bluejetty:00083015:ios.description:
Can’t decide what to watch? Find your next favorite show or movie with Watchworthy, your personalized streaming guide. Powered by real fan ratings and advanced data science, Watchworthy helps you discover what you’ll love across your multiple streaming services.
Watchworthy’s exclusive WORTHY SCORE predicts how much you’ll enjoy shows and movies, based on your unique taste. The more you rate, the smarter and more accurate your recommendations become. 
Could Watchworthy be your new best friend? Probably not (there are apps for that). But Watchworthy is an uncannily accurate, super-intelligent watch assistant that learns what YOU like and personally matches you to new shows and movies. So stop wasting time endlessly scrolling through your streaming services, and discover shows and movies you’ll love with Watchworthy.
How It Works:
• Personalized Recommendations for TV & Movies: Start by selecting the streaming services you use, like Amazon Prime, Apple TV+, Disney+, Hulu, HBO Max, Netflix, Paramount+, and over 50 others.
(NOTE: A paid subscription is required to watch some shows and movies; Watchworthy does not provide or promote illegal streaming or downloading of copyrighted content.)
• Next, tell us what you love, like, and dislike by rating popular TV shows and movies.
• (cue magic) Get matched to shows and movies based on your WORTHY SCORE. The higher the score, the more we think you’ll love it. It doesn’t end there; the more you rate, the smarter Watchworthy becomes!
Your All-in-One Streaming Guide:
• Perfect Match: Tell us a few of your favorite shows, and Watchworthy will match you with the perfect new show or movie to watch next.
• Browse by Mood, Genre, and Streaming Service: Whether you’re craving a new thriller, a comedy, or a classic film, Watchworthy’s filters make it easy to find exactly what you want to watch.
• Create & Share Watchlists: Organize your TV shows and movies into personalized watchlists. Want to share your picks? Collaborate with friends and family to build the perfect group watchlists based on a group WORTHY SCORE.
• Stay Updated: Check out new releases, trending shows and movies, and what’s popular right on the app’s home screen.
Watchworthy in the Press:
• “The New ‘Watchworthy’ App From Ranker Is EXACTLY What We All Need Right Now” — BuzzFeed
• “… Watchworthy… might just be the solution TV lovers have been looking for…” — Elite Daily
• “It’s the only statistically relevant, crowd-sourced recommendation app on the market. And the only one you’ll need!” — Pop-Culturalist
• “The antidote for viewers who are overloaded by the bewildering array of program choices in the Peak TV era.” — VideoNuze
Awards & Recognition:
• The Webby Awards: Best Mobile User Experience (Nominee)
• The Webby Awards: Best Entertainment App (Nominee)
Download Watchworthy today and find the next show or movie you’ll love!
Have any questions? Email us at: help@watchworthy.app
(NOTE: Watchworthy recommends content from streaming services. Some streaming services require a paid subscription to watch. Watchworthy does not provide or promote illegal streaming or downloading.)

bluejetty:00031225:ios.summary: Rider magazine's goal is to provide a wealth of information for riders who are less interested in ultimate high-performance but strive to improve their riding skills and enjoyment of everyday motorcycling and motorcycle touring—through both
bluejetty:00031225:ios.description:
Rider magazine's goal is to provide a wealth of information for riders who are less interested in ultimate high-performance but strive to improve their riding skills and enjoyment of everyday motorcycling and motorcycle touring—through both guided and self-guided tours.
Rider is the premier motorcycle touring, travel and adventure magazine in the United States. The magazine was started in 1974 and is published monthly for readers who look to Rider for the best information on all types of street and adventure motorcycles, places to ride, accessories and maintenance.
Many types of bikes and riders participate in the street motorcycle market. Rider is the one magazine that caters to the ranks of mature, serious street and adventure motorcycle enthusiasts, regardless of the type and brand of bike they own. Rider magazine's goal is to provide a wealth of information for riders who are less interested in ultimate high-performance but strive to improve their riding skills and enjoyment of motorcycling. For more than 40 years, Rider's intelligent road tests, travel articles, and How-To features have created a loyal audience of active and informed, real-world street riders.
----------------------------------------------
This is a free app download. Within the app users can purchase the current issue and back issues.
Subscriptions are also available within the application. A subscription will start from the latest regular issue at the time of purchase.
-The subscription will renew automatically unless cancelled more than 24 hours before the end of the current period. You will be charged for renewal within 24 hours of the end of the current period, for the same duration and at the current subscription rate for the product.
-You may turn off the auto-renewal of subscriptions through your Account Settings, however you are not able to cancel the current subscription during its active period.
-Payment will be charged to your iTunes account at confirmation of purchase and any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when a subscription to that publication is purchased.
-If a subscription offers a free trial, at the end of the trial period, you will be charged the full price of the subscription. You may cancel a subscription during its free trial period via the subscription settings on your iTunes account. This must be done 24 hours before the end of the subscription period to avoid being charged.
Users can register for/ login to a pocketmags account in-app. This will protect their issues in the case of a lost device and allow browsing of purchases on multiple platforms. Existing pocketmags users can retrieve their purchases by logging into their account.
We recommend loading the app for the first time in a wi-fi area so that all issue data is retrieved.
If your app will not load past the splash page after a first install or an update, please delete and reinstall the app from the App Store
Help and frequently asked questions can be accessed in-app and on pocketmags.
If you have any problems at all please do not hesitate to contact us: help@pocketmags.com
--------------------
You can find our privacy policy here:
http://www.pocketmags.com/privacy.aspx
You can find our terms and conditions here:
http://www.pocketmags.com/terms.aspx

bluejetty:00063386:ios.description:
Followers Analyzer shows you exactly who unfollowed you on X (Twitter), who is not following you back, and how your audience changes over time.
Every refresh compares your current followers with the previous snapshot, so you get a real history of who followed and who unfollowed you — not just a number that went down.
WHAT YOU CAN SEE
• Unfollowers — everyone who has unfollowed you, with the date
• Not following back — accounts you follow that do not follow you
• Fans — people following you that you have not followed back yet
• Mutual followers — your reciprocal connections
• New followers — who joined your audience since your last check
• Pending requests — follow requests that were never accepted
GROWTH ANALYTICS
• Daily, weekly and monthly follower growth charts
• Followers gained and lost, side by side
• Following growth over the same periods
• Full history, so you can tell a good week from a bad one
TRACK OTHER ACCOUNTS
Add any public account and follow its growth next to yours. Useful to benchmark competitors, clients, or accounts you want to learn from.
MULTIPLE ACCOUNTS
Manage several X (Twitter) profiles from the same app and switch between them instantly. Each account keeps its own followers history and its own statistics.
PRIVACY
Security is our top priority. We ask for access to your X (Twitter) data only to compute your followers statistics, and we handle that responsibility with the utmost care. We never post to your account without your explicit action.
PREMIUM
Premium removes ads and unlocks the full lists and the extended history.
Available in 11 languages: English, Arabic, French, German, Hindi, Italian, Japanese, Portuguese, Russian, Spanish and Turkish.
Got questions?
• X: https://twitter.com/AppFollowers1
• Email: project130234@gmail.com
This app is not affiliated with X Corp. or Twitter.

bluejetty:00122265:ios.name: TV Cast Pro for Samsung TV
bluejetty:00122265:ios.summary:
Watch any web video, online movie, livestream or live TV show on your Samsung Smart TV or Blu-ray Player. Enjoy the show on your big screen with the no#1 web video streamer.
With Video & TV Cast for Samsung Smart TV you can browse the web
bluejetty:00122265:ios.description:
Watch any web video, online movie, livestream or live TV show on your Samsung Smart TV or Blu-ray Player. Enjoy the show on your big screen with the no#1 web video streamer.
With Video & TV Cast for Samsung Smart TV you can browse the web and stream any web video, online movie, livestream or live TV show you want on your Samsung Smart TV. Mp4, m3u8, hls livestreams and also video-over-https are supported.
There is no time limit at all! You can watch videos of 2 minutes or 2 hours or even more. Just open Video & TV Cast, navigate to a website and wait for the video link detection. The video link will appear below the browser. Tap it and the video will be sent to your big screen instantly! Streaming personal media from your device is also supported. You don't need to install a big media server like Plex or any other third party software.
>>> Important Notes
* To enable video casting, please open the Samsung App Store (Smart Hub) on your TV or Blu-ray Player, search for 'TV Cast' and install the receiver app.
* Please enter the IP address of your iPhone/iPad by using the number pad and up/down/left/right buttons on your Samsung TV Remote. Just enter the numbers, no need to press the enter key.
* iTunes movies and DRM-protected videos like Amazon Prime, Netflix, Hulu, Vudu, DirecTV, Xfinity, HBO Now are not supported!
* Please use the Remote Playbar for video control while browsing (see more info below).
* The app streams only the video part of a website and not the whole website content (No screen or tab mirroring!). 
* Sometimes it is necessary to play the video on your iPad or iPhone first before it gets discovered by the app for streaming. It may also be neccessary to start casting multiple times until it works with specific videos.
* If a specific video is not working, please check the FAQ on the app startpage. If that does not help you, please drop us an email before leaving a negative comment on the App Store. We will try to add support for that website as soon as possible.
>>> PRO FEATURES
* Remote Playbar: Use the Playbar for advanced video control while browsing, including video scrubbing, forward, rewind, play, pause, stop. The playbar works on all Samsung Smart TVs and Blu-ray Players. 
* Local Videos: Cast your camera roll videos from an iPhone or iPad. Supports mp4, m4v and mov videos that were saved to the camera roll via Apples SD-Card/USB Adapter, iTunes Desktop Software or third party apps.
* Ad-Blocker + No Sponsoring Ads: The Pro app version has no ads and the Ad-Blocker blocks ads & popups on most websites that you visit. You can update, enable/disable ad-blocking at any time in the settings. 
* Bookmarks: Save unlimited website bookmarks. Synchronize and transfer them between different TV Cast apps and iOS devices by using backup and restore via iCloud.
* Desktop Mode: Change the browser user-agent and cloak your iPhone/iPad as a desktop PC to load the desktop website instead of the mobile website. Please note that this will NOT enable video casting on websites that serve Flash videos in desktop mode.
* Change Homepage: Set your personal homepage in the settings.
Disclaimer: This app is not affiliated with Samsung or any other trademark mentioned here.

bluejetty:00158212:ios.name: WeWash
bluejetty:00158212:ios.summary: WeWash has started a revolution in communal laundry washing! Unnecessary trips to the laundry room; collection of coins and washing tokens; and uncertainty about when exactly your laundry is done are things of the past. Thanks to WeWash doi
bluejetty:00158212:ios.description:
WeWash has started a revolution in communal laundry washing! Unnecessary trips to the laundry room; collection of coins and washing tokens; and uncertainty about when exactly your laundry is done are things of the past. Thanks to WeWash doing your laundry is so much easier: 
• Reserve washing machines and dryers for free. 
• Receive notifications about the state of your laundry. 
• Pay with your phone — no more coins or tokens — transparently and conveniently. 
• Our help center and WeWash customer support will help you with any questions. 
In detail:
Reserve washing machines and dryers for free 
With our app, you can check whether there are any washing machines or dryers currently in use in your laundry room; when not in use, you can reserve them for free – directly from your sofa, when on the go, or from anywhere you choose. If there currently is no machine available … Not a problem! Enter our virtual waiting queue and save your spot in line to automatically getting the next machine when it becomes available! We will notify you as soon as your appliance is waiting for you.
Cashless payment 
No more collecting special coins or buying tokens! With WeWash, you can pay for your washing and drying conveniently directly via the app. You can choose from a wide range of international payment options such as credit card, Apple Pay, PayPal and many more. Keep track of the costs with our simple, GDPR compliant and easy to understand invoicing. 
Always stay up to date 
You will receive regular updates on the state of your laundry via push notifications: Whether your position in the waiting queue changes; your laundry cycle has started successfully; or your laundry is now ready for pick up: You will enjoy full transparency about your reservations, pick up times, and costs. 
Free customer support and help center directly within the app 
No matter what questions you might have, our customer support is always there for you. We offer you several self-help options and a help center which allows you to contact us conveniently and directly within the app
The WeWash app is available in several languages – you can change the language at any time in the profile settings.
WeWash isn’t available yet in your building? Contact us at support@we-wash.com, if you would like to discuss how to get our system in your laundry room. We look forward to hearing from you and to welcoming you to the WeWash community! 
About WeWash 
WeWash, part of the BOSCH group and located in Munich, Germany offers a cashless laundry system and a service which makes using communal laundry rooms attractive to all parties involved.

bluejetty:00172405:ios.description:
Pack your sleeping bag, tent and hat and lets go camping ! Create your very own wildlife adventure, playout your very own camping stories. My City : Wildlife Camping has everything you need for a fun outdoor trip with friends and family. Find the hidden temple, watch out for the bears, go fishing, canoeing and eat lots of marshmallows! Let your imagination take over! My City: Wildlife Camping has lots of fun activities and locations just waiting for you to discover.
*Massive play area which includes an Ancient Temple, a Lake and a Forest.
*Plenty of objects to interact with, including the cute animals!
*Watch out for traps and reveal disguised treasures!
*Spot hidden clues to expose keys, gems, and articles that can open more content!
*Play as a Camper, an Explorer, and many more!
Over 100 million kids have played our games world wide!
Creative Games Kids Love to Play
Think of this game as a fully interactive dollhouse in which you can touch and interact with almost every object you see. With fun characters and highly detailed locations, kids can role-play by creating and playing out their own stories.
Easy enough for a 3-year old to play with, exciting enough for a 9-year old to enjoy!
Game features:
- This game has 8 new locations for kids to explore, role-play and layout their own stories.
- 20 Characters included in this game, feel free to take them to other games. The options are endless!
- Play as you want, stress-free games, Extremely high playability.
- Kids Safe. No 3rd party Ads and IAP. Pay once and get free updates forever.
- Connects with other My City games: All My City games connect together allowing kids to share characters between our games.
More Games, More Story Options, More Fun.
Age group 4-12: 
Easy enough for 4 year olds to play and super exciting for 12 year to enjoy.
Play Together: 
We support multi touch so kids can play together with friends and family on the same screen!
We love making children games, if you like what we do and want to send us ideas and suggestions for our next games of My City you can do so here:

Love our games? Leave us a nice review on the app store, we read them all!
Terms of Use: https://www.my-town.com/EULA
Customer Support contact: support@my-town.com

Play more action packed missions as a real military officer to fight for your survival. This nuclear war game will come to an end when military drones will cater the entire rivals place and destroy them at their peak times. Missile launchers and drone attacks

Real war destruction scenes

bluejetty:00035270:ios.description:
Free mobile data, anywhere you land. 1.2+ million people use Firsty, rated 4.8/5 on Trustpilot.
Firsty is a global mobile network in an app. Install one eSIM, once, and get online in 170 countries, no SIM card, no contract, no roaming bill.
WATCH AN AD, GET DATA. FREE.
Firsty Free costs nothing. Watch a short ad and unlock 20 MB at 1 Mbps. Stack them, and they last 7 days. It's enough for WhatsApp, iMessage, Google Maps, email and booking an Uber, the things you actually need the minute you step off a plane. No credit card. Available for users across North America, Europe and APAC.
NEED REAL SPEED? PICK A PLAN.
CLASSIC , from €0.98/GB
Buy only the data you need, from 0.5GB to 50GB. Highest available speed, no ads, and the same price in every country. Data stays valid for 30 days from activation, and you choose when to activate, so nothing goes to waste. The bigger the package, the lower the price per GB.
UNLIMITED , from €2/day
Data every day you travel: 5GB at full speed, then 512 Kbps until your next day or top-up. Hotspot included. Same daily price for every country. Pause it the day you get home, start it again on your next trip.
Switch, top up or pause whenever you want. No contracts. No hidden fees. No lock-in.
CALL ABROAD FOR LESS
Top up credit in the app and call internationally at low per-minute rates , even on Firsty Free. Your own number shows on every call, and you only pay for the minutes you use. No roaming charges, no second SIM.
ONE eSIM, 170 COUNTRIES
The United States, the United Kingdom, France, Italy, Spain, Germany, Japan, Turkey, Canada, Switzerland, Greece, Albania, Colombia, Peru, Panama, Guatemala, Costa Rica, Brazil, Chile, Israel, Saudi Arabia, Morocco, India and China and many more , all on one eSIM, at one price. Full list: www.firsty.app/countries
HOW IT WORKS
1. Download Firsty
2. Install your eSIM , once, for the whole world
3. Watch an ad for free data, or choose Classic or Unlimited
4. Land anywhere and you're already online
WILL IT WORK ON MY PHONE?
Firsty works on any eSIM-compatible device. Check yours in seconds: www.firsty.app/post/does-my-device-support-esim
INVITE A FRIEND
Your friend gets €3 off their first purchase over €4. When they buy, you get €3 in your Firsty wallet. Full rules: www.firsty.app/firsty-referral
Questions? support@firsty.app

• Play house in interactive ocean scenes

Introducing
bluejetty:00130220:ios.description:
Achieve Your Weight Goals with Ease Using Calo
Looking for an effective way to meet your weight and health goals? Welcome to Calo, your go-to app for seamless calorie tracking, meal planning, and adopting a healthier lifestyle.
Introducing Calo: Your essential companion in reaching weight goals and improving your health!
Key Features:
- Calorie Counter: 
Tailored to your needs, our app uses science-based algorithms to set personalized calorie goals. Track your meals and snacks effortlessly with our intuitive tracker, which provides detailed nutritional information to help you make informed choices.
- Macro Tracker: 
Beyond calorie counting, our app offers a personalized macros program. Get recommendations for protein, carbs, and fats based on your activity level and diet preferences, including balanced, low-carb, low-fat, keto, vegan, vegetarian, paleo and more.
- AI-Powered Food Logging: 
Simplify your diet tracking with our AI-driven feature. Log meals by taking a photo or typing, and let our smart technology handle the rest. Enjoy dining out without the hassle of manual entries.
- Barcode Scanner: 
Quickly access nutritional data by scanning the barcodes of packaged foods. Ideal for specialized diets, this feature helps you make informed food choices wherever you are.
- Solid Scientific Base: 
Our calorie counting is grounded in a scientific foundation, using the Mifflin-St Jeor equation for Basal Metabolic Rate (BMR) and Total Daily Energy Expenditure (TDEE). This ensures a more precise, personalized calorie budget tailored to your lifestyle.
- Personalized Meal Plans: 
Receive meal plans designed to maximize nutrient intake. Based on your eating habits and preferences, our app crafts a plan that aligns with your health goals and dietary needs.
- Weight Loss Recipes:
Success starts with knowing what to eat. Calo offers individualized meal plans with balanced recipes that help manage hunger and support your weight loss journey. Whether you're a beginner or advanced, customize your recipes to fit your goals.
- Recipe Recommendations:
Enjoy balanced meals throughout the day with our personalized meal plans. We design a plan that fits your eating habits and maximizes nutrient intake, helping you maintain a healthy diet during your eating window.
Transform your relationship with food and fitness with Calo. Download now and start your journey towards a healthier you!
Subscription Information:
• Payment will be charged to your iTunes Account at the time of purchase confirmation.
• Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
• Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period.
• Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription.
• Subscriptions may be managed by the user, and auto-renewal can be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings after purchase.
Note: This app is developed for informational purposes only. Always consult your doctor before starting any diet plan. Results can vary.

Privacy Policy: https://app-service.foodscannerai.com/static/privacy_policy.html

bluejetty:00186746:ios.description:
Dinosaur Math: Turn Math into an Adventure Kids Love
Looking for math games for kids that feel like play, not pressure? Dinosaur Math transforms learning into an exciting, interactive journey. Kids explore themed worlds, drive vehicles, collect parts, and unlock cool mechas—while naturally building number sense, logical thinking, and confidence with addition and subtraction. Every challenge feels like a win, and every win keeps them curious for the next level.
Why Kids Love Dinosaur Math
• Learn through play: hands-on block puzzles make numbers and math ideas easy to understand
• Reward-driven progress: complete tasks to earn parts, stickers, and unlock new mechas
• Always engaging: mini-games, races, factories, and adventures keep learning fresh
What Kids Do in the Game
• Explore 5 themed islands with fun missions that connect numbers to quantities
• Drive a train and tackle counting games and math questions to sharpen skills
• Use a factory-style block system to merge and split blocks, learning addition and subtraction step by step
• Pilot awesome mechas in challenge battles powered by a rich question bank for continuous practice
Parent-Friendly Learning Design
• Adjustable difficulty for different skill levels and steady progress
• Clear learning reports with progress insights and helpful practice suggestions
• Offline play supported for learning anywhere
• No third-party advertising for a more focused experience

bluejetty:00070842:ios.name: HRCI Exam Prep 2026
bluejetty:00070842:ios.summary: HRCI Exam Prep 2026 is an exam preparation app that will help you pass the HR Certification Institute (HRCI) certification exam with a high score in your first attempt. Currently, we support preparation for both PHR, SPHR, APHR and GPHR cer
bluejetty:00070842:ios.description:
HRCI Exam Prep 2026 is an exam preparation app that will help you pass the HR Certification Institute (HRCI) certification exam with a high score in your first attempt. Currently, we support preparation for both PHR, SPHR, APHR and GPHR certification exams.
HRCI Exam Prep 2026 will not only help you gain insight into concepts related to HRCI certification exam preparation, but will also help you increase your confidence in passing the exam on your first attempt by practicing thousands of exam-like questions.
### Passing the exam on the first attempt ###
HRCI Exam Prep 2026 contains a large number of questions prepared by exam experts that cover the scope of the official exam requirements. According to the requirements of the exam, you need to master 5 subjects in the PHR certification exam, and each subject contains more than 10 subdivided knowledge areas. You have the flexibility to choose which subjects you need to practice, depending on your situation.
Specifically, the PHR exam subjects include
- Business Management
- Talent Planning and Acquisition
- Learning and Development
- Total Rewards
- Employee and Labor Relations
For the SPHR certification exam, you will need to master 5 subjects, each of which is broken down into over 10 areas of knowledge.
Specifically, the SPHR exam subjects include.
- Leadership and Strategy
- Talent Planning and Acquisition
- Learning and Development
- Total Rewards
- Employee Relations and Engagement
For the APHR certification exam, you need to master 5 subjects, each of which is broken down into more than 5 areas of knowledge.
Specifically, the APHR exam subjects include:
- Talent Acquisition
- Learning & Development
- Compensation & Benefits
- Employee Relations
- Compliance & Risk Management
For the GPHR certification exam, you need to master 6 subjects, each of which is subdivided into more than 10 areas of knowledge.
Specifically, the GPHR exam subjects include:
- Strategic Global Human Resources
- Global Talent Management
- Global Mobility
- Workplace Culture
- Total Rewards
- Risk Management and Compliance
### Key Features ###
- Over 4,000 questions to practice, each including detailed answer explanations
- Specialized practice by content area, with the flexibility to switch at any time
- View an analysis of your current performance in the "Statistics" section
The most important part of passing the HR certification exam is to keep practicing and not lose confidence in the exam. You will find that each time you practice on HRCI Exam Prep 2026, your knowledge of the exam increases, thus increasing your certainty of passing the exam.
Set aside a certain amount of time each day to practice some questions, while hinting to yourself that you will do the same tomorrow. After you develop good study habits, you will find it easier to pass and score high not only on the HRCI exam, but on any other exam!
### Purchase, Subscriptions and Terms ###
You will need to purchase at least one subscription to unlock access to all features, content areas, and questions. Once purchased, the cost will be deducted directly from your Apple account. Subscriptions will automatically renew and be charged based on the rate and term selected for the subscription plan. If you need to cancel your subscription, please do so no later than 24 hours before the end of the current term or your account will be automatically charged for renewal.
You can manage your subscription by turning off auto-renewal in your account settings in Apple after purchase. If a free trial period is offered, any unused portion will be forfeited at the time you purchase your subscription (if applicable).
Terms of Service - http://hrci.yesmaster.pro/terms-of-service.html
Privacy Policy - http://hrci.yesmaster.pro/privacy-policy.html

About Giani Sant Singh Ji Maskeen:
Giani Sant Singh Maskeen, a revered Sikh scholar, was renowned for his profound knowledge of Gurmat and Gurbani. Born in 1934 in Lakki Marwat (now Pakistan), he faced the upheaval of Partition in 1947, which interrupted his education. His family migrated to Alwar, Rajasthan, where he eventually settled.
Maskeen Ji worked briefly as a railway employee before marrying Sunder Kaur in 1958 and making Alwar his permanent home. They had three sons and two daughters. He passed away on 18 February 2005 due to a heart attack during a marriage ceremony in Etawah, Uttar Pradesh, India.
For his invaluable contributions to Sikhism, he was honored with the title of Panth Ratan.

bluejetty:00023568:ios.description:
You arrive at the footsteps of Hollow alone.
Armed with only an empty suitcase, and faint memories… you are determined to discover the details of the life you once lived here.
At the footsteps of the entrance, a familiar apparition appears, leaving you few answers, and an obscure note shunning you away from town.
Haunted by visions of your past, and suffering from amnesia for almost ten years, you embark on a quest to discover buried secrets, putting the pieces of the puzzle together of the life you once had, and to find out once and for all, what happened to your missing family, and this once thriving village.
Armed with a suitcase, a book, and a compass, you roam the desolate area of Hollow, picking up clues, solving puzzles and riddles, & finding journal entries with clues to your past.
Will the secrets you unveil be more than you had ever imagined?
 ——————————————————————
Intuitive Design:
Designed with the player in mind, it’s easy to navigate the world of Hollow with puzzles designed for both the novice, and hardcore player.
Stunning & Realistic Artwork:
The world of Hollow looks hauntingly realistic, with scenes, and locations full of stunning detail & character.
Professional Music & Sounds:
Professionally recorded audio and sounds make Hollow come to life with unnerving effects, and music.
Addictive & Compelling Gameplay & Story:
Compelling even for non-gamers, the story and puzzles will draw you in, inviting you to finish this game to discover the truth, and secrets behind Hollow.

bluejetty:00017439:ios.description:
Welcome to the best animal game, Wild Zombie Online (WZO)
Go hunt! If you don’t hunt first, they will hunt you after.
The wild, the world of animals where only the strongest survives according to the law of the jungle! 
A life-and-death animal hunting action game where you become a zombie animal to chase and hunt wild animals. 
In Wild Zombie Online, you grow to become the best animal hunter by chasing and hunting animals living in the wild. With gigantic monsters, you must subdue and hunt wild animals who resist and come at you. 
You must bravely confront the attacks by strong and rough carnivores and give the fear of death to herbivores who stand up against you in a large herd.
Will you become a powerful and violent wild animal hunter who will beat the attacks of numerous hostile animals and make all wild animals tremble in fear by you? 
1. Differentiated, Rich Maps
The maps are divided into Sahara, a bleak desert; Siberia, covered by snow and ice; and a savanna, a vast tropical grassland. They also consist of regular maps that have different natural environments as well as special maps such as Monster Field where to block wild animals attacks with giant zombie monster and Dragon Lava where dragons with the properties of fire, ice, and lightening. In addition, you will also have maps with various characteristics and uniqueness such as an event map where you can enter only at a certain time, PVP Zone where you can have a 1:1 battle. 
2. Diversified Hunting Means
You can experience hunting and attacking in oriented battles like the ability to transform into a powerful zombie monster and summoning the same kind, power attack
3. Various Missions and Master Menus
You can add more fun to the game through the Trophy Menu where you can make achievements and earn honor points by performing specific missions such as travelling, hunting, and acquiring as well as the Master Menu that enables you to give much more damage when hunting a certain animal. 
※ If you delete the game, all the data will be gone and not recovered.
※ Please visit our Facebook page (www.facebook.com/wildanimalsonline) or YouTube (www.youtube.com/user/hanaGames) channel if you want more information.

Your portfolio, always in your pocket
The AJ Bell app puts your investments right at your fingertips. Here's just some of what you can do in a few taps:
• Manage your portfolio anytime, anywhere 
• Buy and sell shares, funds, ETFs and investment trusts in just a swipe

On our app, you can easily open an account that suits your investment goals:
• Stocks and shares ISA – tax-efficient investing, with anytime withdrawals
• Lifetime ISA – get a government bonus towards your first home or later life
• Self-invested personal pension (SIPP) – take control of your pension, with tax relief
• Dealing account – invest without limits
Help if you need it
You'll get all the tools you need to manage your investments with confidence. And if you need a helping hand, try our:
• AJ Bell Managed funds, which let you leave all the hard work to our experts
• AJ Bell Favourite funds, our shortlist of investments to make choosing easier
• Shares Magazine news and views, to help you keep up with the markets
Safe, secure investing
We think investing should feel good – and that starts with feeling safe. With the AJ Bell app, you can feel assured by:
• Strong industry-standard 256-bit encryption, to keep your data safe
• Use Touch or Face ID for fast, secure access 
• Or sign in with your existing AJ Bell details
Support you can rely on
Our UK based support team is here whenever you need us. Reach us through in-app chat, at ajbell.co.uk, or by calling 0345 54 32 600.
Important information 
Investing is an opportunity to grow your money, and has typically outperformed cash savings over the long term. However, it involves risk as well as reward, and the value of your investments can go down as well as up. You may get back less than you invest. 
Tax benefits depend on your individual circumstances, and tax rules may change in future. 
Any information we provide is to help with your research, and isn't financial advice. If you’re unsure if an investment's right for you, it's best to seek financial advice. 
AJ Bell is authorised and regulated by the Financial Conduct Authority.

bluejetty:00149171:ios.description:
Learn how to play Black Jack with BlackJack Guru!
Blackjack is a game of skill, where every decision moves the odds for or against you. Blackjack Guru helps you understand the strategy behind the game and build real confidence, without ever risking money.
Whether you're new or experienced, the trainer adapts to your level and takes you step by step. Learn the fundamentals, master basic strategy, then progress into card counting.
STRATEGY
· Strategy Table: Learn the correct decision in every situation, at a glance.
· Strategy Drills: Play out simulated hands and decide whether to hit, stand, split, double, or surrender based on the dealer's upcard and your own.
· Instant Feedback: Find out immediately whether you made the optimal play, so mistakes turn into learning.
· Understand Why: Go beyond memorizing. Every decision comes with a clear explanation grounded in probability and outcomes.
· Multiple Training Modes: Focus on the hands you find hardest, such as pairs, soft hands, hard hands, or high-difficulty spots. Drill tricky situations until they're automatic.
· Smart Training Mode: Adapts to your play and targets your weak spots, repeating hands similar to the ones you got wrong so you actually learn before moving on.
· Adapts to Every Level: Whether you're learning the rules or refining an advanced game, difficulty and training order match your skill.
CARD COUNTING
· Card Counting Theory: Understand how counting works, step by step. The system, the card values, and how to keep an accurate running count.
· Card Counting Practice: Build speed and accuracy with structured exercises across multiple difficulty levels.
· Full-Table Counting: Train on multiple hands at once and keep the count under pressure.
· True Count and Deviations: Learn how the running count converts to a true count, and what changes when it does.
PRACTICE AT A TABLE
· Sit down at a virtual table and play full hands to apply what you've learned in the Strategy and Counting modules.
· Earn XP for every hand you play, level up, and unlock new cities.
TRACK YOUR PROGRESS
Detailed statistics show your correct-decision rate over time, reveal patterns in your play, and point you to the areas worth working on next.

Free to download. An optional subscription unlocks unlimited training, the full card counting course, and Smart Training Mode. Additional features and virtual items are available as in-app purchases.

· This app is an educational training tool for learning blackjack strategy and card counting fundamentals, with simulated play only. No real money is wagered at any point.

bluejetty:00037278:ios.summary: The harmonica, also known as a French harp or mouth organ, is a free reed wind instrument used worldwide in many musical genres, notably in blues, American folk music, classical music, jazz, country, and rock. The many types of harmonica in
bluejetty:00037278:ios.description:
The harmonica, also known as a French harp or mouth organ, is a free reed wind instrument used worldwide in many musical genres, notably in blues, American folk music, classical music, jazz, country, and rock. The many types of harmonica include diatonic, chromatic, tremolo, octave, orchestral, and bass versions. A harmonica is played by using the mouth (lips and tongue) to direct air into or out of one (or more) holes along a mouthpiece. Behind each hole is a chamber containing at least one reed. The most common is the diatonic Richter-tuned with ten air passages and twenty reeds, often called the blues harp. A harmonica reed is a flat, elongated spring typically made of brass, stainless steel, or bronze, which is secured at one end over a slot that serves as an airway. When the free end is made to vibrate by the player's air, it alternately blocks and unblocks the airway to produce sound.
Reeds are tuned to individual pitches. Tuning may involve changing a reed's length, the weight near its free end, or the stiffness near its fixed end. Longer, heavier, and springier reeds produce deeper, lower sounds; shorter, lighter, and stiffer reeds make higher-pitched sounds. If, as on most modern harmonicas, a reed is affixed above or below its slot rather than in the plane of the slot, it responds more easily to air flowing in the direction that initially would push it into the slot, i.e., as a closing reed. This difference in response to air direction makes it possible to include both a blow reed and a draw reed in the same air chamber and to play them separately without relying on flaps of plastic or leather (valves, wind-savers) to block the nonplaying reed.
An important technique in performance is bending, causing a drop in pitch by making embouchure adjustments. Bending isolated reeds is possible, as on chromatic and other harmonica models with wind-savers, but also to both lower, and raise (overbend, overblow, overdraw) the pitch produced by pairs of reeds in the same chamber, as on a diatonic or other unvalved harmonica. Such two-reed pitch changes actually involve sound production by the normally silent reed, the opening reed (for instance, the blow reed while the player is drawing).
(https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Harmonica)
The Harmonica Real is Diatonic Harmonica musical instrument simulation app.
More offline and online songs for practice (With the ability to change speed, transpose, reverb).
Play with 2 modes:
- Normal
- RealTime
You can choose autoplay for listening songs.
Record feature: record, play back and share to your friends.
Reverb feature.
** Songs is updated regularly

bluejetty:00184180:ios.description:
Unlock the Power of Compound Interest: See Your Money Grow Over Time
Ever wondered how much your savings could grow if you started investing today? With Compound Interest, you can instantly see the impact of saving and investing on your future wealth.
Start Saving Early and Watch Your Money Grow
What if you started saving for retirement at just 15 instead of 40? By contributing just $100 a week with a 7% return, you could accumulate over $2 million by the time you retire. You may wonder: "How is that possible when I’m only saving $260,000?" The answer lies in the power of compound interest. While your direct savings would total just over $250,000, the additional $2 million comes from the growth of your investments over time. Impressive, right?
Reach Your Retirement Goals with Ease
Already have a target in mind? You can easily adjust the settings to calculate your required contribution, desired return rate, or even the time frame needed. For example, if your goal is to retire with $5 million but you're unsure how much to save each month, simply switch to the "solve for contribution" mode, and the app will automatically calculate the amount you need to save to reach your goal.
Key Features:
Visualize Your Future: Easily calculate how your savings or investments could grow over the next 30 years (or more) with interactive graphs that break down your gains year by year.
Plan for Your Goals: Want to retire a millionaire? Set your target goal, and let the app calculate how much you need to save each month, the return rate, or how long it will take to get there.
Experiment with Different Scenarios: Test different saving strategies with the option to create multiple tabs. Try saving $100/week for 10 years, then adjusting your contributions—see the real impact of compound interest!
Flexible Calculations: Whether you're solving for total balance, contribution amount, return rate, or investment length, Compound Interest makes it easy to adjust your plan and reach your financial goals.
Advanced Tab References: Link one tab's balance to another for more complex calculations. Want to try saving more for a few years and less later? It's easy to reference and compare different strategies.
Customizable Themes: Switch between light and dark modes to suit your style.
Why You'll Love It:
See exactly how compound interest works and how small changes in saving habits can lead to huge financial gains.
Perfect for retirement planning, saving for big goals, or simply exploring the magic of compounding.
Simple, intuitive design for easy use no matter your financial knowledge.
Start planning today, and watch your future wealth grow with Compound Interest!

bluejetty:00069110:ios.description:
Welcome to Coronation Street! It’s time for you to step onto the cobbles and help Ken Barlow, Bet Lynch and many of your favorite characters in this new crossword game, based on the popular drama, Coronation Street!
Help Ken give his old house a whole new look. Design it, decorate it and unearth buried treasures from Ken’s past.
Head to the Rovers Return Inn where you can help Bet renovate the world famous pub and restore it to its former glory after it’s consumed by yet another fire. Decide on the legendary pub’s new look, and get it up and running again so Bet can serve the thirsty locals.
In order to progress in the game you will need to solve entertaining and funny crossword puzzles. Beat and complete these crossword levels to unlock new chapters in the story. Discover secrets and the hidden mysteries of Coronation Street with some classic characters.
The game features all sorts of shenanigans:
• A new type of word game: Solve word puzzles to progress in the story!
• Interior design: Create your dream Coronation Street look and make those legendary sets your own.
• Exciting crosswords: This game really needs a true word puzzle master. Could that be you?
• Famous characters: Meet Ken Barlow, Bet Lynch and many more Coronation Street legends as you progress through the game!
• Discover secrets and mysteries: Discover and unlock new rooms and hidden areas in Coronation Street!
• Collect and find famous Coronation Street items as you design and build Ken’s new Memorabilia Room - the Kenorabilia Room!
It’s time to show off your decorating skills as you choose from a wide range of styles and design Ken’s house, the Rovers Return Inn and many more. By being in control of all of the design decisions, you’ll get to pick and choose many of the new items that go into the rooms, ensuring you have the final say on where Ken and Bet call home.
Once you’ve solved your first Coronation Street crossword puzzle, you’re on your way to helping Ken and Bet solve their problems while creating your very own dream Coronation Street look!
So what are you waiting for? Download the Coronation Street Game, it’s flamin’ belting!
Learn more about the game on Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/Coronation-Street-Words-Design-121988852736512/

THE “WHEN” OF YOUR DAILY ACTIVITIES

bluejetty:00148334:ios.description:
THE “WHEN” OF YOUR DAILY ACTIVITIES
Feel more energized, think more clearly, and sleep more deeply by syncing your daily life to nature’s rhythm. Circadian helps you wake, eat, move, work, and rest at the optimal times for your body so that you can be at your best.
Achieve natural health by honoring your body’s built-in clock. 
ALIGN WITH SUNLIGHT & SEASONS
Start living more in alignment with your local environment. Circadian harnesses daily and seasonal patterns to optimize your days and thus your health. Uncover sunset, sunrise UVA/UVB rise & set as important daily markers and time cues. Entrain your body to the time of day, night, and season for a radically different experience of living. 
BEDTIME & BIORHYTHM CALCULATOR
Plan your optimal hours of sleep with our seasonal sleep calculator. Let your sleep cycles sync to nature’s timing and reap the benefits. Understand why just five minutes of morning light can boost next night's sleep quality by 20%. There is a lot to discover. Everything is connected. 
EAT & FAST IN SYNC WITH NATURE
Research shows that intermittent fasting and early time-restricted eating—eating during daylight hours and fasting after dark—support a healthy metabolism, balanced blood sugar levels, and deeper sleep. Schedule meal and fasting reminders that honor nature’s timing.
THE SCIENCE OF CIRCADIAN RHYTHMS
Built on Nobel Prize–winning chronobiology, Circadian reveals how light, hormones, and environment shape your well-being. Learn why morning sunlight is crucial for your mood, energy and hormonal balance, how your body needs darkness at night, and why robust rhythms guard against chronic disease. Explore our in-app library for articles and practical tips on melatonin, exercise timing, artificial light, cognition, grounding, and more.
With over 800 resources and 1000+ references, Circadian is the ultimate guide for learning about the most important aspect of your health.
EVERYDAY BENEFITS
◾ SLEEP WELL – Difficulty falling or staying asleep and excessive sleepiness is often due to chronic circadian disruption. Instead, drift off naturally and wake refreshed.
◾ BALANCE WEIGHT – Circadian disruption is strongly associated with insulin resistance and obesity. Eat and fast in line with nature for an efficient & healthy metabolism.
◾ BOOST ENERGY – Aligning with natural rhythms and increasing exposure to sunlight boosts cellular energy production.
◾LIFT MOOD – Circadian rhythm disruptions and light disturbances are a major hallmark of severe mood disorders. Learn how to produce endorphins, dopamine, and serotonin in your body, naturally.
◾LIVE LONGER – Circadian rhythm disruption plays a direct role in diseases of ageing and ageing itself. The opposite is also true!
◾GET STARTED FOR FREE – Try Circadian for free with no credit card required.
START PRIORITIZING WHAT MATTERS MOST
◾Set reminders for critical circadian events essential for health and vitality.
◾Align your lifestyle with the light and dark cycles at your location.
◾Learn the science of circadian rhythms and how to apply it to your daily life.
Download Circadian today—and step into a more harmonious and healthier life.

bluejetty:00116483:android.description:
🌟 Join Mia and Elara on a vacation of their lifetimes! 🌟
The once beautiful and prosperous Mediterranean island, with its charming harbor and seaside allure, has declined with the arrival of a mysterious corporation. Now it's up to the two best friends to uncover secrets and bring the island back to its glory. 🏝️
Key Features:
🧩 Merge Items:
Create a vibrant world by combining items to craft new, exciting objects. Discover endless combinations as you help rebuild the Cozy Coast B&B and assist your friends on this enchanting island.
🌍 Explore the Island:
Venture across breathtaking Mediterranean landscapes, highlighting the lush gardens and stunning seaside views using your exploration energy. Each area brims with unique challenges and rewards, all wrapped in stunning visuals that transport you to a timeless summer escape.
🏘️ Revive the B&B and the Island Charm:
Restore the Cozy Coast B&B and the rest of the island, embracing the warmth of the summer retreat experience! Each site holds its own story, inviting you to aid friendly islanders in rejuvenating their treasured home.
🔍 Uncover Hidden Mysteries:
Clear the fog to reveal new areas, chasing clues about the secretive plans of the mysterious corporation. Among the island's vibrant gardens, every discovery moves you closer to unveiling the truth and protecting the island’s future.
📖 Follow an Inspiring Story:
Will Mia restore her childhood paradise by the seaside, or will the mysterious corporation take over? Follow along as Mia and Elara put their friendship to the test in this captivating adventure weaving themes of friendship, love, and courage.
👭 Team Up with Friends:
Mia and Elara are the dynamic duo for this grand mission. Together, they’ll face trials, unearth secrets, cook local delicacies, and fight for the island’s past and future.
🎒 Pack your bags and dive into the magical world of Cozy Coast. Your help is crucial—the island is counting on you! ✨

bluejetty:00100095:ios.summary:
THE FRUITY HOLE GAME YOU DIDN’T KNOW YOU NEEDED
Say what now? That’s right, this delightful app mixes an eating game with a black hole: each level you’ll guide the black hole around the field, swallowing jelly fruits whole as fast as you c
bluejetty:00100095:ios.description:
THE FRUITY HOLE GAME YOU DIDN’T KNOW YOU NEEDED
Say what now? That’s right, this delightful app mixes an eating game with a black hole: each level you’ll guide the black hole around the field, swallowing jelly fruits whole as fast as you can. Addicting and fun to play, fans of arcade games will love the classic graphics, easy interface, and of course, dropping fruits into the hole!
FRUITS AWAY!
Each level consists of a field filled with fruit, and your job is to swallow it all whole. Zip around eating jelly fruit as fast and efficiently as you can, avoiding accidentally blocking your black hole, knocking fruit off the field, or running out of time. Levels get progressively more difficult so take the time to hone your jelly munching skills. Despite the timer this hole game is tons of fun to play for all ages and skill levels, and is chock full of great features.
Look forward to:
- Classic graphics – bright, classic arcade-style graphics and colors await you in Jelly Hole, ensuring that the game is easy on the eyes. Thanks to the straightforward interface and basic controls you’ll be able to fully focus on steering your black hole around and gobbling up goodies instead of learning crazy rules or pushing through flashing lights and crazy graphics.
- Fun for all – Seasoned player or total newb, all are sure to have fun with this addicting game. Levels get harder the further along you get, making it easy to get used to the rules and game play, and helpful boosters are available in case you ever get stuck on a difficult spot. Along the way, take some time to enjoy all of the colorful fruit patterns on the field, and the animations as your black hole gulps down food.
- Chill gaming – While the pressure may be on to swallow all of the jelly fruit before your time runs out, you’ll find this game to be surprisingly calming. Perfect for when you’re between things and want to distract yourself for a few minutes, or when you have a longer chunk of time that needs filling, this relaxing game fits the bill.
FRUIT-FUL FUN
Ready, set, swallow that fruit! Jelly Hole is an exciting arcade-style black hole game where you race around swallowing fruits and other tasty jellies before the timer runs out. Each level offers a kaleidoscope of fruit that you’ll need to find and eat, but don’t stress too much – boosters and more are available to ease you through any difficult levels. Relaxing yet exciting, this easy addicting hole game is the perfect addition to your day, so why not give it a try now, and see how much fruit you can eat!

Terms of Use: https://say.games/terms-of-use

bluejetty:00085622:ios.description:
Découvrez notre toute nouvelle application et plongez, chaque semaine, dans le monde incisif de Charlie Hebdo, un journal indépendant, satirique, politique et joyeux, désormais à portée de main sur votre smartphone ou tablette. Enquêtes, reportages, dessins, coups de gueule… Retrouvez toute l’équipe de Charlie dans votre poche dès le mardi soir.
Fonctionnalités clés :
1. Accès à l'Édition hebdomadaire : ne ratez jamais un numéro ! Téléchargez et lisez le dernier numéro de Charlie Hebdo avant même sa sortie en kiosque, dès le mardi soir.
2. Nouvelle interface : notre application offre une expérience de lecture fluide et intuitive, conçue pour vous offrir un confort de lecture optimal sur tous les appareils.
3. Archives : plongez dans notre vaste bibliothèque numérique et accédez aux numéros précédents pour revisiter vos articles et dessins préférés.
4. Mises à jour régulières : activez les mises à jour automatiques pour rester connecté à votre journal et bénéficier de nos dernières évolutions.
5. Personnalisation : marquez vos journaux favoris et créez votre propre collection numérique.
6. Lecture Hors Ligne : téléchargez vos numéros préférés pour les lire où que vous soyez, même sans connexion Internet.
7. Notifications : soyez informés instantanément dès la sortie d'un nouveau numéro.
L’appli Charlie, c’est le meilleur moyen de retrouver tout votre hebdo préféré dans votre poche. Rejoignez notre communauté de lecteurs fidèles et restez connectés à l'actualité, à la politique et à la société… Faites comme eux, soyez moins cons, lisez Charlie.

bluejetty:00121010:ios.description:
Welcome to the sweetest hair salon for girls! Meet the Candylocks™ dolls with their crazy long and super soft cotton candy hair that begs to be styled! Curl, braid, straighten, cut and move hair as you wish! Dye it in any color of the rainbow! Add yummy DIY hair accessories! Create cute makeup looks! Decorate your fantasy salon!
· COLLECT DOLLS ·
Unravel cotton candy hair to reveal your first surprise Candylocks™ doll! Collect them all: Kiwi Kara, Betty Berry, Birthday Kate, Uni Cami and Cotton Sandy! Each girl has a unique style. Discover it!
· PLAY WITH HAIR ·
Create hundreds of deliciously adorable hairstyles for cute Candylocks™ girls! There are no rules — just get creative and play with hair! Move it in any direction! Use 10 hair salon tools to create the sweetest braids, buns and updos. Don’t be afraid to experiment and cut Candylocks’™ hair short — there’s always a magic potion to grow it back! Dye hair in any color of the rainbow! Add tons of delicious accessories!
· STYLE CUTE OUTFITS ·
Mix and match tons of new dresses, skirts, tops and shoes! Create the sweetest outfits for your Candylocks™! Each doll has her own unique selection of clothes! Style a look inspired by this week’s theme and get exciting rewards. What a sweet twist!
· DO SWEET MAKEUP ·
Create the sweetest makeup to finish up your doll’s look! Choose among tons of shimmery eye shadows!
· CREATE WITH CANDYLOCKS™ ·
Unleash your creativity with the Candylocks™ dolls! Design sweet hair accessories. Decorate your hair salon with cute candy-inspired house decor! Take colorful photos of your fave hairstyles. New backgrounds and decor added!
Play Candylocks Hair Salon — a deliciously adorable game for girls and boys who love hairstyling, dolls and surprises!

bluejetty:00061506:ios.summary: Take control of your energy with the Palmetto app. Monitor your solar system, track home energy usage, connect with expert support, and maximize your savings — all in one place. Whether you're a solar customer or just starting your clean en
bluejetty:00061506:ios.description:
Take control of your energy with the Palmetto app. Monitor your solar system, track home energy usage, connect with expert support, and maximize your savings — all in one place. Whether you're a solar customer or just starting your clean energy journey, Palmetto makes it easy to understand and optimize your home's energy performance.
Key Features
REWARDS FOR SMARTER ENERGY USAGE
Now you can turn your everyday energy use into points you can redeem for discounts on home upgrades.
- Track your energy usage between bills
- Earn points for saving energy
- Redeem points for upgrades, from heat pumps to smart plugs and more
It’s not a game, but it sure feels like one.
Think of it as a personal energy coach for your home, always on, always on your side. Simple. Helpful. Rewarding the good choices you’re already making.
ENERGY INSIGHTS & DASHBOARD
Track your energy usage and solar production in real time. View daily, weekly, and monthly trends to ensure your system is running at peak efficiency.
PERSONALIZED SAVINGS TOOLS
Get recommendations tailored to your home that help you save even more, from system performance tips to smart energy upgrades.
WHOLE HOME ENERGY MANAGEMENT
See how your home uses energy beyond solar. Monitor consumption patterns and make data-driven decisions.
REFER & EARN
Love your solar setup? Invite friends to switch and earn cash rewards through the in-app referral program.
SUPPORT, WHENEVER YOU NEED IT
Reach Palmetto’s award-winning customer experience team with just one tap. Chat, email, or call directly from the app.
FAQs
Q: Who can use the Palmetto app?

bluejetty:00044693:ios.summary:
► ROCK THE BLOCKS
What a tangled web we weave, and you’re the one who’s going to untangle it in this unusual and entertaining puzzle game that requires you to stretch your imagination, unblock your logic, and really get your brain working.
bluejetty:00044693:ios.description:
► ROCK THE BLOCKS
What a tangled web we weave, and you’re the one who’s going to untangle it in this unusual and entertaining puzzle game that requires you to stretch your imagination, unblock your logic, and really get your brain working. Tug and twist at the matted tangle until eventually something snaps and a pair of cubes break free. Solving the puzzle won’t be easy – especially as the number of blocks gets bigger and bigger and more and more complex mechanisms are added to the mix – but it’s bound to bring a massive dose of satisfaction when you finally set the last blocks free.
► CAN YOU SQUARE IT?
• Feeling mentally blocked? This original and addictive brainteaser game is a great way to improve your IQ and give your mind a quick but powerful workout. Pairs of blocks connected by a stretchy cord must be brought together to clear the board and complete the puzzle. Pull this one up, push that one to the side, and keep shuffling till you’ve completed all the pairs.
• It's a non-stop block party: With over 1000 levels to complete, there’s always something to engage your brain and get you thinking in this relaxing but intriguing puzzle game. Five minutes to spare? Get solving another tangled block puzzle.
• New tricks on the block: As you progress through the game, you’ll come across a wide range of new mechanics that will keep the puzzles challenging and your brain ticking over – exploding blocks, pairs moving in one direction only, shattering glass cubes and much more. Be sure, you’ll never have time to get bored, and your logic will always be tested.
• Blocks of colour: Original puzzle mechanics are combined with bright and beautiful graphics and satisfying haptic effects to brisk each puzzle and activate not just your logic but every part of your brain.
• Never get stuck on the blocks: If you don’t see the solution straight away, you may pull and prod at different blocks on the board as long as you like – until you find a way to start setting them free. And if you really get stuck, there’s always an option of just skipping to the next level ensuring a stress-free and pleasurable playing experience.
► UNTANGLE, UNWIND AND HAVE FUN
If you’re looking for a fast and entertaining puzzle game that would keep you engaged and your brain active for some five minutes or endless hours, then look no further than Shackled Cubes. Download the game now and throw yourself on untangling the knotted cubes in increasingly challenging and enjoyable puzzles that will give your brain enjoyable exercise while also helping you kick back and relax. Come and join the block party!

bluejetty:00180505:ios.summary: Maktun is the ultimate app for collectors of coins, banknotes and tokens. Just take a photo to identify any item instantly, discover its current market value, and add it to your personal collection. The database already contains over 300,00
bluejetty:00180505:ios.description:
Maktun is the ultimate app for collectors of coins, banknotes and tokens. Just take a photo to identify any item instantly, discover its current market value, and add it to your personal collection. The database already contains over 300,000 coins and 160,000 banknotes from around the world.
Organize and value your collection easily. Maktun lets you save photos, create exchange or sale lists, and access detailed statistics about countries, denominations, and rarities — all synchronized and safely stored in the Cloud.
- Now we have tokens too! Along with coins and banknotes, Maktun now includes over 15,000 tokens. Explore the largest catalogue of commemorative and regular issues - lira, euros, dollars, German marks, USSR coins, rare pieces, and much more.
- Check the current market value and discover rare varieties
- View complete details, including country, denomination, year of issue, catalogue number, mintage, weight, size, and other specifications
- Get help from numismatists right inside the app
User-friendly collection management
- Create private collections and add items to lists for exchange, purchase or sale
- Save high-quality photos of coins, banknotes and tokens
- Keep track of items for exchange, purchase and sale
- Export data to PDF, XLS or CSV for analysis and printing
Detailed statistics and analytics
- Track your progress with statistics on the number of items, countries, denominations and missing pieces
- Visual infographics on a world map show you which countries your coins and banknotes come from
Synchronisation and security
- Access your collection from any device, even when you're offline
- Backup - your data is always safe
- Share coins, banknotes and entire collections with friends and other collectors
About subscription
Access exclusive features and benefits by subscribing. 
Take your pick from our two available plans:
Pro - This is our monthly subscription plan. By subscribing to Pro, you gain the ability to create and manage up to 10 personal collections. You can export your data to PDF, XLS, or CSV formats, with a generous limit of 100 coins and banknotes. Your backups can be securely stored in iCloud without any restrictions. Dive deep into your collection statistics, including the number of coins, banknotes, countries, denominations, a world map view, and easily identify missing pieces to complete your collection.
Pro+ - Option for our yearly subscription plan, Pro+, for even more benefits. With Pro+, you can expand your personal collections to 25. Enjoy unlimited exports of your data to PDF, XLS, or CSV formats. Your iCloud backups remain unrestricted. Delve into comprehensive statistics about your collections, just like in the Pro plan.
Your subscription payment will be processed through your iTunes account once the purchase is confirmed. The subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current billing period. Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period, indicating the renewal cost. You have the flexibility to manage your subscriptions and cancel them through your user account settings post-purchase.
Terms of Use: https://maktun.com/terms 
Privacy Policy: https://maktun.com/privacy
Should you have any further inquiries or require assistance, please don't hesitate to reach out to us at help@maktun.com.

bluejetty:00046116:ios.description:
HUBCHART app is a free HIPAA compliant, Patient-Centered Collaborative Care app. It is the best tool to manage thousands of Patient Care Groups. The Care Team can securely share vital information with each other anytime, anywhere. This Team Care approach helps facilitate and expedite care delivery. The “Patient-named” Collaborative Chat Groups can function like an ad-hoc Health Record where all chats, files, images, videos, and link can be shared within the secured group and archived for future reference. These private group chats are managed by a group owner and administrators, as well as other participants of the care team permitted by the group owner. The Care Team can be made up of doctors, doctor’s staff, the patient or family, Pharmacy etc. Hubchart’s Patient Centric Groups are especially valuable for Complex Medical Care, Case Management and Concierge Medicine where individualized care can be delivered by a multidisciplinary team continuously coordinating with each other to provide optimum care.

With
bluejetty:00144471:ios.description:
The go-to app for pet lovers. Quickly find your lost pet using unique IDs and a detailed profile in a global database. Speed up pet recovery and organize all critical pet information in one place. Trusted by over 2 million pet owners.
With our app, over 90% of lost pets return home within 24 hours
FEATURES
UNIQUE QR PET TAGS
Easily create and manage custom QR tags for your pets. The QR code on your pet's tag allows anyone who finds your pet to access its profile and contact you immediately. The owner's contact information and other critical details are customizable and can be updated anytime, with changes reflected instantly.
MICROCHIP REGISTRATION
Register any microchip from top brands in the US, such as HomeAgain, Avid Identification Systems, 24Petwatch, AKC Reunite, PetLink, Fi Nano, Nanochip ID, PetKey, SmartTag Microchip, and BuddyID, ensuring your pet can be easily identified and located.
GLOBAL SEARCHABILITY
Ensure your pet is globally identifiable with seamless synchronization of your pet’s microchip across major pet databases like PetMaxx, AAHA, and Europetnet. If your pet doesn't have a QR tag, their profile can still be accessed via their microchip on the Animal ID website.
REAL-TIME SCAN ALERTS
Receive push and text notifications whenever your pet's QR tag or microchip is scanned. With the scanner's consent, see the location on the app's map, helping you quickly reunite with your lost pet.
UNLIMITED PET DOCUMENT STORAGE AND MORE
Store all your pet’s documents without limits. Manage a comprehensive photo gallery, track your pet's weight, set reminders for important events like vet visits and vaccinations — all in one place.
JOIN THE COMMUNITY
By creating a profile for your pet on Animal ID, you join a global community of over 1 million registered animals. Connect with other pet owners and support the development of new products designed to help animals.
Trusted Partners:
Best Friends Animal Society (USA)
Dogs Trust Worldwide (UK)
Four Paws International (Austria)
NatureWatch Foundation (UK)
Europetnet Association (EU)
PetMaxx.com (Global)

bluejetty:00030695:ios.summary:
احتجت محامي؟ استشارة قانونية؟ نسهلها عليك بخدمات تطلبها خلال دقائق، يقدمها محامون مرخصون من وزارة العدل وذوو خبرة، في أكثر من 19 تخصص قانوني. كل هذا في تطبيق واحد، بكل سهولة وأمان.
شورى هي منصتك الموثوقة للحصول على استشارات وخدمات قانونية
bluejetty:00030695:ios.description:
احتجت محامي؟ استشارة قانونية؟ نسهلها عليك بخدمات تطلبها خلال دقائق، يقدمها محامون مرخصون من وزارة العدل وذوو خبرة، في أكثر من 19 تخصص قانوني. كل هذا في تطبيق واحد، بكل سهولة وأمان.
شورى هي منصتك الموثوقة للحصول على استشارات وخدمات قانونية تغطي كل ما تحتاجه، بسرية تامة، وواجهة استخدام سهلة. من أول استشارة، إلى صياغة العقود، التمثيل أمام القضاء، وحتى التحكيم والترجمة القانونية - كل شي في مكان واحد.
لماذا تختار شورى؟
محامون مرخصون وذوو خبرة:
جميع المحامين في شورى محامون مرخصون من وزارة العدل السعودية، ويتم اختيارهم بعناية لتقديم استشارات دقيقة وموثوقة.
تخصصات قانونية متعددة:
نغطي أكثر من 19 تخصص قانوني، منها الأحوال الشخصية، القضايا الجنائية، الأخطاء الطبية، العقارات، الشركات، وغيرها الكثير.
متاحين 24/7:
الخدمة متوفرة على مدار الساعة. تقدر تطلب استشارتك في أي وقت يناسبك، من أي مكان.
تجربة استخدام سهلة وسريعة:
من أول ما تفتح التطبيق، تقدر تطلب الخدمة اللي تحتاجها بخطوات بسيطة وواضحة - بدون أي تعقيد.
خصوصيتك أولويتنا:
نتعامل مع بياناتك بأعلى درجات السرية والأمان. كل تواصل يتم بسرية تامة، وتحكم كامل بمعلوماتك.
خدمات قانونية متكاملة:
من الاستشارات والترافع، إلى العقود، التحكيم، الترجمة القانونية، توثيق المستندات، وأكثر.
خدماتنا تشمل:
استشارات قانونية في جميع التخصصات.
صياغة ومراجعة العقود.
التمثيل القانوني أمام الجهات القضائية.
كتابة المذكرات القانونية (صحيفة دعوى، مذكرة اعتراض، لائحة نقض...).
التحكيم وحل النزاعات.
دعم قانوني للشركات الناشئة والصغيرة والمتوسطة.
ترجمة قانونية معتمدة.
توثيق المستندات والوكالات.
مشير – أول مساعد قانوني ذكي:
مشير هو مساعدك القانوني المعتمد على الذكاء الاصطناعي، يجاوب على استفساراتك بشكل فوري، ويوجهك للخدمة المناسبة داخل التطبيق.
حمّل تطبيق شورى الآن واطلب استشارتك القانونية بسهولة، أمان، وفي أي وقت تحتاج فيه محامي.

• Fast, precise 3D scans with a simple guided flow.
• Uses LiDAR when available; otherwise processes via cloud photogrammetry for high-detail models.

• Customizable AR Code designs—both functional and brandable.
• Customizable in-AR banner to engage users during the experience.
Capture objects, create immersive AR experiences, and share instantly with an AR Code.
AR Code Object Capture Premium is a monthly recurring subscription. You will automatically be billed the amount (US$34.99) through the App Store at the end of the free trial period which is 7 days. bluejetty:00029867:ios.description:
Come to the Princess Games and let's play together!  
You will be a baby doctor and help the little princess prepare for the arrival of the new baby. Whether receiving professional pregnant care in the hospital room, enjoying peaceful moments in the room of the baby doctor, or maintaining physical health in the fitness center, every room in the castle will provide her with comprehensive services. We also have adorable babies and other dolls, through interacting with them and triggering various tools. Enjoy a variety of games for kids and experience the joy of the girl game, taking care of the baby in "My World: Princess Town--Pregnant Little Princess".
Features in the girl game:
- Dress up the little princess and create her dream house in the castle, making her pregnet life even more special.
- Different rooms available for adventure!
- Experience a fun pregnet life in the princess's castle in games for kids like Toka Boka.
- Touch, drag and explore every item and see what happens! Surprises are hidden everywhere!
- Discover hundreds of exquisite items, dolls and enjoy the fun of my world with Elsa.
How to play:
- You can decide all the orders in "My World: Princess Town".
- You can create a different doll by clicking the avatar button.
- Choose a room in the dream house and a character to play with, such as the Toka Boka town, hospital room, and luxury canteen.
- Click and drag the tools you see, every item can be played and interacted in dream house. 
- Customized clothes of the day according to the daily schedule, dress up the princess and doll to be Elsa or anyone you like.
- You can try different types of activities in this girl game, such as exercising, using B-ultrasound equipment, beauty treatments, practicing yoga, and more.
Subscription pricing and terms:
This app offers an auto-renewing week subscription at $2.99/week to provide unlimited access and other premium features.
Payment will be charged to the credit card connected to your iTunes Account when you confirm the initial subscription purchase. Subscriptions automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current subscription period. Your account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period, and the cost of the renewal will be identified. You may manage your subscription and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to your Account Settings after the purchase. Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when you purchase a subscription, where applicable.
Your use of this application is governed by the Terms of Service available at https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Collection and use of your data are subject to the Privacy Policy available at https://www.privacypolicygenerator.info/live.php?token=6sSgtRE9QeOG9ZW73usCGwXn76XpGRt4
Important Message for Purchases:
- By downloading this App you agree to our Privacy Policy
- Please consider that this App may include third parties services for limited legally permissible purposes.

bluejetty:00187481:ios.summary: Medallia Mobile is the ultimate tool for closing the loop with customers fast. New role-based dashboards, streamlined workflows, and built-in alerts put real power in the hands of your workforce to take quick action on trends or feedback in
bluejetty:00187481:ios.description:
Medallia Mobile is the ultimate tool for closing the loop with customers fast. New role-based dashboards, streamlined workflows, and built-in alerts put real power in the hands of your workforce to take quick action on trends or feedback in real-time.
Listening and responding to feedback becomes a habit when you bring the customer experience to employees at all levels with an intuitive interface and the ability to access this critical information anywhere, anytime:
Role-based dashboards mean instant access to the most relevant, fine-tuned CX metrics for every employee
- Close the loop fast via email and phone
- Call customers back and record call results
- Quick email replies with starter templates, or forward to colleagues
- View, close, or reopen alerts
- Optimized case management actions and ability to assign a case to user and/or role
- Consistent look and feel between mobile and web with common modules that have the same behavior and user-defined filters in both
Self-service administration makes it easy to set up and build dashboards for each role, aligning every employee with their most important customer experience metrics. Users can then view individual customer feedback and see the full context of each response along with related case management activities. 
Medallia Mobile 3 is built with the Medallia Alchemy design system to provide a consistent, fundamentally better user experience between mobile and desktop. And support for Single Sign-on, Pincode/Touch ID, and Enterprise Mobility Management platforms makes it easy to manage user access across your organization from one place. 
Download Medallia Mobile 3 today to activate your employees everywhere by putting real power into the hands of your mobile workforce. 
About Medallia:
Medallia Mobile provides access to the Medallia Enterprise Feedback Management solutions used by Global 2000 companies around the world to track customer satisfaction. 
Medallia’s solutions enable companies to gather, monitor, and act on feedback from customers, partners, and employees. Customers include global financial services, retail, high-tech, business-to-business, and hotel companies.
