bluejetty:00067945:ios.name: Helicopter Flying: Car Driving
bluejetty:00067945:ios.summary:
Explore the huge environment, filled with forests, deserts, cities, and mountains; more than 16 km² of the area to fly and drive around in one of the best helicopter flying simulators!
Compete in tons of unique missions to become a profess
bluejetty:00067945:ios.description:
Explore the huge environment, filled with forests, deserts, cities, and mountains; more than 16 km² of the area to fly and drive around in one of the best helicopter flying simulators!
Compete in tons of unique missions to become a professional helicopter pilot.
!! Helicopter Flying Simulator: Car Driving contains awesome free missions and unlimited gameplay action !!
Fly and drive from a wide range of helicopters and cars; choose between flying in search and rescue helicopter (like Bell 412 or AS-365), civil copter (like MD-500, Hughes, Ecureuil), transport chopper, and more to fly.
Take flight and help save people in a Fire rescue helicopter to transport water and extinguish the fires.
Transport broke down vehicles to the scrapyard with your helicopter to move objects with an electromagnet.
Or choose the "Apache" helicopter to fire rockets and clear the road of debris.
Explore the expansive world to find one of many helipads to launch a mission, or you can fly or drive cars around and do whatever you want freely. Take the open road around the winding roads around the mountains or take your helicopter and fly right over them. Explore the wonders and possibilities in one of the best helicopter flying simulators today!
The minimap helps you to know where are the mission spots.
Real car drifting and nitro fuel injected engines bring realistic car driving simulator experiences, enjoy lots of points of interest to discover. Customize and style out your car with each cool unlock earned through gameplay.
Drive offroad or search the skies to see the sights like rivers and lakes, ancient ruins, airports with other aircraft and planes, secluded houses and farms, city, a camping place, and more...
Example of missions :
- Search and rescue response, help stranded hikers on mountains.
- Firefighter: collect water and extinguish burning fires.
- Transport wreck: grab the old car with your electromagnet and go to the wrecking yard
- Help the victims after a car accident
- Get the empty oxygen cylinders at the top of the mountain, during a tempest
- Race through checkpoints as fast as possible
- Unload a container ship with a magnet
- Fire rockets to remove all the objects and clear the road
- Land your helicopter on a moving boat and moving trucks
- Stop and catch all bad drivers before they escape
Features :
- Huge open world, filled with wide open roads, mountains, city, hills, and forests
- Realistic flying and driving simulation
- Realistic flight and car driving physics
- Design cars with customization tools.
- High-quality helicopters and car models
- Dynamic camera angles
- Easy to play driving controls, use touch and tilt controls!
You can adjust the quality button to play without lag in the pause menu.

bluejetty:00041113:ios.description:
Make A Cocktail is the official app from Make Me A Cocktail — the world's greatest online cocktail resource, with over 3,500 recipes and a global community of home bar enthusiasts. Now with hands-free, step-by-step voice guidance, photo-scan your bar, and live AI advice from Cocktail Colin & Cocktail Connie.
MAKE ANY COCKTAIL, HANDS-FREE
Tap "Start making" on any recipe and get step-by-step voice narration that walks you through every pour, shake and stir. Sticky hands? No problem — your phone reads each step out loud while you mix.
ASK COLIN OR CONNIE ANYTHING
Stuck on a step? Out of an ingredient? Tap the microphone and just ask. Cocktail Colin gives you straight answers. Upgrade to Premium and Connie tailors every reply to your bar, your tastes, and the bottles you actually own.
PHOTO-SCAN YOUR HOME BAR
Point your camera at the bottles on your shelf and we'll add them in seconds — no typing required. Save unlimited bars (home, holiday, the office party) and switch between them in a tap.
WHAT CAN I MAKE RIGHT NOW?
Tell us what you have — spirits, mixers, juices, wine, even eggs — and we'll show you every cocktail you can make this minute. No "almost" results. Just drinks you can pour right now.
GET INSPIRED
Browse 3,500+ recipes by base spirit, style, or mood. Discover the cocktail of the day, seasonal collections, and curated lists from our editors and the community.
REMEMBER WHAT YOU LOVE
Save favourites, mark drinks you've tried, and add tasting notes so you remember exactly why that Old Fashioned hit. Build lists for parties, date nights, dry January, anything.
PREMIUM
Unlock unlimited questions to Cocktail Connie, personalised recommendations based on your bar, multi-bar support, and our full feature set with a Premium subscription.
GOT IDEAS?
We'd love to hear from you. Email contact@makemeacocktail.com

Embark on a global quest to track down and hunt some of the most formidable monsters from the Monster Hunter universe as they appear in o
bluejetty:00026509:android:1.description:
The thrill of the hunt is calling. Begin your hunting adventure now!
Hunt monsters in the real world:
Embark on a global quest to track down and hunt some of the most formidable monsters from the Monster Hunter universe as they appear in our world. Forge powerful weapons and team up with fellow hunters to track down larger-than-life monsters and take them head-on.
Authentic hunting action carefully adapted to mobile: 
Discover a variety of monsters depending on the habitat around you – Forest, Desert or Swamp – and engage in thrilling hunts solo, or band together with fellow hunters to take on these large monsters. The simplified tap-based controls and high-fidelity graphics enable you to engage in enjoyable hunting action wherever you go. 
See monsters around you with the AR Camera:
Experience what it’s like to have these iconic monsters appear in the real world with exclusive AR Camera features.
Master the hunt in 75 seconds:
Can you complete the hunt within 75 seconds? Master the weapons, craft armor sets and hone your skills – exploit weaknesses and utilize every element at your disposal to take on the hunt.
Mark monsters even with your phone in the pocket: 
With Adventure Sync, you can use a Paintball to track monsters while you explore your town and bring the hunt to your doorstep afterwards. As you explore, your Palico can mark passing monsters with Palico Paintballs, even while you aren’t actively playing, allowing you to return to them later, ensuring that the action never stops.

bluejetty:00037307:ios.description:
London Fitness Guy and the PWER Trainers are here to help you stick to an exercise plan, enjoy your workouts and get you feeling STRONGER & FITTER.
With over 10+ years experience in delivering group exercise, London Fitness Guy and the team bring all the motivation, energy and expert coaching to your mobile or laptop, allowing you to workout wherever, and whenever you like!
The 4 class disciplines of BURN, BUILD, BALANCE AND BREATHE are designed to provide a workout to your body and mind. Whether it's HIIT, Strength, Yoga or Meditation you choose, we make sure you feel great when you finish your session.
Join the 1000+ people around the world who take part in our monthly challenges, these help to provide accountability and direction by giving you a structured daily workout plan, removing the hassle out of planning your week.
Included in the membership:
ACCESS TO ALL WORKOUTS
With over 200+ workouts on the platform, you can filter by duration, mood, or type to find what suits you. Hit start, and we guide you through from beginning to end, with exercise options for beginners to advanced.
- HIIT
- Strength Training
- Bodyweight
- Stretch and Mobility
- Yoga
- Meditations / Mindfulness
- Monthly Challenges
CHALLENGES
A new challenge each month keeps your workout plan varied & fun to stick to! We currently have more than 6+ challenges to complete including a 4-week Strength Programme, 8-week Sweat Challenge, and even a dedicated Core Strength Programme.
BODYWEIGHT AND DUMBBELL WORKOUTS
As seen on London Fitness Guy's Instagram page, accessibility is the key behind maintaining your fitness. We want to make exercising and sticking to a programme as easy as possible. That's why you can do all workouts from home, the gym, on holiday or outside in the fresh air! Bodyweight or Dumbbell - we have you covered!
CALORIE CALCULATOR
We have a built in calorie calculator to help you understand your calorie requirements. We use a TDEE (Total Daily Energy Expenditure) calculation to identify the calories required to achieve your goals.

bluejetty:00023880:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00023880:ios.description:
Is your phone charging as fast as it should? Don't guess-know for sure with Amperes Battery Charging Lite!
Amperes is your ultimate battery companion, giving you a real-time look at exactly how fast your iPhone or iPad is charging. Charging speed can vary wildly depending on your cable, your power adapter, the port you're plugged into, and what your device is doing in the background. Amperes cuts through the guesswork and hands you the hard numbers.
WHY USE AMPERES?
- Instantly see live charging speed in milliamperes (mA)
- Compare cables, chargers, wall outlets, power banks, and car adapters
- Spot the slow charger hiding in your drawer before it wastes another night
- Track how background apps and screen brightness affect charging power
- Learn what real fast charging looks like versus a trickle charge
- Keep an eye on your battery's overall health and current status
KEY FEATURES
- Real-time charging speed meter, updated every second
- Clean, easy-to-read display designed for a quick glance
- Current battery level, state, and charging status at your fingertips
- Works with any Lightning or USB-C charger, cable, or accessory
- Lightweight, fast, and free of clutter
- Optimized for the latest iPhone and iPad models
PERFECT FOR
- Travelers testing hotel USB ports and airport outlets
- Power users comparing MagSafe, wireless pads, and wired chargers
- Anyone shopping for a new cable or fast charger
- Tech enthusiasts who love knowing exactly what their gear is doing
- Parents and families sharing chargers around the house
HOW IT WORKS
Plug your device into any power source, open Amperes, and watch the live reading appear. Swap cables or adapters and see the difference in real time. It's the fastest way to answer the question: is this actually fast charging, or is my phone crawling?
STOP GUESSING, START MEASURING
A bad cable or underpowered adapter can double your charging time without you ever noticing. Amperes puts the truth on your screen so you can charge smarter, travel lighter, and never be stuck at 20% again.
Download Amperes Battery Charging Lite today and take control of every charge.

■オンライン対戦
端末の通信機能を使って、いつでもどこでも誰とでも最大２０人までリアルタイムでリモート対戦することができます。
オンライン対戦では、全国対戦、合言葉対戦、友達対戦から選ぶことができます。
◇見やすく快適な文字入力！
・メッセージが読みやすく、また戸惑うことなく素早くメッセージを入力できるようメッセージアプリのような親しみやすいレイアウトと操作性を実現しました。
◇ボイス付きスタンプ機能でより対戦が盛り上がる！
・通常のメッセージだけでなく、対戦相手に専用のボイス付きスタンプを送ることができます。
◇全国のプレイヤーとオンライン対戦！
全国対戦を遊ぶことでランキングポイントが加算され全国のプレイヤーとランキングを競うことができます。
◇合言葉を決めてオンライン対戦！
友達同士で決めた合言葉を入力することで手軽に対戦することができます。
◇登録した仲間とオンライン対戦！
友達に登録したプレイヤーとオンラインで対戦することができます。
プレイヤーアイコンとして、好きな画像をアイコンに使用することができます。

スマホ一台で（最大２０人）対戦できる対戦モードです。一台の端末を囲んで順番に操作してゲームを進行します。パーティーやイベントなどで使用すれば盛り上がること間違いなしです！
◇ＧＭ不要！！ボイスナビで快適ゲーム進行！
プレイヤーがゲーム進行を兼務して説明する必要はありません。
アプリが代わって、ゲーム進行役（ＧＭ：ゲームマスター）の説明を音声（ボイス）で行います。
◇ライフ消費無し
対面対戦では何回遊んでもライフが消費されません。
お友達と思う存分人狼ジャッジメントをお楽しみいただけます。
■アドベンチャー
オフラインでひとりで楽しむアドベンチャーモード。
人狼ジャッジメントの操作や遊び方がわかるモードです。
はじめての人やオンライン対戦が苦手な人でも楽しむことができます。

文字を入力不要！選択肢から選ぶだけのお手軽モードです。

対人ゲームではないので、時間を気にせず、じっくり考えることができます。
時には話を読み返し、慎重に話の矛盾や人狼しか言わないような言葉を見つけ出し人狼を追い詰めましょう！
◇ライフ消費無し
アドベンチャーも対面対戦と同様、何回遊んでもライフは消費されません。

突然の吹雪によって遭難してしまった人々。
険しい森、強い風と雪…
極限状態の中でふと見上げるとそこには不気味にそびえ立つ屋敷があった。
吹雪を凌げると屋敷に避難した人々だったが、その中に人の姿に化けた人狼が紛れ込んでいた。
やがて夜になると人狼は、狼の力を取り戻し、屋敷の中のひとりに襲いかかり喰い殺した。
次の朝、鋭い牙と爪によって引き裂かれた死体が屋敷の床に転がっていた。
その無残な死体を目の当たりにした人々は、この中に人狼がいることを確信した。
人々は人狼が誰かを話し合った。
しかし、話は紛れ込んだ人狼によって簡単に纏まらない。
人狼が誰か分からぬまま時間だけが過ぎていく。
このままでは夜が来て、また誰かが襲われてしまう。
そこで、人々は投票によって一番怪しい人ひとりを選出し、日が落ちる前に処刑することにした。
もし処刑された人物が人狼ならば、その夜から誰も襲われることはない。
しかし、もし人狼でない者を処刑すれば、その夜もまた誰かが襲われることになる。
吹雪の収まる気配はない。
人と人狼の生き残りを賭けた戦いが今はじまる！
－－－－－－－－－－

　不正な方法で、ライフ等を獲得する行為

　事実と異なる情報を入力してアカウントを生成する等の行為
　その他、当社が不正行為と判断する行為

A trip you've talked about for months. A deadline nobody wants to mention. An idea that deserves more than “we should”. Bring it to Shapes.

bluejetty:00041108:ios.description:
Track ovulation with confidence with the gold standard fertility charting app, trusted for over 25 years. Fertility Friend helps to accurately find your most fertile days, understand your ovulation pattern, and learn more about your unique cycle.
Join the millions of women who have used Fertility Friend while trying to conceive, including over 1 million who recorded positive pregnancy tests in the app.
Track your period and key fertility signs (BBT, cervical fluid, OPKs, symptoms). Fertility Friend will automatically create your chart, highlight your fertile window, and provide personalized insights, including when ovulation likely occurred and when to test for pregnancy.
Fertility Friend teaches you how to chart, what your signs mean, and gives you the confidence to never miss a fertile opportunity.
What’s FREE:
- We do not sell or share your data or display ads
- 30-day trial of premium features (No credit card, no auto-charge)
- Automatic ovulation detection
- Use Fertility Friend’s advanced (default) accurate ovulation detector or choose ovulation detection based on the Fertility Awareness Method (FAM)
- Interactive fertility chart with coverline and symptom display
- Color-coded fertility calendar: see your period, fertile days, ovulation and more at a glance
- Detailed and customizable data entry: period, BBT, OPK, CM, symptoms, meds, LH tests…
- Sync with Apple Health and Oura (automatic import of temps, heart rate, sleep, and more)
- Graphical cycle progress bar/ticker display
- Daily data summary
- Period tracking
- Menstrual cycle statistics: cycle length, phase length, ovulation dates
- Extensive TTC educational library: videos, lessons, quizzes, games, articles
- Searchable gallery of 240,000+ shared cycles. 
- View real life BBT charts filtered by keywords
- Sharing possibilities (optional)
- Dark Mode and custom color themes
- Companion access to FertilityFriend.com
What’s PREMIUM (Highlights):
- All Free features plus
- Advanced fertility insights and analysis
- More graphs & detailed interpretations
- Enhanced data display on chart and calendar
- Cycle comparison tools
- Pregnancy Monitor
- Pregnancy Tracker
- Charts “Like Mine” gallery search
- Stats display on Chart Gallery searches
- Pattern detection
- Private, supportive community
- Additional expert tools developed over decades
Fertility Friend offers unmatched experience, accuracy, and depth to help you understand your cycle with confidence.
Important: This app provides educational estimates only and must not be used to avoid pregnancy or schedule medical procedures. Always consult your healthcare provider for medical advice.

bluejetty:00180740:ios.description:
Find the perfect time to catchup across multiple time zones without the mind-bending math.
Overlap is a smart world clock that helps you connect with people in different time zones. It makes it simple to see the time in multiple places at once, and its fun Overlap Graph is a unique visual way to quickly find convenient meeting times across the world. You can choose ‘available’ hours for each time zone. For example Dan in London might be available from 2pm to 5pm and Rashida in Sydney might be available from 7am to midday. Bring up the Overlap Graph and it will magically show you the most compatible times to schedule your catchup. 
Overlap also displays your calendar events, so you can always find a time that suits your schedule.
Available on iPhone, iPad and Mac.

bluejetty:00064127:ios.description:
Experience the classic thrill of Klondike, the most renowned solitaire card game, now right at your fingertips! Dive into this timeless pastime, perfectly crafted for both enthusiasts and newcomers alike. With Klondike's intuitive and engaging gameplay, you're set for hours of captivating challenges.
In this digital version, you'll maneuver a standard 52-card deck, artfully arranged in seven piles, to unveil hidden cards and build up foundations. The crisp, visually stunning graphics bring the traditional game to life, ensuring a seamless and enjoyable experience.

Authentic Klondike Solitaire, following the classic rules that millions love.
A scoring system that adds a competitive edge to your play.
A diverse array of card designs and scenic backgrounds to personalize your game.
Choose your challenge: opt for the simplicity of drawing one card, or the complexity of three.
Effortless drag-and-drop controls, designed for smooth, easy play.
Every game is winnable – a perfect blend of skill and strategy awaits.
Quick-move functionality: a simple tap can smartly relocate a card.
The ability to save and load games, so you never lose progress.
An undo feature to revise moves and refine strategies.
Whether you're looking to unwind or engage your mind, our Klondike Solitaire offers the perfect blend of relaxation and mental stimulation. Download now and start building your legacy in the world of solitaire!

bluejetty:00079795:ios.name: The Salt Lake Tribune
bluejetty:00079795:ios.summary: A voice for Utah since 1871 and a nonprofit since 2019 The Salt Lake Tribune brings you our new 2-in-1 iOS app. Free to download and use, The Salt Lake Tribune app includes both a free live news site and the subscriber-only e-edition, a dig
bluejetty:00079795:ios.description:
A voice for Utah since 1871 and a nonprofit since 2019 The Salt Lake Tribune brings you our new 2-in-1 iOS app. Free to download and use, The Salt Lake Tribune app includes both a free live news site and the subscriber-only e-edition, a digital version of the paper created and delivered in the app everyday.
STAY INFORMED
Updated with a streamlined reading experience, now available to non-subscribers, easily get the latest news as it happens from Salt Lake City, the Wasatch Front and throughout Utah. 
As a 501(c)(3) nonprofit we strive to tell stories that are interesting, important and inclusive. The Tribune offers unmatched reporting on state and local government, politics, the environment, education, religion, criminal justice, sports and the variety of rich stories about the people and places that make Utah special. Keep up to date with the latest news that impacts you and your community. Your readership today helps ensure a stronger Utah tomorrow. 
KEY FEATURES
Access to all The Tribune’s award-winning coverage. Sort through stories by section and curate a reading experience tailored to your reading habits and interests. 
Tribune subscribers can easily flip through pages, read stories, and view photos just as they’ve appeared in paper with The Tribune e-edition. Share and save stories, access previous editions, download for offline viewing and more. 
Receive push notifications and stay informed with keep in the loop on breaking news and the important stories.
Streamlined navigation for users on the go: Easily swipe between stories, zoom in as necessary, and share articles with friends and family in the new Salt Lake Tribune iOS app.
Let text to speech read out stories aloud to you as you go throughout your day.
OUR NONPROFIT MODEL
The Salt Lake Tribune transformed to a 501(c)(3) in late 2019, making it the first legacy newspaper in the U.S. to transform from a for-profit company to a nonprofit entity. Under the new structure, The Tribune is governed by a board of directors, with Huntsman serving as chairman of the board.
The Salt Lake Tribune is pioneering one path forward for local news.

bluejetty:00061873:ios.description:
YouApp è l’app di Banco BPM per il mobile banking. Ti consente di gestire il tuo conto Banco BPM e quelli che possiedi presso altre banche, in un’unica applicazione, con funzionalità avanzate e un’interfaccia intuitiva.
Nata anche grazie ai suggerimenti dei clienti, YouApp evolve continuamente per offrirti un’esperienza semplice, completa e su misura.
UNA SOLA APP PER TUTTI I TUOI CONTI
Con YouConnect, puoi collegare al mobile banking Banco BPM anche i conti correnti e le carte di altre banche. In questo modo ottieni una visione aggregata e aggiornata di saldo e movimenti, direttamente da YouApp.
AUTENTICAZIONE CON TOKEN APP
YouApp sostituisce il token fisico: accedi e confermi le operazioni online con Token App. Puoi utilizzare l’impronta digitale o il riconoscimento facciale per autorizzare l’operatività in modo rapido e pratico.
GESTIONE SPESE E RISPARMIO
La sezione Spese ti aiuta a monitorare e pianificare il bilancio familiare:
• Analizza le spese per categoria e ottieni una previsione mensile
• Fissa limiti di spesa personalizzati
• Confronta i dati del mese corrente con quelli dei due precedenti
• Monitora i tuoi obiettivi di risparmio mensile
• Visualizza i brand a cui sei più affezionato
FIRMA DIGITALE DEI CONTRATTI
Accedi in modo semplice ai prodotti e servizi Banco BPM. Puoi parlare con un consulente al telefono o in videochiamata e firmare i contratti direttamente in app, in pochi passaggi.
OPERAZIONI E PAGAMENTI
Grazie al pulsante Pagamenti puoi:
• Effettuare bonifici ordinari o istantanei, anche verso l’estero e per detrazione
• Ricaricare il cellulare e le carte prepagate
• Pagamenti MAV, RAV, CBILL-PagoPA e bollettini postali
• Caricare un PDF per acquisire i dati dei tributi in automatico
• Pagare il bollo auto direttamente da app
• Hai un modulo F24 in PDF? Caricalo in app: i dati si compilano da soli.
Hai anche la possibilità di utilizzare la fotocamera per acquisire i dati o dettare la causale tramite comandi vocali.
GESTIONE COMPLETA DEL PROFILO
• Consulta saldo, investimenti e finanziamenti dalla Home
• Tieni sotto controllo i movimenti delle tue carte
• Aggiungi carte di debito e prepagate al wallet Apple Pay per pagare dal tuo smartphone
• Acquista titoli in autonomia con il trading online
• Investi in oltre 4.000 fondi nell’area Fondi & SICAV
• Trova la filiale Banco BPM più vicina e fissa appuntamenti direttamente in app
• Imposta notifiche e avvisi personalizzati per tenere sempre monitorati conti e operazioni
“PER TE” – LA NUOVA AREA PRODOTTI
Scopri una sezione completamente rinnovata, organizzata per aree tematiche, dove trovare facilmente ciò che ti interessa: carte, prestiti, noleggio a lungo termine e altre soluzioni su misura.
ASSISTENZA OVUNQUE TI TROVI
Hai bisogno di supporto? Utilizza l’Assistente vocale o l’Assistente virtuale, che ti guiderà alle funzionalità più utili. In alternativa, puoi parlare direttamente con un consulente del Servizio Clienti, via chat o telefono.
Info accessibilità:
gruppo.bancobpm.it/accessibilita/

bluejetty:00039573:ios.summary:
DON’T JUST TRACK YOUR TRAINING. SEE WHICH MUSCLES ARE ACTUALLY DOING THE WORK!
Lightweight! is a science-based workout tracking and analysis app built for fitness, bodybuilding, strength training, powerlifting, and anyone who wants to unde
bluejetty:00039573:ios.description:
DON’T JUST TRACK YOUR TRAINING. SEE WHICH MUSCLES ARE ACTUALLY DOING THE WORK!
Lightweight! is a science-based workout tracking and analysis app built for fitness, bodybuilding, strength training, powerlifting, and anyone who wants to understand their training at a deeper level.
• Discover effective exercises
• Log your sets, reps, and weights
• Analyze your workout program with muscle-region heat-maps
• Choose from dozens of ready-made training programs from our experts
• Track your body progress and powerlifting performance
Don’t just track how much you train. See which muscles you’re training, which areas may be underworked, and how well you’re recovering.
MUSCLE GROWTH ANALYSIS & TRAINING SCIENCE
Training a muscle is only part of the equation. You also need to understand how much stimulus you’re creating and how well you recover between sessions.
Analyze how every workout affects individual muscles and muscle regions.
• See which muscles are working and by how much
• Get detailed muscle-region analysis
• Identify undertrained and overworked areas
• Analyze daily training stimulus
• Review weekly stimulus and muscle damage
• Track muscle fatigue and recovery
• Evaluate the muscle distribution of your training program
• Easily identify exercises that may be missing or unnecessary
Lightweight’s mathematical training model combines your exercises, sets, reps, effort, and training load to help you understand what your program is actually doing.
WORKOUT TRACKING & TRAINING LOG
Build your own workout program or choose from dozens of programs created by our expert team for different goals and training styles.
• Gym-based bodybuilding or powerlifting programs
• Programs designed specifically for women
• Equipment-free home workouts
• Dozens of 2, 3, 4, 5, and 6-day training plans
Log your sets, reps, weights, and performance with ease. Review previous workouts, track your progress, and plan your next session.
Whether your goal is building muscle, getting stronger, bodybuilding, or powerlifting, your complete training history stays with you.
DISCOVER THE BEST EXERCISES
Find the right exercise quickly with an extensive exercise library.
• Detailed filtering by muscle group
• Exercise selection by equipment
• Home workout and gym options
• Exercise instructions and demonstration videos
Whether you train at the gym or at home, find exercises that match your goals in seconds.
GYM, HOME, OR OUTDOOR TRAINING
Science-based training should work wherever you train!
• Gym exercises and structured workout programs
• Dumbbell and equipment-free home workouts
• Outdoor and calisthenics exercises
• Training options for women and men
• Programs for beginners through advanced athletes of all ages
TRACK YOUR STRENGTH
Follow your progress in the squat, bench press, deadlift, and other major lifts.
• Log the weights you lift
• Track personal records
• Monitor your estimated strength level
• Evaluate your powerlifting performance
• Compare your results with other Lightweight! users
TRACK YOUR BODY PROGRESS
Record your weight, body measurements, and other physical changes over time.
• Estimate your body fat percentage
• Calculate your FFMI
• Set and track weekly bodyweight and body-fat targets
See your training performance and physical progress in one place.
Lightweight! brings advanced training science and powerful analysis tools into one app, helping you understand your workouts instead of simply recording them.

Privacy: https://www.lightweightapp.com/company/privacy
EULA: https://www.lightweightapp.com/company/eula

bluejetty:00137720:ios.description:
SmartWOD Workout Generator creates functional fitness workouts based on the equipment you have available. Whether you're training at home, in the gym, or while traveling – SmartWOD helps you find the perfect workout in seconds.
Select your equipment, generate a workout, and start training immediately with the integrated workout timer.
But SmartWOD is more than just a workout generator. It's a complete functional fitness training app that helps you plan, track, and perform your workouts.
FEATURES
WORKOUT GENERATOR
• Generate workouts based on available equipment
• Over 5000 workouts in the database
• Filter by muscle group, movement category or equipment
• Bodyweight workouts and travel-friendly workouts
• Benchmark WODs and partner workouts
• SmartWOD special workouts
WORKOUT BUILDER
• Create your own workouts
• Combine multiple workout parts such as warm-up, strength, metcon, and finisher
• Supports workout formats like AMRAP, EMOM, FOR TIME, TABATA and more
• Perfect for functional fitness, strength training and high-intensity workouts
SMART WORKOUT TIMER
• Integrated timer for all workout types
• Interval timer for EMOM, TABATA and AMRAP workouts
• Round counter and workout tracking
• Rest timers for strength training (e.g. 5x5 workouts)
• Apple Watch companion app
EXERCISE LIBRARY
• Exercise demonstration videos
• Instructions for common functional fitness movements
• Helpful guidance for correct exercise execution
SMART WARM-UPS & COOLDOWNS
• Warm-up routines tailored to your upcoming workout
• Cooldown & stretching routines adapted to the workout you just completed
• Video guides for every warm-up and cooldown exercise
PERSONAL RECORDS
• Track your PRs for lifts, gymnastics and benchmark WODs
• Personal records for deadlift, bench press, squat, clean and more
• Monitor your progress over time
WORKOUT TRACKING
• Log your workouts with scores and notes
• Track your times and progress
• Complete training diary always in your pocket
COMMUNITY
• Share your results and connect with other athletes
• Follow friends, compare scores and stay motivated
• Customize your profile and visibility settings
Train anywhere – at home, in the gym, or while traveling – and always find the right workout with SmartWOD.
Have fun sweating with SmartWOD!
SUBSCRIPTION PRICING AND TERMS
SmartWOD offers two auto-renewing subscription options:
$3.49 (US) per month
$29.99 (US) per year
These prices are for United States customers. Pricing in other countries may vary and actual charges may be converted to your local currency depending on the country of residence.
Your SmartWOD subscription will automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can go to your iTunes Account settings to manage your subscription and turn off auto-renew. Your iTunes Account will be charged when the purchase is confirmed.
SmartWOD also offers a Lifetime subscription which is paid for by a one-off upfront payment of $89.99 (US) with unlimited access to the SmartWOD features forever.

- You do not need to run the application, because the application reads the steps sensor inside your device and thus will not affect the device's battery.
- يدعم اللغتين العربية والانجليزية
- Supports both Arabic and English
- يدعم الوضع الليلي
- Support Dark mode

bluejetty:00158260:ios.name: Tower Rush - Tower Defense TD
bluejetty:00158260:ios.summary:
Play the world’s first true PVP Tower Defense game!
In this one-of-a-kind tower defense game, you battle your opponent on a shared battlefield in real time! Strategically prepare your deck with warriors to send against your opponent as wel
bluejetty:00158260:ios.description:
Play the world’s first true PVP Tower Defense game!
In this one-of-a-kind tower defense game, you battle your opponent on a shared battlefield in real time! Strategically prepare your deck with warriors to send against your opponent as well as towers to attack and defend. During the fast-paced battle, place magical towers to attack the advancing enemy troops and help your own soldiers reach the enemy base! Tower Rush gets back to the roots of what makes Tower Defense fun with the fresh addition of a player-vs-player experience.
Enjoy an awesome variety of visually stunning characters, maps, towers, and powers. Customize your strategy and respond to your opponent’s moves to stay on top! 
The game is set in a vibrant magical world of visually captivating maps and characters. Your throne has been usurped by your brother, who has pushed you and your loyal followers to the edge of the kingdom. With your back to the sea, you must harness the power of magical trees and rally your friends to fight back and reclaim your land!
Many games claim to be PVP Tower Defense, but Tower Rush actually delivers.

bluejetty:00021367:ios.name: Brother iPrint&Scan
bluejetty:00021367:ios.summary: Brother iPrint&Scan is a free app that enables you to print from and scan to your iOS device (iPhone / iPod touch / iPad). Use your local wireless network to connect your iOS device to your Brother printer or all-in-one. Some new advanced f
bluejetty:00021367:ios.description:
Brother iPrint&Scan is a free app that enables you to print from and scan to your iOS device (iPhone / iPod touch / iPad). Use your local wireless network to connect your iOS device to your Brother printer or all-in-one. Some new advanced functions have been added, including edit, fax send, fax preview, copy preview, and machine status. Visit your local Brother website for a list of supported models.
[Key Features]
- Easy to use menu.
- Simple steps to print your favorite photos, web pages and documents (PDF, Word, Excel®, PowerPoint®, Text).
- Print photos directly from your iPhone camera.
- Print PDF files or Microsoft® Office documents or Text files by starting the app from "Open in..."
- Print your documents and photos directly from the following cloud services: Dropbox™, OneDrive, Evernote®.
- Print what you copied to the clipboard.
- Use iTunes File Sharing to send compatible files (PDF, Word, Excel®, PowerPoint®, Text, JPEG, PNG, TIFF) to iPrint&Scan for convenient printing at a later time.
- Scan directly to your iPhone/iPod touch/iPad.
- Save scanned images to your photo album, iCloud or Facebook / X / Flickr accounts or send them in an E-mail (PDF, JPEG).
- Print scanned images saved to iCloud from this app.
- Automatically search for supported devices on a local wireless network.
- No computer and no driver required.
*To save scanned images directly to Facebook / X / Flickr, you must first register your accounts on your mobile device.
[Advanced Functions]
(Only available on new models.)
- Edit previewed images using the editing tools (scale, straighten, crop) if necessary.
- Send a fax directly from your mobile device.
(This app feature requires access to the address book of your mobile device.)
- View received faxes stored on your machine on your mobile device.
- The copy preview function enables you to preview an image and edit it if necessary before copying to avoid copy errors.
- View the machine’s status such as ink/toner volume and error messages on your mobile device.
*Compatible functions will depend on the selected device.
[Compatible Print Settings]
- Paper Size -
4" x 6" (10 x 15cm)
Photo L (3.5" x 5" / 9 x 13 cm)
Photo 2L (5" x 7" / 13 x 18 cm)
A4
Letter
Legal
A3
Ledger
- Media Type -
Glossy Paper
Plain Paper
- Copies -
Up to 5
[Compatible Scan Settings]
- Document Size -
A4
Letter
4" x 6" (10 x 15cm)
Photo L (3.5" x 5" / 9 x 13 cm)
Card (2.4" x 3.5" / 60 x 90 mm)
Legal
A3
Ledger
- Scan Type -
Color
Color (Fast)
Black & White
[Access Permission Information]
You must check and allow the essential access permissions below to use Brother iPrint&Scan service.
Essential Permission
• Contact information: access to your contact numbers is needed when you use functions like fax, but you can limit access to the specific contact necessary for the service.
Optional Permission
• Location information: It is requested only when you use device search features like Wi-Fi Direct, Bluetooth, or NFC.
Optional data is required to use the corresponding function, and even if permission is not granted, services other than the corresponding function can be used.
*Compatible settings will depend on the selected device and function.
*Evernote is a trademark of Evernote Corporation and used under a license.
*Microsoft, Excel, and PowerPoint are either registered trademarks or trademarks of Microsoft Corporation in the United States and/or other countries.
*To help us improve the application, send your feedback to Feedback-mobile-apps-ps@brother.com. Please note that we may not be able to respond to individual emails.

bluejetty:00014970:ios.description:
Forty Hadith Qudsi that every Muslim should know.
The hadith qudsi are the sayings of the Prophet divinely communicated to him and the hadeeth summarize the essential teachings of Islam and are the best introduction to the study of the Prophet's Sayings.
This app contains the complete Al Hadith Al-Qudsi with all of its Ahadeeth in English. Read through this app and learn from it! Or refer to it for the specific topic you are looking for.
The hadith summarize the essential teachings of Islam, concentrating on the following areas: affirmation of the doctrine of tawhid and understanding Allah (swt) in all His attributes, the significance of the five pillars of Islam, attainment of virtue, self-sacrifice for the cause of Allah (swt) and preparation for the day of judgement.
Don't just keep this knowledge to your self but share it with your friends and family via Facebook or just send them an email.
FEATURES
------------
* Very fast scrolling to the specific Hadeeth
* Post to Facebook
* Email option
* Elegant Themes

bluejetty:00186504:ios.name: Elephant Games: Kids Puzzles
bluejetty:00186504:ios.summary: Our diverse collection of games keeps kids engaged and motivates them to learn more! We've developed an extensive curriculum that covers number sense and math tasks, tracing letters and numbers, writing words, phonics, interactive reading,
bluejetty:00186504:ios.description:
Our diverse collection of games keeps kids engaged and motivates them to learn more! We've developed an extensive curriculum that covers number sense and math tasks, tracing letters and numbers, writing words, phonics, interactive reading, and more. Curated by experts, the content fosters curiosity, creativity, and confidence in young learners, assisting them as they grow. 
SKIDOS PASS: ALL IN ONE
With the SKIDOS Pass, children explore a safe and age-appropriate space with 1000+ fun and engaging activities, gaining life skills and receiving positive reinforcement for academic success. Parents can create up to 6 personalized profiles for their kids. and customize each according to age, gameplay preferences, and subjects to learn. Monitoring kids' progress is easy - learning reports in the app or via email give you a simple overview of their growth and challenges.
GAMEPLAY:
WAKE UP THE ELEPHANT
It is a cute puzzle game for kids with cool math tasks. Wake the Elephant is an animal puzzle where kids improve their math and logical thinking while playing a fun game!
FEATURES: 
- physics puzzle for kids & adults 
- 110+ funny, logical, and challenging puzzles in different environments
- 5 various worlds with outstanding graphics and music
- cute animals and adorable characters
- kid's friendly interface
- addicting gameplay for learning and playing
- localization into 16 languages!
____
LEARNING CURRICULUM
Our curriculum mixes engaging games with learning content, improving your child's learning skills and promoting active play.
MATH: Our math exercises cover a comprehensive list of topics, including number sense, addition, subtraction, multiplication, division, geometry, and more. Tasks evolve as your child progresses. Interactive design and animations help support learning - three cute SKIDOS mascots will offer assistance, encouraging kids while they work on the assignments.
TRACING LETTERS & NUMBERS: You can pick tracing letters and numbers for your child to practice. A ladybird will show your little learner how to trace with their finger, while visuals and voiceovers teach new words and counting.
READING: Children will be introduced to the world of phonics, sounds, letters, and reading. Interactive designs and smart prompts help kids make their first confident steps toward reading, while storytelling with songs keeps them engaged and curious about new learning journeys.
EMOTIONAL WELLBEING: Through engaging activities, kids learn to understand and express their emotions and nurture positive attitudes.
EDUCATIONAL VIDEOS: Our video content piques kids' curiosity in a fun and easy way. We've curated just the right mix of entertainment & learning in our video catalogue.
SAFE & AD-FREE
SKIDOS ensures an ad-free online environment, providing kids with a positive and uninterrupted learning experience. Our apps are COPPA & GDPR-compliant.
ABOUT THE SKIDOS PASS SUBSCRIPTION:
- We offer monthly, quarterly, bi-annual and annual auto-renewable subscriptions
- Every subscription starts with a 3-day Free Trial
- Payment is charged to your Apple Account only after a free trial period, wherever applicable
- Subscriptions renew automatically unless auto-renewal is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current billing cycle
- The user may turn off the subscription auto-renewal in the user's device Account Settings
- Cancellation goes into effect at the end of the current billing cycle
- Any unused portion of a free trial period will be forfeited when the user purchases a SKIDOS pass, where applicable
Privacy Policy: http://skidos.com/privacy-policy
Terms & Conditions: https://skidos.com/terms/
Support: support@skidos.com

bluejetty:00071150:ios.description:
Welcome to Solitaire TriPeaks: Happy Land, the ultimate solitaire game that guarantees endless hours of fun and brain-teasing entertainment! 
Embark on an exciting journey of card-matching challenges with Solitaire TriPeaks in 2024.
Get ready to explore breathtaking landscapes and conquer challenging levels as you immerse yourself in this amazing and visually stunning solitaire adventure.
-- How to Play --
Tap any card higher or lower one than the bottom visible card to clear all the cards from the board.
For example, if the bottom visible card is a 5, you can tap a 4 or a 6.
There are special solitaire cards which help or disturb, like the BOMB CARD can explode in a certain time, the SPIDER CARD wraps the card in silk and hides it, the WILD CARD can be matched with any card.
And there are also Boosters and Power-Ups to help you overcome obstacles and clear challenging levels.
--- Features --
1. Stunning Visuals
Immerse yourself in the captivating beauty of various landscapes as you progress through the game. From tropical beaches to snowy mountain peaks, each backdrop is handcrafted to provide a visually stunning experience.
2. Unique Power-Ups
Unlock and utilize a variety of powerful boosters and power-ups to enhance your gameplay. Discover hidden treasures, reveal hidden cards, and blast through challenging levels with strategic use of these special abilities.
3. Exciting Challenges
Test your skills and strategy as you tackle increasingly difficult levels. From cascading waterfalls to treacherous caves, each level offers unique obstacles and objectives that will keep you hooked.
4. Daily Bonuses and Rewards
Come back every day to claim your daily bonus and receive exciting rewards. Earn coins, boosters, and other valuable items to help you progress through the game and reach new heights.
5. Play with Friends
Connect with friends through social media platforms and compete against each other on the global leaderboard. Show off your solitaire skills and climb the ranks to become the ultimate TriPeaks champion.
Download Solitaire TriPeaks: Happy Land and Enjoy yourself in the free solitaire tripeaks game!
Please note:
1. Solitaire TriPeaks: Happy Land is a free card game to play, but you can make in-app purchases for additional features and content.
2. Solitaire TriPeaks: Happy Land does not offer real money gambling or an opportunity to win real money.

bluejetty:00131944:ios.name: Hearts: Classic Card Game Fun
bluejetty:00131944:ios.summary:
Welcome to Hearts, an app designed to offer classic card games players the authentic, free hearts card game experience online or offline, on their device of choice!
Among trick-taking games that are not directly related to Bridge or Whist,
bluejetty:00131944:ios.description:
Welcome to Hearts, an app designed to offer classic card games players the authentic, free hearts card game experience online or offline, on their device of choice!
Among trick-taking games that are not directly related to Bridge or Whist, perhaps the foremost one is HEARTS, which is truly one of the greatest card games ever devised for four players, each playing individually. The classic Hearts game can be played in 4, but also in 3 or 5 players. What's the scope of any Hearts card game player? To end up with the lowest score at the end of the cards game.
What's great about our Hearts app?
- It's based on the authentic, offline hearts game play experience
- Clear card game interface, simple hearts gameplay, without distracting elements and additions.
- It's a card game app suitable for both experienced hearts game players and beginners alike (with the option to select slow cards animation).
- Table and cards fronts and backs can be customised to any taste.
- Game statistics are available for players at any moment.
If you haven't tried, but you want to learn how to play Hearts, this card game app is exactly what you need, as it makes it easy for you to get a grip on the hearts game rules in no time.
Here are some hints:
- The player holding the 2 of clubs after the pass makes the opening lead. If the 2 has been removed for the three handed card game, then the 3 of clubs is led.
- Each Hearts player must follow suit if possible. If a player is void of the suit led, a card of any other suit may be discarded. However, if a player has no clubs when the first trick is led, a heart card or the queen of spades cannot be discarded. 
- The highest card of the suit led wins a trick and the winner of that trick leads next. There is no trump suit.
- The winner of the trick collects it and places it face down. Hearts may not be led until a heart card or the queen of spades has been discarded. The queen does not have to be discarded at the first opportunity.
- The queen can be led at any time.
Install and play Hearts today to master this classic hearts game like a pro!
Enjoy playing Hearts? Take some time to leave us your feedback - our players' opinions are always valued. 
We also invite you to play one of our other cards games and decide which is your favorite: Spades, Klondike Solitaire , Spider Solitaire, Pyramid Solitaire, Tripeaks Solitaire, Gin Rummy.
Test your luck and have fun with Hearts!

bluejetty:00064165:ios.description:
In a world where neon warriors clash under glowing lightsabers, survival is everything. Epic Stickman Lightsaber Games throws you into a relentless stickman war filled with ragdoll chaos, ninja battles, and monster duels. Every fight is a legend in the making—do you have what it takes to rise as the ultimate stickman fighter?
The arena is unforgiving. One moment you’re cutting through enemies with blazing neon swords, the next you’re caught in a ragdoll fall, surrounded by warriors and monsters. Precision, timing, and skill are your only allies. Step into the fight, master your combat moves, and prove yourself in the epic neon battlefield.
KEY FEATURES
- Epic Stickman Battles – Face off against ninjas, monsters, and warriors in intense lightsaber combat.
- Neon Visuals – Stunning glowing effects and vibrant stickman duels light up every fight.
- Ragdoll Physics – Every hit, fall, and knockout feels explosive and unpredictable.
- Multiplayer Chaos – Challenge friends in one-screen battles or dominate the arena solo.
- Unlockable Legends – Discover new weapons, characters, and abilities as you fight.
- Free-to-Play Action – Jump in and battle without limits, upgrade through skill or watch ads for rewards.
WHY YOU’LL LOVE IT
If you enjoy high-speed stickman fighting, ragdoll physics, and glowing lightsaber duels, this game is your arena. Every match is different, every battle intense, and every victory feels legendary. Whether you’re a casual player or a hardcore fighter, you’ll find endless excitement in these neon wars.
CALL TO ACTION
Download Epic Stickman Lightsaber Games today and become the stickman legend the arena has been waiting for!

bluejetty:00160965:android.description:
The world-renowned racing competition is about to begin! Fasten your seatbelt, grip the wheel, and drive! Head over to the racetrack to compete!
DRIVING SIMULATION 
It's an exciting experience! You will overcome many different tracks at fast speeds. Tracks include steep slopes, corners, and cliffs. Drive your race car, feel the acceleration, and race until you reach the finish line!
DODGE OBSTACLES 
Pay attention! If a rock suddenly appears in front of you, you must swerve quickly and avoid it! There are also other obstacles that may appear, such as road signs, trains, etc. You'll have to demonstrate your good driving skills in order to avoid them. 
UPGRADE YOUR CAR
Want to drive a more advanced car? Make enough progress and a surprise car will be waiting for you. With beautiful wheels and a shiny body, you'll love it! Keep driving and there will be more upgrades awaiting you!
The driving journey has not ended yet, little racers, enjoy the fun and excitement of driving your car!
FEATURES:
-Play as a racer and experience the excitement of driving!
-Drive on various tracks and have fun like never before!
-Own many beautiful race cars!
-Compete in races and watch the fireworks go off as you cross the finish line!
About BabyBus

At BabyBus, we dedicate ourselves to sparking kids' creativity, imagination and curiosity,and designing our products through the kids' perspective to help them explore the world on their own.
Now BabyBus offers a wide variety of products, videos and other educational content for over 400 million fans from ages 0-8 around the world! We have released over 200 children's educational apps, over 2500 episodes of nursery rhymes and animations of various themes spanning the Health, Language, Society, Science, Art and other fields.

bluejetty:00154497:ios.summary:
Women's Bible – A Devotional and Prayer Companion for Women
Women's Bible is a Bible app designed specifically for women, helping you immerse yourself in God's Word daily, finding comfort, wisdom, and strength. Whether it’s morning prayer,
bluejetty:00154497:ios.description:
Women's Bible – A Devotional and Prayer Companion for Women
Women's Bible is a Bible app designed specifically for women, helping you immerse yourself in God's Word daily, finding comfort, wisdom, and strength. Whether it’s morning prayer, evening reflection, or seeking God's guidance in everyday moments, this app will accompany and support you on your faith journey.
Key Features
Daily Morning and Evening Verses & Prayers Start your day with carefully selected scripture and prayers, guiding you to embrace each morning with faith, hope, and grace. In the evening, reflect on your day with another verse and prayer, feeling God's presence and comfort as you prepare for restful sleep and renewed strength.
A Dedicated Bible Reading Experience More than just a Bible app, Women's Bible creates a reading space designed specifically for women. The elegant and soothing layout enhances your focus on God's Word, making your devotional time more peaceful and immersive. Whether reading alone or sharing in fellowship, you can enjoy uninterrupted spiritual reflection.
Notes & Highlights to Deepen Your Faith Your spiritual journey deserves to be cherished. Take notes at any time to record your thoughts, reflections, and prayers. Highlight meaningful verses so that God's Word takes deeper root in your heart. This feature allows you to create a personal devotional journal, witnessing your faith's growth.
Bookmark Your Favorite Verses When you come across scripture that speaks to your soul, save it with a bookmark for easy access later. Whether you need encouragement during a challenge, reassurance in uncertainty, or joy in moments of gratitude, your bookmarked verses will be ready to inspire you.
Night Mode for a Gentle Reading Experience Many women prefer reading and meditating on scripture at night, which is why Women's Bible offers a night mode for a softer, more comfortable reading experience. Let God's Word be the light that guides your heart, even in the quietest moments.
Share Verses and Inspire Others Faith is not just personal—it is meant to be shared. Easily send inspiring Bible verses to friends and loved ones or post them on social media. Spread the message of love, hope, and encouragement, uplifting those around you.
Bible Quiz – Strengthen Your Understanding This is more than just a quiz—it’s an interactive learning experience. Test your Bible knowledge, deepen your understanding, and strengthen your faith foundation. Whether you're a beginner or a seasoned reader, you'll discover new insights along the way.
Women's Bible is designed to provide women with a nurturing and spiritually enriching Bible app, helping you draw closer to God and deepen your faith. Whether you're seeking a moment of peace in a busy day or encouragement during difficult times, this app serves as a haven for your soul.
Download Women's Bible and let God's Word empower your daily life!
Subscription Service Description:
(1) Service: Unlock all features and enjoy an ad-free experience with our subscription plan.
(2) Pricing:
- $2.99 per month (auto-renewable)
- $26.99 per year (auto-renewable)
(3) Payment: Payment will be charged to your Apple ID account upon confirmation of purchase.
(4) Auto-renewal: The subscription will automatically renew unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours before the end of the current period.
(5) Cancellation: You can manage or cancel your subscription anytime in your Apple ID account settings.
(6) Trial: We do not offer a free trial period.
(7) Privacy Policy: https://kjvbiblenow.com/women/privacy.html

Get closer to Southampton Football Club with the official Southampton FC app. From the latest news and live match updates to digital tickets, exclusive content and interactive games, it's your essential Saints companion – wherever you follow the action.
YOUR MATCHDAY COMPANION
Make the most of every matchday, whether you're at St Mary's or following from afar.
Access your digital match tickets directly in the app.
Follow live scores, team news, match commentary and key moments.
Explore fixtures, results and league standings.
Receive push notifications for breaking news, team announcements and match updates.
DIGITAL TICKETS, MADE SIMPLE

Read the latest club news, interviews and features.
Watch match highlights, exclusive videos and behind-the-scenes content.
Follow the Men's, Women's and Academy teams.
Discover personalised content tailored to your interests.
WATCH AND LISTEN WITH SAINTS PLAY
Get closer to the action with Saints Play, available directly within the app.
Enjoy live audio commentary, live video coverage of eligible fixtures and exclusive video content, wherever you are.
Live streaming availability varies by location, fixture and subscription.
GET INVOLVED AND SHOW YOUR SUPPORT
Supporting Saints is about more than watching football.
Predict the Score and Predict the Line-Up.
Take part in quizzes, polls and competitions.
Compete with fellow supporters and climb the leaderboards.
Enjoy opportunities to win exclusive Saints prizes.
EXCLUSIVE BENEFITS AND OFFERS
Make more of being a Saints supporter.
Access eligible Season Ticket holder benefits and discounts.
Discover offers, experiences and events at St Mary's.
Explore tickets, official merchandise and more.
ONE ACCOUNT. ALL THINGS SAINTS.
Log in with your MySaints account to enjoy a more connected and personalised experience across the club's digital services.
Whether you're cheering from the Northam Stand or following Saints from the other side of the world, the official Southampton FC app keeps you connected to your club.
Download the Southampton FC app today and get closer to the Saints.

bluejetty:00186890:ios.description:
Who said that vacation must be away from home? BabyBus now brings a big vacation area into your room. Let's go! Baby panda’s awesome vacation is about to start!
HOTEL CHECK-IN 
Enter the number of occupancy days , select your bed, pay your deposit, complete the check-in process yourself, learn a new skill with ease.
SEA SURFING
Sharks appear occasionally. Click on the screen, jump and avoid. Can you react quickly? Experience the thrill of surfing the waves. Hang on until the finish!
SANDCASTLE BUILDING
Want to know the secret to build a great sandcastle? Baby Panda's Vacation has all tools and beautiful decorations. Work to design your castle and plan the decoration.Then create the best sandcastle ever with baby panda.
CREATIVE BUFFET 
In Baby Panda's Vacation all the food choices are yours! Make the hot dog as you want. Add cucumber or tomato? Lemon juice or watermelon juice? It’s up to you!
FEATURE:
SEASIDE SENERY: the blue sky, the vast sandy beaches, a luxurious hotel...this is the vacation destination of your dreams;
VACATION GAMES: Sandcastles, surf the waves, hotel check-in, packing-up, buffet, the vacation fun never ends!
TONS OF ITEMS: There are 20+ interesting items, including: shovels, red flags, suitcases, cameras and more! Which one will be your favorite?
NO LIMITS: Design your own sandcastle, there's no rules or restrictions!
EDUCATIONAL VALUE: Simulate vacation activities let you master different skills.

bluejetty:00043724:ios.description:
O aplicativo Trackernet oferece uma solução abrangente e fácil de usar para monitorar e proteger seus veículos em tempo real. Com recursos avançados de geolocalização, você pode acompanhar a localização exata do seu veículo a qualquer momento, garantindo maior segurança e tranquilidade.
Além disso, o aplicativo oferece alertas personalizáveis, permitindo que você seja notificado instantaneamente sobre atividades suspeitas, como movimentos não autorizados ou velocidades acima do limite definido. Com a Trackernet, você pode tomar medidas imediatas para proteger seu veículo contra roubo ou uso indevido.
Nossa plataforma também fornece relatórios detalhados de histórico de viagens, permitindo que você analise o comportamento do veículo ao longo do tempo e otimize rotas e eficiência. Seja para frota de empresas ou veículos pessoais, a Trackernet oferece uma solução completa para manter seus ativos protegidos e sob controle em todos os momentos.

Welcome to Toot Toot Montessori Learning Games for Kids and Toddlers—a fun and interactive 3D educational experience! This engaging app is designed to captivate toddlers and preschoolers with vibrant graphics and exciting games. Through play, children will develop essential skills like shape recognition, color matching, sorting, and shadow matching. Montessori-Based Activities: Following the Montessori approach, our app encourages hands-on learning through interactive play. Children will develop essential cognitive, motor, and sensory skills while having fun, fostering independence and creativity.

bluejetty:00185143:ios.summary:
#1 screen mirroring app to cast your iPhone or iPad to Samsung Smart TV.
Application to mirror the screen of your iPhone or iPad to any Samsung Smart TV. No wires and no additional hardware needed! You can mirror anything from your iPhone
bluejetty:00185143:ios.description:
#1 screen mirroring app to cast your iPhone or iPad to Samsung Smart TV.
Application to mirror the screen of your iPhone or iPad to any Samsung Smart TV. No wires and no additional hardware needed! You can mirror anything from your iPhone or iPad to your Samsung TV.
To mirror video as well as audio, please make sure that you start mirroring when you are in the app (Photos, YouTube, etc.) that you want to mirror to your TV.
Enjoy everything on TV from your iPhone, iPad & Mac.
This works on any Samsung Smart TV from the 2012 models onward. Which model year do you have? You can see that by looking at the middle letter in your model type (on the back of Samsung TV).
E = 2012
F = 2013
H = 2014
J = 2015
K = 2016
M = 2017
N = 2018
R = 2019
T = 2020
A = 2021
B = 2022
C = 2023
Q = QLED (also supported)
For instance:
UE55_E_S8000 = 2012.
UE78_H_U8500L = 2014.
In using the app, there will be a couple of seconds of latency (usually between 1 and 3). So this mirroring & screen casting is not suitable for gaming. 
However, it is very suitable for watching movies, giving presentations, watching photos, and much more!
How the app works:
1. Make sure that your iPhone or iPad is connected to the same local network as your Samsung TV. Don't use multiple VLANs or subnets.
2. Launch the Mirror for Samsung TV app. It will start looking for your Samsung TV(s) on your local network. When you use this app for the first time, depending on your model Samsung TV, the TV might ask you to "allow" the connection. In that case, take your TV Remote Control and press OK to allow the connection from your TV to your iPhone or iPad for airstream.
3. Turn on notifications for this app. We will not spam you, but we will use this to let you know if your TV is working correctly or not. So please, please allow it, otherwise when things don't work as they should, you are left in the dark.
4. Click on Start Mirroring to start mirroring on the TV that is currently selected. After that, you can just go to any other app on your iPhone or iPad and the mirroring just continues to run.
5. To stop mirroring, there are two options. (1) click on the red top bar that you will see on your iPhone or iPad. (2) Go to the Mirror for Samsung TV app and click on Stop Mirroring.
Limitations and known issues:
DRM
Some apps block Screen Mirroring. This means that application developers can choose themselves if they want to block Screen Mirroring, airmirror. For instance, Netflix, Disney and AppleTV+ have decided to block this.
You can purchase the Mirror for Samsung TV Pro Version through an in app purchase.
The Pro Version has the following features:
1. Adds audio to the screen mirroring
2. Provides for free lifetime updates of the app
3. Gives the option to choose higher screen resolutions, like 720p and 1080p

* Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period.
* Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period, and identify the cost of the renewal.
* Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user’s Account Settings after purchase.
* Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication, where applicable.
Our Terms of Use: http://bit.ly/ABTV-TOU21
Our Privacy Policy: https://www.airbeam.tv/privacy-policy/

bluejetty:00073694:ios.description:
Ace Racer is a racing mobile game introducing innovative vehicles with ultimate skills. Experience various actual cars from legendary vehicle manufacturers like Porsche and Nissan, along with our own custom creations. Each vehicle has its own ultimate skills. So, what are you waiting for? Start your engines and experience our own spin on vehicle ultimates along stunning race tracks! Let's race with ultimate skills to feel ultimate thrills.
FEATURES:
[UNIQUE ULTIMATES] Every vehicle has a unique ultimate skill. Flash across walls, transform while driving, and drift at high speeds! Enjoy every drive and make your own rules!
[MULTIPLE FASCINATING TRACKS] Drag to your heart's content in multiple fascinating tracks around the world. Los Angeles, Shanghai, Tokyo, Nevada, and California are all at your fingertips! Speed along beautiful scenery in famous tourist attractions whenever you want!
[COLLECTIONS GALORE] Enhance your garage with iconic collections! Hop in the driver's seat of a Porsche 911, Nissan GT-R, and other real-life luxury rides, along with some of our own creations. Drive 100+ authorized vehicles from more than 25 well-known car manufacturers. Make each ride your own!
[CUSTOMIZABLE VEHICLES] Customize your vehicle with paint, decals, rims, and lights. You can even get your own license plate! Time to ride your way!
[FAST-PACED, EASY RIDES] Enthusiasm is all you need to drive, even if you're new to the game. Each competition is fast-paced with one minute per round! Dig, drift, drag, and drive your way across the finish line. You own the track!
[COOPERATION] Team up with friends and choose to be a Speedster, Supporter, or Interceptor. Let the unique 3v3 match system add even more thrills to your high-speed experience!
To get more information about the game, please follow us: 
Official site: http://www.aceracer-game.com/pre 
Twitter: https://twitter.com/AceRacerNE 
Please contact our customer service at: gameaceracer@global.netease.com if you have any questions.

Become the ultimate hockey general manager in Hockey Legacy Manager 25 (HLM25)! Take control of a professional hockey team and create an enduring legacy. Experience the most immersive mobile hockey manager with features that let you dominate the league for decades!
THE ULTIMATE HOCKEY GM EXPERIENCE
Manage every aspect of your team, from coaching and scouting to drafting and trading. Negotiate contracts and develop players to lead your team to victory.
OFFLINE HOCKEY MANAGER
Play anytime, anywhere - no internet connection required! HLM25 lets you enjoy the excitement of managing your hockey team whenever you want.
UNIQUE CAREER STORYLINES
Follow the evolution of the entire league, witnessing teams rise from declining contenders to rising superstars. Track league records, draft classes, player transactions, and more!
FULLY CUSTOMIZABLE
Customize players, teams, coaches, and leagues! Take control of your hockey universe and shape its future with expansion drafts.
START FROM 1917
Begin your career from the early days of hockey and lead your team through the ages. Make strategic decisions and leave a lasting impact on the league's history.
NEW FEATURES
Hockey Legacy Manager 25 introduces exciting new features to enhance your hockey management experience:
Hall of Fame: Experience the prestige of the Hall of Fame with the new nomination and induction feature. Each team can nominate players based on their career achievements, and witness the celebration of hockey legends!
Three-Team Trades: Make big trades involving three teams to improve your roster and create the best team possible.
Contract Clauses: Handle contract negotiations with new options like No Trade Clauses (NTC) and No Movement Clauses (NMC) to add more strategy.
Inbox: Keep track of team activities and messages with a new inbox feature that shows league news, trade offers, and more.
Player Training: Improve your players’ skills with a new training system that lets you customize their development.
For a complete list of new features, visit: https://hockeylegacymanager.com/
PROLONGED GAMING EXPERIENCE
With Hockey Legacy Manager PRO, you can play for decades and even centuries, experiencing the thrill of hockey management for ages!
Start your General Manager career now and leave your mark on the hockey world! Download Hockey Legacy Manager 25 today!

bluejetty:00018506:ios.description:
The new Piraeus Business app is here!
The new Piraeus Business application has been redesigned to offer you an improved banking experience through a modern, upgraded, friendly, easy-to-use and modern experience.
From the dashboard page you can explore an overview of your recent transactions, transactions for approval and you can also easily initiate a new transaction. Also, you can arrange Online Appointment with your Business Partner in Piraeus Bank. Furthermore, the dashboard page has been enriched with the section Piraeus in the spotlight where you can find propositions that promote your banking relationship.
From the "Deposits" section, you can view a summary of your account balances or a detailed view of your transactions for each account. Selecting an account, you can initiate multiple transactions from the Transact button. In addition, from the section Details you can share the informations of your IBAN account.
From the "Cards" section you can manage your business cards (debit, deposit, credit, and prepaid). You can also view the balances and transactions of your cards, block temporarily a card, loading and unloading prepaid card, manage card limits and much more.
From the "Loans" section you can view important information about business’ loans and financing.
The new Piraeus Business app is designed to meet business needs, and offers functionality and services such as:
- Access of a single user to all the corporations for which he is authorized (Single Sign-On).
- Execute transfers between corporate accounts, transfers within Piraeus Bank (QR code/barcode scanning) or to other banks, bill payments and card payments within Piraeus Bank with Quick Login authentication (4-digit PIN, fingerprint or Face ID for compatible devices).
- Confirmation of Piraeus e-banking transactions.
- Issuing Insurance coupon
- Issuing of e-Administrative Fee
- Remote Signing
- Online Appointment (available to Professionals and Small Businesses)
- Certificates, Applications & Supporting Documents
- Approval of other users' Piraeus e-banking transactions according to the company’s approval schemes.
- Show pending transactions for approval.
- Mass Transaction Approvals
- Reissue Password & Username reminder
Piraeus Business app offers personalized security, with quick and easy access (Quick Login), using a 4-digit PIN, fingerprint or facial authentication (for compatible devices).
In case you have not yet acquired Piraeus e-banking credentials for your access to the Piraeus Business app, please visit any Piraeus Bank branch.
For any information, or assistance in your banking experience, you can contact us through:
- email: supportebanking@piraeusbank.gr 
- Phone: +302103288000

bluejetty:00067935:ios.description:
Embark on an epic journey of strategic conquest in the thrilling world of Merge Towers - Kingdom Defense. This free-to-play masterpiece blends the engaging mechanics of tower merging with the intensity of a kingdom defense strategy. 
BUILD, UPGRADE, MERGE TOWERS
Unleash your creativity and strategic prowess by building, upgrading, and merging towers. Develop an impenetrable defense as you combine different towers to create more powerful and upgraded defenses. This mechanic of Merge Towers - Kingdom Defense encourages strategic thinking and decision-making.
20+ TOWER LEVELS TO MERGE
Explore a vast array of towers, each with its unique abilities and strengths, offering you the flexibility to customize defenses based on different enemy types and challenges. Over 20 tower levels to merge provide you with a sense of accomplishment and the motivation to continuously improve defenses.
CONQUER 10+ MAPS
Confront diverse challenges, enemy types, and environmental factors across more than 10 captivating maps. Each map presents a unique terrain and set of obstacles, requiring you to adapt and refine your tactics for victory. Let's pass all the maps by building and strengthening your troops.
CONNECT AND RACE TO THE TOP WITH FRIENDS
Forge alliances and compete with friends in an exhilarating race to the top of the leaderboards of Merge Towers - Kingdom Defense. Connect with fellow defenders, share strategies, and prove who possesses the superior tactical mind.
EYE-CATCHING GRAPHICS, VIVID SOUND
Immerse yourself in a visually stunning world brought to life by eye-catching graphics. The vivid sound effects enhance the gaming experience, making each tower merge and defense action more exhilarating.
Merge Towers - Kingdom Defense offers a captivating gaming experience where you must not only focus on building an intricate tower defense but also strategically merge towers to unlock their full potential. Use your tactical acumen to navigate through challenging levels, defeat waves of enemies, and become the ultimate defender of the kingdom.
By downloading Merge Towers - Kingdom Defense, you agree to receive future updates through your app store or social network. You can choose to update the game, but opting out may affect your game experience and functionality.

bluejetty:00013728:ios.description:
VerseVIEW Songbook is a simple and easy to use application containing a collection of Christian song lyrics in Malayalam, Hindi, Tamil, Telugu, Bengali and Kannada language spoken in India. Song lyrics can be searched, browsed and bookmarked easily. This application replaces printed songbook and users benefits from readily having the lyrics. 
 Choir members can bookmark and easily access the lyrics during church choir service thus avoiding printing the lyrics each time. 
Features
- Loaded with over 4700 Malayalam, 1000 Hindi, 750 Tamil, 500 Telugu and a collection of Bengali and Kannada Christian Song Lyrics
- Most of the Malayalam lyrics with English transliteration
- Tags for Malayalam songs to quickly access during different situations
- Feature to show lyrics in slide format for quick presentation with screen mirroring
- Over 500 commom Malayalam songs with chord progression
- Key transpose feature with help for Piano and Guitar tabs
- Song list sorted alphabetically
- Search lyrics by title, lyrics, author
- Bookmark lyrics for quick access 
- Set font size for easy readability
- No Ads and no personal logins needed

bluejetty:00081817:ios.description:
Samsung TV Remote Control: Your Ultimate Smart TV Companion
Transform your iPhone into a powerful, intuitive remote for your Samsung Smart TV! Our app brings the convenience of your TV controls right to your fingertips, offering a seamless and enhanced viewing experience.
Key Features:
- TouchPad: Navigate your TV with precision using our responsive and advanced TouchPad. Works with TV navigation, all apps and web browser.
- Precision Control Customization: Adjustable sensitivity settings for both TouchPad and CursorPad for accurate navigation.
- Launch App Hub: Access all your TV's installed apps in one place. Launch any app with a single tap, making it easier than ever to start your favorite content.
- Remote Control: Navigate your TV with ease using our sleek, user-friendly interface. Control volume, change channels, access menus, and more - all from your iPhone.
- Haptic Feedback: Experience satisfying tactile responses with every button press, making navigation more intuitive and engaging.
- Multi-TV Support: Easily switch between multiple Samsung TVs in your home. Perfect for households with several smart TVs.
- Quick Launch Apps: Start your favorite streaming services like Netflix and YouTube with just one tap.
- Media Casting: Share your memories on the big screen! Cast photos and videos directly from your iPhone to your Samsung TV with our simple-to-use interface.
- Customizable Interface: Choose between arrow keys or a dial pad for navigation, tailoring the remote to your preference.
- Power Control: Turn your TV on and off remotely - perfect for those cozy nights when you don't want to leave your bed.
- Advanced Playback Controls: Play, pause, fast-forward, and rewind with dedicated media control buttons.
- No Additional Hardware: Works over your home Wi-Fi network - no dongles or additional hardware required!
Experience the future of TV control today! Transform now the way you interact with your Samsung Smart TV!
Note: Requires your iPhone and your Samsung TV to be connect on the same Wi-Fi network.
* Upgrade to Premium to remove ads and unlock all features, including the Launch App Hub, Touchpad & Media Casting. The Premium subscription costs $3.99 per week.
Information about the auto-renewable nature of the Premium Subscription:
- Your iTunes account will be charged for the subscription, which automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the current period ends. The cost of renewal will be the same as the original subscription price.
- You can manage auto-renewal in your Account Settings at any time. Please note that refunds are not provided for any unused portion of the subscription.
Terms of use: https://reportking.app/remotetvapp/terms.html

bluejetty:00119082:ios.description:
D&R uygulaması güncellendi bi dünya yenilik geldi!
Kitap, müzik ve film tutkunları için özel tasarlanan D&R mobil uygulamamızla alışveriş deneyimini bir adım öteye taşıyoruz! 
Hızlı Arama ve Filtreleme: Aradığınız ürünlere anında ulaşın! Hızlı arama ve gelişmiş filtreleme özellikleri sayesinde istediğiniz ürünü kolayca bulun.
Kişiselleştirilmiş Tavsiyeler: Sizin için seçilen kişiselleştirilmiş önerilerle keşif yolculuğunuz artık daha özel. 
Anında Bildirimler: Kaçırmak istemeyeceğiniz fırsatlar, kampanyalar ve indirimler hakkında anında bildirimler alın. En güncel haberleri kaçırmayın.
İndirim ve Kampanya Takibi: Uygulama içindeki sınırlı süreli indirimleri ve kategoriye özel kampanyaları kaçırmayın. Her an güncellenen fırsatlarla bütçenizi dostça yönetin.
Benim D&R’ım: Kendi okuma listelerinizi oluşturun ve dilediğiniz zaman göz atın. Kişisel kitap arşivinizi yöneterek okuma alışkanlıklarınızı organize edin.
Favori Listesi: En sevdiğiniz ürünleri Favori Listesi'ne ekleyin, istediğiniz zaman göz atın ve hemen satın alın.
Fiyat Alarmı: Belirlediğiniz ürünlerdeki fiyat değişikliklerinden hemen haberdar olun. Fiyat alarmı ile istediğiniz fiyat seviyesine düşen ürünleri kaçırmayın.
Stok Habercisi Listesi: Tükenmek üzere olan ürünleri takip edin. Stok Habercisi ile istediğiniz ürünler tekrar stoklara geldiğinde anında bilgilendirileceksiniz.
Hediye Kartları : Sevdiklerinize özel günlerde hediye kartı ve e-Kitap hediye kartı gönderin. 
Güvenli Ödeme Seçenekleri: Güvenli ödeme seçenekleriyle alışverişinizi daha rahat tamamlayın. Kredi kartı, alışveriş kredisi ve sürekli eklenen ödeme alternatifleri sizleri bekliyor.
D&R mobil uygulamasını hemen yükleyin, Kültür, Sanat ve Eğlence Dünyasına siz de katılın!

ShiftKey users: Get paid instantly¹ and take control of your finances with ShiftKey Wallet, powered by Branch.

Money lands in your account moments after your invoice is approved.¹ You get a digital debit card and business account⁴, without the hassle of minimum balances, credit checks, or monthly account fees.

• Earn cash back rewards for everyday purchases
• Use your ShiftKey Card wherever Mastercard is accepted⁴
• Easily withdraw cash at any of the 55,000+ ATMs in the Allpoint Network²

Start your account setup in the ShiftKey App.

⁴ Banking services are provided by Evolve Bank & Trust, Member FDIC.
