bluejetty:00022395:ios.name: LK - Ableton & Midi Controller
bluejetty:00022395:ios.summary: LK is a flexible remote control application for Ableton Live and MIDI devices, providing a wide range of features and functionality to enhance the production and live performance of electronic music. LK offers tight integration with Ableton
bluejetty:00022395:ios.description:
LK is a flexible remote control application for Ableton Live and MIDI devices, providing a wide range of features and functionality to enhance the production and live performance of electronic music. LK offers tight integration with Ableton Live using our free UBRIDGE desktop application, providing access and control of Ableton Live projects, with both wired and wireless connection options.
LK has extensive MIDI capabilities too, allowing for communication and control of any MIDI compliant software or hardware, even apps running on the same device thanks to virtual MIDI support and AUv3 integration too. LK is split into six unique modules, each available as a separate in-app purchase, offering great value that you can tailor to your specific needs.
LK is also capable of connecting with USB MIDI interfaces which allows you to interact with external gear.
To connect LK to your host computer you will need to download and install a free software utility called UBRIDGE on your computer. It is available for Windows and macOS and it can be downloaded from Imaginando website. See our setup guide for further details in LK’s product page.
MATRIX MODULE
- Live Mode - In Live mode, you can control almost every aspect of Ableton Live directly from LK. The app mirrors your session view, allowing you to launch clips, add tracks and scenes, arm, solo, and mute tracks, and adjust track monitoring, volume, pan, and cue settings on the master track. You can create and edit clips with the powerful built-in clip composer, featuring tools like scales, swing, humanize, horizontal and vertical mirroring, time-shifting notes, pitch swapping, transposing, and even chord and melody generation within a defined range. LK also enables device control within each track, offering a range of generic layouts for quick access and instant parameter adjustments, so you can modify settings without needing to interact directly with your computer.
- MIDI Mode - In MIDI mode, LK enhances workflow with a flexible, independent sequencing environment for streamlined composition and arrangement. Users can create and manage MIDI clips per track, arrange scenes, and send MIDI to other software or hardware. When loaded as an AUv3 in hosts like AUM, LK sequences and coordinates various instruments, perfect for complex setups and live performances. Essential editing tools like signatures, scales and transformative tools simplify MIDI editing, while automation and generative tools enable dynamic compositions. Follow actions and probability settings further smooth transitions, making performance arrangements seamless and spontaneous—all within a single, powerful interface.
PADS MODULE
- Get the MPC feel on your touchscreen with PADS, featuring an arpeggiator and a chorder. When working in Ableton Live mode it automatically maps drum rack pad names to each pad on the app - never miss a pad again. Use it in MIDI mode to quickly play other synth apps.
CONTROLLER MODULE
- Extensive control of 128 parameters with CONTROLLER. Use assignable and customisable knobs, faders, buttons and pads to control MIDI hardware, desktop and mobile DAWs - now with the power of AUv3 integration too.
X/Y MODULE
- Three dimensional parameter tweaking with X/Y PAD. This module can work with CC or NOTE events. In CC mode, a CC can be assigned per axis. In NOTE mode, X is pitch, Y is velocity and Z is Note ON/ Note OFF.
CHORDER MODULE
- Play chords like never before with the CHORDER module. Use this chord generator to build chords and lay them out according to your needs.
KEYBOARD MODULE
- KEYBOARD features 3-axis expression capabilities with scale and range controls. It also allows the possibility of mapping any Live or MIDI CC parameters to be controlled by the X and Y position within each of the keys, providing additional expression to the performance. It also has an MPE mode so you can use it with your favorite MPE compatible synths.

bluejetty:00142902:ios.description:
No more digging for coins. This is how parking should be.
Pay, extend, and manage your parking session with just a few taps. It’s easy!
PAY ON THE GO 
Pay quickly and securely with your smartphone.
- Time's precious, stop wasting it feeding a meter.
- Forget refilling the meter in the rain or braving the cold.
NO PRICE SURPRISES
- Receive email receipts at the end of your parking session.
- Expenses made easy, manage your parking history through the mobile app.
STRESS-FREE PARKING
Get alerts when your parking session is about to end.
- Stop worrying about how much time is left on the meter, we have you covered.
NO NEED TO RUSH
Add time to your parking session directly from your phone.*
- Your plans change, your parking spot shouldn't. Simply extend your parking session via our app.

3. Pay for your parking session from your phone.
4. Relax, welcome to parking as it should be.
--------
COMING SOON
The AHS Parking app is not done yet! We're constantly updating the app based on your feedback.
--------
APP PERMISSIONS
- Location Services (optional): Used to quickly provide nearby parking zones.
* where applicable

bluejetty:00131378:ios.summary:
App loved by 75 million users worldwide

"Connect over time. Grow bonds together."

- Family use
Solve time management issues of double-booking with family members. Ideal a
bluejetty:00131378:ios.description:
App loved by 75 million users worldwide
Winner of the "App Store Best of 2015" award!
"Connect over time. Grow bonds together."
Sharing with TimeTree
- Family use
Solve time management issues of double-booking with family members. Ideal also for planning to pick up the kids and other errands. Carry the calendar with you and check anytime anywhere!
- Work use
Plan work shifts of employees
- Couple use
Perfect for those who have trouble adjusting their time together. See the available slots of both in the calendar and plan out dates!
Key Features
- Shared Calendar
Easy calendar sharing for families, couples, work and other groups.
- Notifications and reminders
Keep up with new events, updates, and new messages. No need to check the app all the time thanks to notifications!
- Sync with a device calendar such as Google Calendar
Start immediately by copying or syncing with your device's other calendars.
- Shared Albums
You can create albums and share photos in each group.
- Memo and to-do lists
Share notes with other members or use memos for events that have no fixed date yet.
- Chat within events
“What time?” “Where?” Discuss event details within the events!
- Web version
Access your calendars also from a web browser.
- Photos in the events
Post details such as images to events.
- Multiple calendars
Create different calendars for multiple purposes.
- Schedule management
Time management app made from the point of view of notebook planner user.
- Widgets
Check your daily schedule easily from widgets without opening the app.
Solve your time management troubles!
- Hard to keep up with my partner's schedule
Do you ever feel uneasy about whether your partner is aware of your schedule? By sharing a calendar in TimeTree, you don't have to contact and confirm with them every time!
- Getting forgetful of various school events and tasks
Keep the printouts from school easily accessible in the app and make those deadlines! Try it out as a diary!
- Miss out on events of your interest
Save artist schedules, movie premieres and other important dates in a calendar and share them with like-minded friends!
TimeTree Official Website
https://timetreeapp.com/
PC(Web) TimeTree
https://timetreeapp.com/signin
Facebook
https://www.facebook.com/timetreeapp/
Twitter
https://twitter.com/timetreeapp
Instagram
https://www.instagram.com/timetreeapp_friends
TikTok
https://www.tiktok.com/@timetreeapp
User Support email
support@timetreeapp.com
Please use TimeTree as a schedule book for the year! We value the opinions of our users. We look forward to hearing your feedback!
This app uses the following permissions. You can still use the app even if you do not allow optional permissions.
- Required permissions
There is none.
- Optional permissions
Calendar: Display device's calendar in TimeTree.
Location information: Improves the accuracy of suggestions when setting a location for an event.
Access to photos: Customize profiles and calendars, and when photos are saved to devices.
Camera: Set and post images to profiles, calendars, etc. using the camera.
Track requests from the app: Display customized advertisement for better experience.
Notifications: Receive notifications about updates, calendar events and activity from the app.
Microphone: Used for the voice input feature.
Speech Recognition: Used for the voice input feature.

bluejetty:00121917:ios.description:
La destination audio de Radio-Canada vous offre tout un monde de contenus en français, 100 % gratuits : vos émissions d’ICI PREMIÈRE, ICI MUSIQUE et des chaînes musicales en direct et en rattrapage; un choix incomparable de balados et livres audio pour toute la famille; des listes musicales et des concerts qui plairont aux mélomanes en tous genres; et plus encore.
Téléchargez l’appli Radio-Canada OHdio pour écouter dès maintenant, et tout à fait gratuitement, les émissions de Radio-Canada ainsi qu’une sélection unique de contenus en français – balados, livres audio, concerts, vidéos, et plus encore.
L’appli Radio-Canada OHdio, c’est aussi une foule de fonctionnalités pensées pour agrémenter l’expérience d’écoute mobile :
• Favoris : mettez un cœur sur vos contenus favoris pour les retrouver facilement, tous au même endroit.
• Reprise d’écoute : poursuivez votre écoute là où vous l’aviez arrêtée.

bluejetty:00151612:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00151612:ios.description:
Jigsawpics Puzzle Gallery — Immersive Eastern Imperial Artifact Exhibition
Step into a treasure-filled world of ancient Eastern palaces! In JJigssawpics Puzzle Gallery, you will flip, slide, match, and assemble pieces to restore magnificent artifacts that carry centuries of history. This game beautifully blends the thoughtful challenge of traditional jigsaw puzzles with smooth card-swiping mechanics, while hidden stories on the back of each card reveal fascinating historical insights—offering a cultural journey that is both peaceful and intellectually engaging, merging memory skills with rich heritage.
How to Play:
- Just press and drag any cards anywhere
- Match & connect pieces to finish the puzzles
- Observe every details and plan your moves wisely to clear the board
Key Features:
- HD Artifacts: Porcelain, jade, calligraphy, bronze ware, and more—premium visuals bring Eastern palace treasures to life
- Satisfying Restoration: Experience the joy of piecing together multiple fragments into complete objects, just like a real conservator
- Hidden Historical Facts—Each card back holds a story or detail, creating a rewarding memory challenge that also educates
- No Time Limits, No Pressure—A relaxing experience suitable for all ages and skill levels
- Gradual Depth: Start with single artifacts and progress to full exhibition halls, with increasing complexity for seasoned players
- Unlock Themed Galleries: Ceramics Hall, Clock & Watch Pavilion, Painting Gallery… keep your journey fresh and inspiring
Perfect For:
- Fans of jigsaw puzzles, card-matching, and historical puzzles, or anyone who enjoys a creative blend of culture and gameplay
- Players looking for a relaxing yet deeply rewarding pastime with a sense of accomplishment
- Those who appreciate beautiful visuals and want to engage their minds while exploring Eastern imperial artistry
Jigssawpics Puzzle Gallery is more than a game—it’s a hands-on restoration of history, a moment of mindful calm, and a celebration of timeless Eastern craftsmanship. Flip, slide, and connect exquisite artifact fragments to feel the warmth of history and complete your own cultural exhibition, one gentle tap at a time.
Download now and join a global community of puzzle and culture lovers in this beautifully crafted fusion of jigsaw challenge and historical discovery!

bluejetty:00185087:ios.description:
INTRODUCING THE ALL-IN-ONE PRETEND PLAY APP FOR KIDS! Set your imagination free and explore the airport town, princess town, stone age town, animal town, space town, fairy town, and much more. You get all your favorite locations in one awesome town to play and explore!
With loads of activities and so much to discover, this app is one destination for all your entertainment. Finding it difficult to decide which role should you play? Well, we have a bunch of great & exciting games of you like: 
1. Stone Age Town
Go back in time and live just like how humans lived in ancient times.
2. Animal Town
It's a fun world of jungle adventure where you can touch, tap and interact with every single item in these best pet games. 
3. Space
We are going to the moon. Are you ready, our young astronauts, for the challenges ahead? Let the adventures begin! 
4. Fairy Land
There is lots of fairies and magic in this town. Make new fairy friends and ride on the unicorns. 
5. Princess Castle
Now you can be a princess in your very own doll house. Explore the huge castle and play pretend!
6. Tizi City
Go shopping with your friends in the city shopping mall or workout in the city gym. Explore many things now!
7. Pirate Town
Adventure in the Pirate Town awaits for you. Join us in this breath-taking experience. Play now!
8. Underwater Village
Dive into the water to begin exploring the ocean, where you will find marine animals, mermaids and more! There are so many things in the ocean that are worth exploring!
9. Monster Town 
Play with the monsters and explore the monster town. Have fun playing in the monster movie theater, kitchen and playground. Get exciting surprises by tapping on different monster objects. 
There are many more games in this app that you can play and have endless hours of fun. 
Key Features of My Tizi World are:
- 9 islands with exciting locations.
- Play with fun characters.
- Touch, drag and explore every object and see what happens!
- Kids friendly content without violence or scary treatments
- Made for kids of ages 6-8, but everyone will enjoy playing this game.
Are you ready to explore each and every town in this Tizi World? Get started now by downloading this app!

bluejetty:00046937:ios.summary: Mobile Legends: Adventure-idle is an idle strategy RPG that can be fit perfectly into a busy daily schedule. Embark on the adventure with 100+ unique heroes, to reveal the truth behind a horrifying prophecy and save the Land of Dawn from de
bluejetty:00046937:ios.description:
Mobile Legends: Adventure-idle is an idle strategy RPG that can be fit perfectly into a busy daily schedule. Embark on the adventure with 100+ unique heroes, to reveal the truth behind a horrifying prophecy and save the Land of Dawn from destruction!
++ IDLE & AUTO-BATTLE ++
Heroes battle automatically to gather resources while you idle! Evolve heroes, upgrade gear, and deploy your squad to fight the evil clones with just a few taps. Say no to grinding—play anytime, anywhere for just 10 minutes a day to gradually strengthen your team!
++ LEVEL UP WITH EASE ++
Trying to build multiple lineups but running short of resources? Save time and effort with level transfer and level sharing features to instantly level up your new heroes!
++ BATTLE STRATEGY ++
Build powerful team compositions in strategic ways to deal with difficult bosses and other players. Use clever tricks to maximize bonus effects for your lineup and solve fun puzzles and mazes!
++ ENDLESS GAME MODES ++
Explore the main storyline, challenge dungeons, go on bounty quests, battle your way to the top of the Tower of Babel... Unlock even more exciting free features as you progress. Constantly updated events and new heroes will keep you hyped!
++ GLOBAL PvP BATTLES ++
Compete with Adventurers from around the world with your strongest hero lineup. Form a Guild with your friends, upgrade facilities, and fight for your Guild's glory!
++ COLLECT HEROES & UNLOCK STORIES ++
MLA is a role-playing game based off the Mobile Legends: Bang Bang (MLBB) universe, so you will see familiar faces from MLBB redesigned with a 2D anime art style. Pull gachas to collect all of your favorite MLBB heroes, and unlock their exclusive stories in this new adventure!

bluejetty:00041871:ios.summary: Welcome to the Kids Construction Game, an app designed for our little engineers who love playing with vehicles and trucks, where they can repair damaged roads and build a house. Are you ready to become a master builder and fixer? Grab your
bluejetty:00041871:ios.description:
Welcome to the Kids Construction Game, an app designed for our little engineers who love playing with vehicles and trucks, where they can repair damaged roads and build a house. Are you ready to become a master builder and fixer? Grab your hat now, because we have tons of exciting truck games, builder games, and 3D games for you to play.
In the Construction Game, you'll get to use your creativity and problem-solving skills to build amazing structures and fix damaged infrastructure. You'll get to drive cool construction vehicles and use special tools to lay down roads, build buildings, and fix broken pipes.
The city is in an emergency. Traffic is at a halt! You need to rescue the vehicle stuck in potholes. Drive a tow truck to the incident street and skillfully rescue the vehicle from the pothole. Good job! you did it! Now time to repair the damaged road.
Are you ready to become a road construction expert? In the Road Construction game, you'll be in charge of repairing damaged roads and constructing new ones. You get to drive cool construction vehicles like bulldozers, cement mixers, and road rollers and use them to make the roads smooth and safe for everyone to use.
Arrive at the construction site in your construction vehicles and inspect the damage and decide how to fix it. Need to lay down new asphalt, fill in potholes, or smooth out rough patches? You'll have the tools you need to fix it quickly and efficiently. 
Next, play the Building Construction game! Here, you can build your own house by using bricks, rebars, and cement. You'll be in charge of designing and constructing buildings or the coolest house in the neighbourhood. With endless possibilities, your imagination is the only limit in these 3D games!
Pick the perfect spot for your building in this build a house game. Then, it's time to start building! Drive the excavator truck to the spot and start digging the pit for the house building. You'll get to use all kinds of cool tools and materials in this builder game to bring your vision to life. 
Calling all plumbing experts! Check out the amazing Pipe Repair game. Here, you'll be tasked with fixing broken pipes beneath the road. Arrive at the site in your construction truck and inspect the area and figure out where the problem lies. Once you've located the broken pipes, it's time to get to work!
And that's not all! We're constantly adding new and exciting games to the Construction Game app, so stay tuned for more challenges and adventures. Whether you're into building, repairing, or designing, there's something for everyone in this amazing kids construction trucks game.
Our build a house games, truck games, and builder games feature stunning graphics and intuitive gameplay that will keep you engaged for hours on end. The app is perfect for kids of all ages who love to create, imagine, and explore. With a variety of games like construction vehicles game, builder games, and 3D games to choose from, you'll never get bored, and you'll always be learning something new.
Subscription Details:
-Payment will be charged to the Apple Account at confirmation of purchase.
-Cancel subscription renewal anytime under Subscriptions in your App Store Settings.
-Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renewal is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
-No cancellation of the current subscription is allowed during an active subscription period.
Privacy Policy: http://www.kidlo.com/privacypolicy.php
Terms of service: http://www.kidlo.com/terms_of_service.php
If you need help or have any feedback, email us at support@kidlo.com
So what are you waiting for? Download the Construction Game app today and start building, repairing, and constructing these amazing builder games for kids.

bluejetty:00068764:ios.description:
Metapho is a powerful tool for photo enthusiasts who want to take care of their photo metadata.
• Viewing Metadata •
- Browse all your photos in iCloud Photo Library
- See essential EXIF data of a photo
- Get photo location and lens direction on the map
- View raw metadata in dictionary format, which can be copied to the clipboard
- Apply filters to your library, such as favorites, location-ness, and creation dates
• Editing Metadata •
- Safe Share: Remove geotag and personal data before sharing
- Remove Metadata: Erase/Restore metadata without duplication
- Date Edit: Change the date and time of a photo
- Location Edit: Add or change geolocation data of a photo
- Batch Operation: Edit multiple items' metadata at once
- Multiple Exporting Options: Save as a new copy or replace the original with a new version
• Files Support •
- Open photo files or folder in Files app, with open in-place feature
- Remove or change image metadata of files directly with editing in-place
- Read and write items in folders shared by the Files app, such as iCloud Drive, external storage, SMB server, and more
Metapho also supports HEIC, DNG, CR2, NEF, 3FR, Live Photos, and videos.
• Pricing •
Metapho requires a subscription or one-time purchase. Yearly subscription comes with a free trial. An active subscription or one-time unlock lets you use the app on Mac, iPhone, and iPad.
Metapho Action app extension lets you check the metadata of a photo and export the file without metadata, from anywhere iOS share sheet is available, such as Messages, Files, and Photos.
Read more about our terms and conditions here:
https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Read more about our privacy policy here:
https://zininworks.com/privacy

bluejetty:00169178:ios.description:
Ladies and gentlemen, welcome to the weirdest, wackiest, and most fantastic game show in the universe! Introducing our cast: LADY FEROCIOUS, REGINALD STARFIRE, BOAT HEAD, MR. SHIGOTO, and least of all our most promising contestant yet… YOU!
A CLASSIC REMADE
Super Monsters Ate My Condo is back for a second helping… again! The BAFTA-nominated chaotic action puzzle game makes its glorious return to mobile with updated visuals and original unforgettably addictive gameplay.
The objective is simple — swipe to feed condos to insatiable monsters! Match the correct coloured condos together and score points and create combo condos which can be matched even further to pull off insane score streaks. Feed the wrong condos to the wrong monster too many times and they will become enraged and will topple over the tower — game over! 
Push for high scores by feeding as many combo condos to the monsters as you can, and activate their special abilities to shake up the gameplay and earn crazy multipliers. With only two minutes on the clock, combine quick thinking with strategy to plan your moves carefully to get the highest score while aiming to keep the tower from toppling down!
Key features:
- Fast-paced match-3 style gameplay.
- Compete on a global leaderboard.
- Complete daily goals and earn coins.
- Gain star power to unlock rewards. 
- Meet a hilarious cast of quirky monsters.
- Unlock and collect hats for your monsters.

bluejetty:00120327:ios.description:
+++ This game includes full access - no additional purchase is required 
An engaging pair matching game for practicing basic concepts and enhancing visual perception skills with the added value of learning about different environments relevant for children's early development. 
A beautiful educational game for toddlers.
About the game
----------------
Explore beautifully illustrated environments and practice basic concepts in this engaging pair matching game aimed for children aged 3 and up. Practice essential basic concepts while matching pairs by colour, shape, logic and attention to details. 
This fun game is also designed to help children develop higher skills such as categorical thinking and task persistence. 
Game features:
---------------
- Easy and intuitive: Toddlers can play this game independently.
- Narration helps to learn new words and concepts as well as understanding instructions
- No stress or time limits.
- Safe environment for your kids (girls & boys). No Ads
- Enjoyable and educational.
Educational targets:
- Practice visual perception concepts.
- Establish Motor skills such as Hand-eye coordination.
- Practice Visual Attention. 
- Explore environments relevant for child development
- Basic categorical thinking.
 - Practice task persistence. 
The game consists of 12 engaging environments, each containing a matching challenge.The boards were CAREFULLY CHOSEN in order to practice and advance early learning concepts and skills. Your child will visit many different unique environments that spark the curiosity and imagination and make learning a fun experience.
Game Boards:
- Fish: Match fish to their homes by COLOR
- Ferris wheel: Match animals based on RESEMBLANCE
- Astronauts: Match astronauts based on SHAPE
- LOCKS: Match keys to locks based on SHAPE
- UMBRELLAS: Match patches to umbrellas based on SHAPE and COLOR
- FARM: Match farm objects based on LOGIC
- FLOWERS: Match butterflies to flowers based on COLOR COMBINATIONS
- Skateboard ramp: Match tools based on SILHOUETTE
- SHOES: Match shoes based on TYPE and COLOR
- WHEELS: Match wheels to vehicles based on LOGIC
- BATH: Match hiding animal based on DETAILS 
- ORCHESTRA: Match musical instruments based on OUTLINE

bluejetty:00095532:ios.description:
Unlock the Mysteries of History – One Coin at a Time.
Imagine holding a piece of ancient civilization in your hands – a coin that once passed through the markets of Rome, the temples of Greece, or the palaces of Byzantium.
With our groundbreaking app, you're no longer just a collector; you're a time traveler, an archaeologist, and a savvy investor all in one. 
This isn't just another coin identification tool. 
Our proprietary technology combines advanced AI recognition with an extensive numismatic database, offering you an experience that's as close to having a personal coin expert in your pocket as possible. 
While other apps might recognize modern currency, we specialize in bringing ancient coins to life – revealing their stories, values, and secrets with unprecedented accuracy. 
Whether you're holding a common Roman denarius or a rare Greek drachm, our app transforms every coin into a captivating historical artifact. 
The thrill of discovery awaits – no magnifying glass or dusty reference books required. 
Advanced Features for Modern Collectors:
Our app transforms coin collecting through innovative technology. 
The instant identification system doesn't just match patterns - it examines metal composition, surface wear, and patina to recognize even damaged or incomplete coins with exceptional accuracy.
For valuations, we go beyond estimates. Our system actively compares your coins against live auction data, dealer pricing, and collector market trends to deliver trustworthy, current market values.
Every identified coin includes comprehensive historical documentation: the minting era and its historical background, rarity assessments, plus cultural and artistic context about its design and significance.
We've designed the experience for all collector levels. Beginners enjoy straightforward identification, while experienced numismatists can access deeper cataloging functions. 
All users benefit from our strict privacy protections - your collection data stays completely private with military-grade encryption, automatically backed up to prevent any loss of your valuable records.
The interface adapts to your expertise level while maintaining intuitive operation throughout, making professional-grade analysis accessible to every collector.
Join the Digital Revolution in Numismatics! 
Download now and experience the future of coin collecting. Your next ancient treasure is waiting to be discovered – will you be the one to uncover its story? 
Premium Subscription:
- Charged to iTunes account 
- Auto-renews unless canceled 24+ hours before period ends 
- Manage in Apple Account Settings 
- Free trial forfeited if subscribing early 
Cancel anytime. Terms apply.
Terms Of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

The SRP Power mobile app for residential customers is a friendlier and faster way to pay your bill and manage your account. Whether you’re at home or on the go, accessing your SRP account is as easy as reaching into your pocket.
Key Featur
bluejetty:00061711:ios.description:
The SRP Power mobile app for residential customers is a friendlier and faster way to pay your bill and manage your account. Whether you’re at home or on the go, accessing your SRP account is as easy as reaching into your pocket.
Key Features:
Daily Cost and Usage: See a snapshot of your energy costs and usage by the hour, day or month. If you’re enrolled in a Time-of-Day plan, you can even see how much energy you’ve used during on-peak and off-peak hours to optimize your savings.
Payments: View your balance and make payments quickly and securely from anywhere. Save payment information and even schedule future payments. If you’d like to make an in-person cash payment, you can access your digital cash payment card through the app.
Report and View Outages: When your power goes out, report it quickly and get estimated restoration times. You can also use the interactive outage map to see areas out of power along with the cause and number of customers affected.
Stay informed: Get push notifications that let you know about updates to your bill or payments, or power outages in your area.
Use your SRP My Account login to access the SRP Power app. Not signed up for My Account? No worries. You can register using your SRP account.
Note: Depending on your price plan, some features may not be available with this release.

Get ready for an exciting and brain-teasing adventure in Sort Dash: the ultimate color-sorting puzzle game! 
In this exciting puzzle game, your goal is simple: collect, match, and sort colorful cards as you progress through masterfully designed levels filled with obstacles and surprises. 
But don’t be fooled - it’s harder than it looks! Strategic decisions and thinking ahead are the keys to success.

- Avoid wrong colors and manage your limited space wisely to stay in the game.
- Organize and clear all cards to win before time runs out.
- Complete levels to unlock new stages, challenges, and rewards!
Why You’ll Love Sort Dash:
- Addictive gameplay that’s easy to learn but challenging to master
- Bright, colorful graphics and satisfying sorting mechanics
- Tons of unique levels and tricky obstacles
- Fun power-ups and boosters to help you dash ahead
- Perfect for fans of color games, challenge seekers, and puzzle fun!
- Simple to play, tough to master – perfect for quick sessions or deep runs
Whether you want a quick game session or a longer puzzle-solving challenge, Sort Dash offers endless fun and replayability.
Download Sort Dash now and test your speed, strategy, and sorting skills!

bluejetty:00180023:ios.name: G1 Test Canada Driving License
bluejetty:00180023:ios.summary:
Read, Learn, Practice and Pass your Driving Exams. A must have app for all road users that helps you to search for rules you missed and improve your driving skills.
Drivio Canada offers an advanced test system to your iPhone offering 2500+
bluejetty:00180023:ios.description:
Read, Learn, Practice and Pass your Driving Exams. A must have app for all road users that helps you to search for rules you missed and improve your driving skills.
Drivio Canada offers an advanced test system to your iPhone offering 2500+ practice questions. With this application you will make progress more quickly than with any other traditional method, as you can take the tests wherever and whenever you want: at the bus stop, in the classroom, at work or at the dentist’s waiting room!
APP FEATURES:
- Intelligent learning system
- Keep a track of your driving lessons, save your lessons, add times and dates, traffic conditions, notes and lesson costs
- Road rules theory of all Canadian Provinces - Test your knowledge with 2500+ questions 
- We randomize questions and answers each time you start a practice test
- Statistics module to track and monitor your progress
- Flashcards
- Search theory content
- Add pages to bookmark
- No internet connection required once installed
The application is divided into the following sections:
# Road rules theory: You can study the official online guides containing all states's traffic laws, traffic signs and regulations.
Included Canadian Provinces:
• Ontario
• Quebec
• British Columbia
• Alberta
• Manitoba
• Saskatchewan
• Nova Scotia
• New Brunswick
• Newfoundland and Labrador
• Prince Edward Island
In this section you will learn about:
- Licence types
- Road safety
- Safe driving
- General road rules
- Traffic signs
- Penalties
- and much more.
 # Practice:
Test your knowledge by practicing.
This section have 8 already prepared mock theory tests, all test are created based on 10 categories, these are:
- General Knowledge
- Alcohol and Drugs - Fatigue and Defensive Driving
- Intersections
- Traffic Lights / Lanes - Negligent Driving
- Pedestrians
- Seat Belts / Restraints - Speed Limits - Traffic Signs
# Flashcards:
This section contains 1500 questions, that helps your to memorize better all theory questions. If you have doubts about your answer just tap on the card to see the right answer. Swipe left or right to see next question.
# Progress Monitor:
The application saves the result of each test answered and a history of failures and successes. At the end of the test, you can check your answers and learn from your mistakes.
Disclaimer
This handbook is not intended to be used as a legal document. It is intended as a guide only, and its aim is to set out, in simple form, the main legal requirements in Canada that a driver is required to observe in everyday driving, as well as other useful information for drivers.
Premium subscription required for unlimited access to premium features and ad-free experience.
Terms and conditions - https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy - https://www.appnursery.com/privacy/

bluejetty:00093760:ios.description:
Acompanhe todas as suas entregas em um único lugar! Com o Rastreador de Encomendas, você centraliza os detalhes do rastreio, recebe alertas das atualizações e sabe exatamente por onde andam as suas compras.
Principais Funcionalidades:
Cobertura Gigante: Rastreamento unificado para Correios, Mercado Livre, Shopee, AliExpress, J&T Express, Loggi, Latam Cargo, Azul Cargo, Jadlog, DHL, FedEx, SSW e centenas de outras transportadoras nacionais e internacionais.
Atualização e Notificações: O app busca as movimentações de forma automática ao longo do dia e envia alertas no seu celular para que você não precise checar a todo momento.

Informações Importantes:
Privacidade e Acesso: Dependendo da transportadora, pode ser necessário informar dados adicionais (como CPF/CNPJ ou CEP original) para que o sistema libere a consulta do rastreio.
Aviso de Transparência: O Rastreador de Encomendas não é uma empresa de logística ou transportadora. Nosso aplicativo funciona como um organizador inteligente que apenas coleta e exibe os dados públicos de rastreio fornecidos pelos sites oficiais de cada transportadora.

• Create professional location reports

• Business & Logistics - Track and share delivery or meeting locations
• Photography & Content Creation - Geotag photos with accurate location data
Privacy & Security
• All location data stays on your device
• No tracking or data collection
• Full control over your location information
Customization Options
• Choose between metric and imperial units
• Light, dark, or automatic theme selection
• Export data in your preferred format
Professional Features
• High-precision coordinate sharing
• Multiple export formats (KML, text, images)
• Weather integration for complete location context
• Offline functionality - works without internet connection
Perfect for professionals who need to:
• Share precise locations with colleagues or clients
• Document field work with accurate coordinates

bluejetty:00172088:ios.name: AnchorQueen
bluejetty:00172088:ios.summary:
Plan a Route. Analyze Marine Weather.Ride it. Replay it. Set Anchor Alarm at anchorages. Explore and Discover awesome Bays and hidden secrets. 
AnchorQueen is built for the whole day on the water — Sea Sports on iPhone and Apple Watch, off
bluejetty:00172088:ios.description:
Plan a Route. Analyze Marine Weather.Ride it. Replay it. Set Anchor Alarm at anchorages. Explore and Discover awesome Bays and hidden secrets. 
AnchorQueen is built for the whole day on the water — Sea Sports on iPhone and Apple Watch, offline S-52 charts when you cruise, and an AI co-captain that keeps anchor watch while you rest. One app from the first jump to the last swing at anchor.
SEA SPORTS THAT FEEL ALIVE
Press and hold Voyage. Pick jet ski, kitesurf, wingfoil, surf, dinghy, kayak, SUP, canoe, rowing, swimming, freediving — 17 sports in all. Live numbers on the chart. Every jump, wave, tack, and stroke. Personal bests. Wind at the moment it happened. Then a 3D Trackcam replay you can orbit like a film set. Start from your wrist; Apple Watch sessions are saved to the Apple Health app as workouts and sync back into your passages.
SHARE THE DAY IN 3D
Turn a sport session, a coastal hop, or a quiet anchorage into a cinematic 9:16 reel on device. Sunny day or miniature tilt-shift. Share to Instagram, WhatsApp, YouTube, or Photos — with a link friends can spin in 3D.
CHARTS YOU CAN TRUST OFFSHORE
Nautica Day and Nautica Night S-52 IHO vector charts: soundings, buoys, lights, hazards, six day/night depth palettes. Download a region once and keep sailing when the cell signal dies. Charts refresh on Wi‑Fi only — never over mobile data, and never while anchor watch or guidance is running.
ROUTE SMART. PADDLE SAFE.
Long-press a destination for depth-safe routing matched to your draft. Live bearing, SOG, XTE, and fuel burn by vessel class. Shore-hugging paddle routes for kayak, SUP, canoe, and rowing keep you out of shipping lanes.
AIS, WEATHER, AND THE SHIP'S JOURNAL
Live AIS with COLREGS-aware warnings. Blended marine forecasts — wind, gusts, waves, tides, 7-day meteograms — with shoreline-aware pins. Your Ship's Journal sketches the day: distance made good, track, key moments, jump to any date.
JULES STANDS THE WATCH
Drop the hook. Jules separates normal swing from real drag and only wakes you for danger. An OS-level geofence keeps guard even if iOS closes the app. Ask Jules in plain language for tide windows, anchorage ratings, and route briefings — it already sees your wind, depth, and position.
CHARTER WITHOUT LEAVING THE CHART
Browse charter fleets on the map, compare boats, and watch 30-day price trends before you commit.
FOLLOW THE RACE
Regatta follows the big offshore races for free: live standings by line honours or corrected time, race news, split times at every mark, and the official course drawn on the chart. Tap a yacht to ride along in Live 3D with a chase camera, every boat drawn as its class in team colours. Your area's chart is free too: the first download brings 14 days of full access.
WHY BOATERS SWITCH
• Sea Sports + Watch recording most chart apps never touch
• True offline S-52 navigation and depth-aware routing
• AI anchor alarm that respects your sleep
• 3D reels and sea state that make the day shareable
Unlike typical chartplotter apps, AnchorQueen is built for both the adrenaline run and the quiet night on the hook.
PLANS
• Free — Anchor alarm, offline navigation, standard marine weather
• PRO — Jules, 3D sea state, passage reels, Sea Sports tools, advanced charts (1-month free trial)
• MAX — Unlimited offline regions, maximum Jules capacity
Monthly or discounted annual. Price shown before you buy.
—
Subscriptions renew unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the period ends. Charged to your Apple Account at confirmation. Manage or cancel in App Store Account Settings anytime.
Terms of Service: https://anchorqueen.com/terms
Privacy Policy: https://anchorqueen.com/privacy

bluejetty:00177650:ios.description:
You like fun arcades and endurance races? Like playing online with other players? Then welcome to Do Not Fall .io! Here you will find a lot of fun and a huge devastating arena! 
Your task is to stay as long as possible and not fall. But you're not the only one in this arena. You have 20 enemies and you have to beat them all! To become a champion, you need to be the last one in the arena that's always destroying right under your feet! Stay as long as you can and don't fall! 
The rules have never been so simple: just jump on the platforms and don't fall down. The one who fell – lost. The last survivor becomes the winner! Handle it? 
GAME FEATURES: 
- Simple and fun game 
- Interesting gameplay 
- Easy controls 
- Beautiful graphics 
- Realistic object physics 
- Intuitive interface 
Do Not Fall .io will give you many exciting moments together with a ton of vivid impressions. And all of this is completely free! So what are you waiting for? Install the app and join the game!

bluejetty:00121465:ios.summary:

Immortal Taoists is a XianXia novel-converted idle game where individual cultivators can seek immortality through cultivation in a peaceful relaxing fantasy world. Players, as protago
bluejetty:00121465:ios.description:
Excellent Xianxia fiction-converted idle game in 2025! 
Immortal Taoists is a XianXia novel-converted idle game where individual cultivators can seek immortality through cultivation in a peaceful relaxing fantasy world. Players, as protagonists, have full freedom to explore their own unique immortal journeys and create their own wonderful life legends in this playable novel game. Joining various immortal sects, learning martial skills, adopting spiritual beasts, fighting against evil demons, or socializing with other like-minded cultivators-you name it-all are different cultivation methods and rich gameplays available and await for cultivators to choose, discover and enjoy!
 ----------------------
Immortal Taoists - Realize your dream of cultivation, a playable fantasy novel!
Wait, Taoist, the idle adventure game Immortal Taoists adapted from the popular fantasy cultivating novel is officially launched. Welcome to join the Facebook "Immortal Taoists" group, let us enter the real and interesting world together!
=======Game Features=======
■Unparalleled Kungfu Skills
In this game, you will learn many different kinds of unparalleled Kungfu techniques, and a myriad of elemental, psychic, and physical spells!
■Great Treasures
In the Universe of Cultivation, spiritual energy fills the lands which teem with mystical treasures, rare herbs, magical talismans, and even the fabled immortality elixir! Take what you find and craft powerful equipment, and refine powerful elixirs.
■Fortunate Destinies
Do you want to be like the heroes in Wuxia novels? Live out your fantasy, whether seeking artifacts in the deep mountains or cultivating in the temple's peaceful serenity, there are countless good fortunes to be discovered! Even a seemingly poor beggar could be an ageless hermit waiting to offer you immortality with powerful spells. Make your choices and discover your destiny.
■Martial Sects
You can experience the many different Martial Sects in the world, make your choice and discover the stories of different sects. It doesn’t matter whether you are good or evil, a cultivator's ultimate goal is to reach immortality regardless of means.
■Find your companion
The path of a cultivator can be a lonesome one, so wouldn't it be wonderful to find a lifelong companion? Someone who is always with you and walks the path of cultivation by your side. It is very difficult for those who walk this path to find true love, so please treasure the strings of fate that bring people together.
#wuxiaworld #overmortal #xianxia
Your immortal destiny is here, let's cultivate together!
Check our Facebook page/discord to get more rewards and guides!
Facebook： https://www.facebook.com/com.immortaltaoists/
Discord：https://discord.gg/AWaevAS

Prizmo is the most capable scanner app for iPhone & iPad to create stunning scans of documents or process business cards from photos. Prizmo offers an efficient capture workflow, powerful editing capabilities, a choice of highly accurate OCRs, text-to-speech & accessibility features, searchable PDF & DOCX exports, and comprehensive automation, all packaged in an elegant & intuitive user interface.
Prizmo will be your trusted mobile scanner, always at hand.
*** Featured in an Apple Keynote presentation ***
"Prizmo is a remarkably deep app that includes a myriad of other features." 
— John Voorhees (MacStories)
"When it comes to mobile scanner apps, Prizmo 5 is unmatched for its fast, streamlined workflow and high-quality scans." 
— J.R. Bookwalter (MacWorld)
PHOTO CAPTURE
• Capture workflow tailored for speed: in just 3 taps, have your document scanned, cleaned up, cropped, and text-recognized to a multi-page PDF right into your cloud
• Highest quality scans: up to 300+ DPI
• State-of-the-art page detection
• Autoshoot
• Quality review: keep or reshoot
• Innovative stabilization
• Multi-page support
TEXT RECOGNITION
• Reliable & accurate on-device OCR with machine learning in 30 languages(*)
• High-performance Cloud OCR in 139 languages(*) + handwriting recognition
• Fine-grained OCR editing: text & regions, binarization, text polarity
• Structural analysis with CoreML
• Background processing
ENHANCE, EDIT & EXPORT
• Adjust rotation, perspective crop, cleanup mode (black/white, color, gray), brightness & contrast, edge repair
• Flattening of curved contents (books & magazines)
• Powerful non-destructive editing: original photo can always be reprocessed from scratch without reshooting
• Export formats: searchable PDF, Microsoft Word DOCX with original layout, TXT, PNG, JPEG
• Advanced PDF options: password protected PDF, efficient compression formats
(customizable JPEG quality, CCITT G4, JBIG2) to generate small files
• Auto Upload: PDFs are automatically sent to your cloud (iCloud, Dropbox, OneDrive, WebDAV)
• Export business cards to Contacts or as vCard
• Smart actions: interact with detected phone numbers, dates, locations, email addresses, URLs
ANNOTATION & MARKUP
• Powerful annotation engine that works with Apple Pencil, capacitive pencils or finger
• Annotate papers, fill out forms, or sign documents
• Markup is stored in editable form (can be updated or even removed at any time)
TEXT READER & VOICE
• Comfortable multi-page reading experience
• Customizable margins, line spacing, text size & fonts
• Read text aloud using iOS voices
• Adjustable speech rate & playback controls
• Word highlighting during playback
ACCESSIBILITY
• Optimized for VoiceOver
• Spoken guidance prior to shooting
• Spoken description
• Dynamic Type
• OpenDyslexic reading font
FOR PROS
• Batch editing: replicate settings across pages
• Automation (x-callback-url): use Shortcuts app to automate document processing
• Keyboard shortcuts
OS INTEGRATION
• Siri Shortcuts
• Messages extension: scan & send a document without leaving the conversation
• Open In & Photos extensions (process & cleanup)
• iPad multitasking and drag & drop
• iCloud & Continuity across iPhone, iPad & Mac
• Background audio player
PRICING
• Prizmo is available as a free download to try out its core features
• Premium Pack is a one-time purchase to unlock all limitations: unlimited on-device OCR, full access to text & text-to-speech, smart actions, watermark removal
• Cloud Plan subscription (optional) provides the Cloud OCR feature. Plans are detailed in the app
• Volume purchase (VPP): see Prizmo (Volume Ed.)
PRIVACY
Prizmo is "privacy first". Personal data is yours, we don’t access it, we don’t read it, we don’t host it on our servers.
Privacy Policy: https://creaceed.com/privacy
Terms of Use: https://creaceed.com/terms
Feedback: prizmo@creaceed.com
(*) full list of OCR languages available on https://creaceed.com/iprizmo
Cloud OCR requires an Internet connection.

Simple yet innovative brain exercise that’s both entertaining and educational.
Whether you want to challenge yourself, train your brain, or just unwind—Categories is your go-to word game! Perfect for fans of puzzles, riddles, word connect, and matching games.

Free to play – endless fun with no time limit!

Casual, colorful, and easy-to-use interface.
Suitable for kids and adults alike – learn and have fun together!
Regular updates with fresh puzzles and new categories.
Improve your logic. Boost your vocabulary. Download Categories - Word Associations now and start playing the best word connection game today!

bluejetty:00091244:ios.description:
Get ready for a fun and relaxing black hole puzzle experience in Holy Hole! Take control of a hole to swallow everything in sight, solve puzzle challenges, and unwind with endless fun hours of satisfying black hole eating games. Players need to accurately swallow designated targets within a limited time, experiencing the perfect combination of strategy and operation.
Game features:
Control a black hole to eat, sort, and solve puzzles across colorful, dynamic levels.
Compete in exciting tournaments to prove yourself as the ultimate puzzle master.
Team up with friends, share rewards, and climb the leaderboard together
Unlock unique objects and exciting themes as you progress through levels
Use "magnets" to attract targets, "time freeze" to pause the countdown, and strategic combinations to help you easily clear levels.
Play offline anytime, anywhere - no internet needed
How to Play
Drag the hole across to swallow all required things into the hole
Swallow objects to grow bigger and absorb even more things
Solve challenging puzzles by collecting items in the right order
Unlock new levels, boosters, and rewards to become a hole game master!
Download 'Holy Hole!' now, relax, swallow, and solve the puzzle! Are you ready to make your Holy Hole a legend?

bluejetty:00119125:ios.description:
Every choice has a consequence. Some could be your last.
Step into a world of terrifying stories where you're not just a reader — you're part of the nightmare. Make decisions, uncover dark secrets, and discover how your choices shape the story. Will you survive, or will your next move lead to a terrifying end?
Welcome to Horror Stories & Scary Stories, where chilling tales come to life through interactive storytelling and immersive audio narration.
Key Features:
• Your Choices Matter
Take control of the story. Hide or run? Trust a stranger or walk away? Every decision can lead you down a different path.
• Multiple Endings to Discover

bluejetty:00074207:ios.summary:
Sydney Transport — Your Smarter Way Around Sydney
Get real-time bus, train, ferry, and light rail updates across Sydney — all in one simple, reliable app designed for everyday travellers.
“Sydney Transport makes commuting so much easier.
bluejetty:00074207:ios.description:
Sydney Transport — Your Smarter Way Around Sydney
Get real-time bus, train, ferry, and light rail updates across Sydney — all in one simple, reliable app designed for everyday travellers.
“Sydney Transport makes commuting so much easier. The live times are spot on, and I can see exactly when my train or ferry is arriving.”
Why Sydneysiders love Sydney Transport:
• Live Transport for NSW bus, train, ferry, and light rail tracking
• Stop and departure alerts
• Smart trip planner with step-by-step directions
• Live and offline route maps
• One-tap “Get Me Home” journeys
• Customisable widgets for quick access
Never miss your stop again — with Get Off Alerts, Sydney Transport lets you relax and know exactly when it’s time to hop off. Track your bus, train, or ferry in real time, check crowding levels, and stay up to date with service alerts and delays.
Whether you’re heading to work in the CBD, catching the ferry to Manly, or riding the Metro home, Sydney Transport keeps you connected and on time.
Coverage Includes:
• Sydney Trains and NSW TrainLink Intercity Services
• Sydney Metro
• Transport for NSW Buses
• Sydney Ferries
• Inner West and CBD Light Rail
• Real-time service alerts, detours, and maintenance updates
Plan trips, check live arrivals, and save your favourite stops — all in one app built for Sydney’s entire transport network.
--------
What is Sydney Transport?
Sydney Transport is a real-time public transport app for Sydney. It shows live bus, train, ferry, and light rail times, plus service alerts and trip planning.
Does it work with Transport for NSW?
Yes — Sydney Transport includes all Transport for NSW services, including Sydney Trains, Metro, ferries, and buses.
Does it include Sydney Metro and Light Rail?
Absolutely. You can see live train and tram times for the Sydney Metro and both Light Rail lines.
Can I check ferry departures?
Yes — Sydney Transport includes real-time Sydney Ferries data, with live tracking and alerts for delays or cancellations.
Does it show service alerts and delays?
Yes — you’ll receive live notifications about delays, detours, and planned maintenance.
Can I use the app offline?
Yes — offline maps and saved timetables let you plan ahead even without mobile data.
Will it tell me when to get off?
Yes. “Get Off Alerts” use GPS to notify you before your stop.
Is Sydney Transport free?
Yes — it’s free to download and use, with optional premium features and widgets available via in-app purchase.
How do I contact support?
Email talk@travelwhiz.app or message @trymomego on X (Twitter).
--------
Travel smarter with Sydney Transport — your all-in-one app for trains, buses, ferries, and light rail.
Download now and get real-time maps, live departures, and service alerts for Sydney and beyond.

 ◆ Send personalized postcards worldwide ◆

 ◆ Three ways downloading MyPostcard just makes sense ◆
 - Make loved ones ecstatic 
 - Uniquely decorate your space 
 - Relive your milestone moments
 ◆ Relive and share your favorite memories with MyPostcard ◆
Send photos to your loved ones as gifts or greetings, or use them to decorate or craft. Choose from:
 - Postcards from $3.49: Choose from 70,000+ customizable designs, or a classic postcard template with between 1-9 photo holders. Edit the border, apply filters, add text, go wild!

 - Photo prints from $5.99: Cultivate a beautiful set of 15, 22 or 30 photos in regular, square or Polaroid format.
 - Umbra frame from $25.00
 - Framed photos from $29.90
Download the best postcard app now to discover tons of personalization possibilities, extras and add-ons.

 1. Download the app and sign up 
 2. Choose your product or search for a card design via the ‘Designs’ tab. 
 3. Follow the next steps to fully personalize your product with text or photos.
 4. Enter the recipient address or add it from your address book.
 5. Pay with credit, card, bank transfer or PayPal.
 6. We’ll print and send your high quality product!
 ◆ Free international shipping on all cards ◆
Your order is directed to the printing partner nearest your recipient, to ensure speedy delivery, and a reduced carbon footprint. We’re partnered with printing houses all around the world, including in the USA, Canada, Australia, Germany, Guernsey, with new locations imminent.

 ◆ What is MyPostcard all about? ◆
With more than three million downloads and a rating of 4.7 stars, we’re the postcard app you trust to send your postcards and printed products to loved ones at home and internationally.
Behind the scenes, we work to support non-profit organizations, such as Rotary, Amnesty International and All Out. MyPostcard stands up for the rights of our users and people worldwide! 
Become part of our community today by following us on Instagram via @mypostcardapp or Facebook via @mypostcard.global. Make sure to tag us in your #MyPostcardMoment for the chance to feature!

bluejetty:00184996:ios.description:
Oink, oink! Look, IT’S A PIG! And it’s EVOLVING! Come meet all different and weird types of piggies in this FUNNY evolution game! Tired of being considered the dirtiest animals in the food chain, it’s time for the pigs to rub their evolution in everyone’s face!
Actually, in this game, the dirtier your pigs are, the richer you will get: make coins POP as your pigs POOP and wallow in money while your herd of pigs wallow in… well, whatever they’re into!
HOW TO PLAY
• Drag and drop similar pigs to create new mysterious and mutant creatures
• Use pig poop coins to buy new pigs and make even more money
• Alternatively, fiercely tap a pig to make them poop and collect more coins!
HIGHLIGHTS
• Different levels and many different pig species to discover
• Watch out for the impostors that will get in your way!
• Put on funny HATS in your pigs and make them unique!
• Paint your pigs the color you want and create a very very special herd of yours!
No pigs were harmed in the making of this game, only developers. Come and check them out!
Disclaimer: While this App is completely free to play, some additional content can be purchased for real money in-game. If you do not want to use this feature, please turn off in-app purchases in your device's settings.
Like our page on Facebook and be the first to know about our upcoming games and updates! http://fb.com/tappshq

Ever wondered what you’d look like if you could borrow another person’s smile, a movie star’s raised eyebrow, or a comedian’s hilarious grin? Meet BigFace, your passport to a world of limitless facial transformations. With just a single photo and a reference video, BigFace uses cutting-edge AI to transfer a wide range of facial expressions onto your own image. It’s time to see yourself in a whole new light—joy, surprise, awe, or even a mischievous smirk are all just a few taps away.
How It Works
 1. Start With a Selfie: Snap a fresh photo or choose one from your gallery.
 2. Select a Source Video: Pick from our curated library of expression-rich clips or use your own. From subtle smiles to bold reactions, you can turn any video into a source of new facial expressions.
 3. Watch the Magic Unfold: Our advanced AI engine seamlessly morphs your face to mirror the chosen expressions. The result? A personalized video where you’re the star, showcasing emotions you never knew you could capture.
Features You’ll Love
 • Realistic Expression Transfer: Leveraging sophisticated deep learning models, BigFace recreates natural shifts in eyes, mouth, and facial contours—no uncanny vibes, just authentic emotion.
 • Easy-to-Use Interface: Whether you’re tech-savvy or just curious, our clean, intuitive controls help you craft your masterpiece in minutes.
 • Customizable Expressions: Fine-tune the results by adjusting intensity. Want a subtle grin instead of a toothy smile? You’re in control.
 • Mix and Match Emotion Sources: Download or record different videos for a wide range of expressions—your face can show calm neutrality in one video and explosive laughter in the next.
 • High-Quality Output: Export crisp, vibrant videos perfect for sharing on social media, messaging apps, or wherever you want to stand out.

 • Endless Creativity: Turn a neutral passport photo into a dynamic set of headshots. Experiment with how you might look emulating your favorite actors, singers, comedians—or even your friends!
 • Social Media Ready: Elevate your profile with one-of-a-kind content. From Instagram Stories to TikTok videos, transform your personal brand and entertain your followers.
 • Memory Enhancement: Relive special moments by blending the expressions of loved ones into your own ph

bluejetty:00100559:ios.description:
Inclined makes it easy for permanent life insurance policy owners to access the cash value in their policies whenever they want, for whatever matters most. The Inclined Line of Credit (iLOC), is a revolving line of credit designed to give you that freedom and flexibility.
The Inclined app is an extension of our platform for existing iLOC clients, putting the power to view, draw from, and make payments on your iLOC account in the palm of your hand. It provides iLOC clients with faster, easier, and more intuitive access to the cash value in their permanent life insurance policies—anytime, anywhere.
FAST ACCESS TO FUNDS
Make draws from your active iLOC account that arrive the next day (in some cases it may take longer.)
PAY ANYTIME
Make payments on-the-go in just a few clicks from within the app.
MANAGE LINKED ACCOUNTS
View and manage connected bank accounts used for transfers.
ACCOUNT VISIBILITY
Check your credit limit, account balance, transaction history and view account documents anytime.
—
NOT AN EXISTING iLOC CLIENT?
If you’re interested in accessing the cash value in your permanent life insurance policies, visit Inclined.com to learn more and apply today.
Permanent Life Insurance provides a powerful living benefit for policyowners by offering a smart liquidity option using the cash value in your policies. The Inclined Line of Credit offers efficient access to the cash that’s rightfully yours whenever you want it.
Features of the iLOC include:
 - Apply online in about 15 minutes with no cumbersome financial disclosures
 - Access up to 95% of your policy’s cash value
 - Credit limits are re-evaluated automatically as your cash value grows
 - Assign unlimited policies to a single line of credit
 - Active iLOCs don’t show as outstanding debt on credit reports
 - No required payments as long as there is room on your credit limit
 - Evergreen lines stay open with no manual renewals required
 - Competitive rates
 - No fees, ever!

bluejetty:00033761:ios.description:
Shoom is an AI music and video generator that turns your ideas into songs and music videos. Create original songs with your own style, sound, and lyrics, then add your photo to generate personalized AI music videos.
An easier alternative to complex production tools, this AI music maker works for everyone, whether you're a complete beginner or a musician pushing past a creative block. From quick song demos and background tracks to pure creative exploration, Shoom puts music creation right into your hands.
With Shoom, you can:
— Turn a text prompt into a complete vocal or instrumental AI song in minutes.
— Write lyrics or use the built-in lyric generator to craft words to fit your track.
— Record or upload your voice and transform it into unique AI music.
— Reimagine songs with an AI Cover and hear them with fresh new voices.
— Create personalized AI music videos using your photos and favorite Shoom songs.
KEY FEATURES
● DESCRIBE IT, HEAR IT
Type a title, choose a genre, set the mood, and let Shoom handle the rest. From rap and classical to K-pop and rock—this AI music maker supports a wide range of genres, vibes, and atmospheres. 
● BRING YOUR LYRICS TO LIFE
Got lyrics but no melody? Paste your words into the AI song writer and hear them come alive with vocals, instruments, and full production—or generate lyrics instantly and edit them to fit your vision.
● MAKE MUSIC WITH YOUR VOICE
Speak, sing, or hum—Voice Mode turns recordings into AI-generated songs with their own unique sound. Record live or upload audio, and Shoom will build the music around your voice.
● TURN PHOTOS INTO AI MUSIC VIDEOS
Upload your photo, choose a background and a song, and watch them come together as a custom AI music video. Create unique music videos inspired by any genre, mood, or style you love.
● COVER IT YOUR WAY
Reimagine your favorite tracks on the fly. Create an AI cover with a fresh vocal style and discover a whole new energy in a song you already love.
● SAVE IT, KEEP IT, GET IT
All your AI songs, all in one place—everything stays saved and ready to go. Play tracks anytime and download them to share your AI music with friends and family.
HOW DOES SHOOM WORK?
1. Pick a genre and describe the sound you want.
2. Add your own lyrics or let the AI song maker create them from scratch.
3. Enter a title for your track.
4. Tap generate, and your track will be ready in minutes.
5. Listen, download, and share with anyone.
Start making AI music that sounds like you. Download Shoom and turn your next idea into a song.
FAQ
Q: Is Shoom beginner-friendly?
A: Yes. This AI music maker is built so anyone can create a song on their first try—the whole process takes a couple of minutes and requires zero musical background.
Q: What genres are supported?
A: Pop, rock, rap, R&B, classical, indie, jazz, EDM, country, reggae, and more. Every AI song you make can be shaped to match the genre and mood you have in mind.
Q: What makes Shoom different?

bluejetty:00104525:android.name: Timesheet, work log -Worker 24
bluejetty:00104525:android.summary: Work tracker application is used to create a work schedule, register your own or your employees' work hours and manage employee leave (including overtime). It contains modern solutions that allow you to forget about a pile of paper document
bluejetty:00104525:android.description:
Work tracker application is used to create a work schedule, register your own or your employees' work hours and manage employee leave (including overtime). It contains modern solutions that allow you to forget about a pile of paper documents, which makes work easier and more efficient.
Work tracker contains 3 main modules. You can handle individual modules yourself or delegate your employees to do so by giving them the appropriate permissions.
1. Timesheet.
Timesheet module allows you to register your own or your employees' work hours.
Thanks to the timesheet module you can also use a Smartphone or Tablet as a Work log Recorder, leave work tracker application turned on at the entrance to the workplace. Communication between devices takes place using the NFC module. To start and end work hours, the employee will have to bring their phone close to it. You will be able to view all work logs in real time on your smartphone.
Work tracker will generate work log reports of registered work hours for you, including:
- timesheet
- work log
- overtime (unpaid overtime and paid overtime)
- unpaid breaks
- estimated salary including overtime
Timesheet module allows you to export all work logs regarding work time registration to an Excel file.
2. Employee scheduling
Employee scheduling module allows you to easily create and edit a work schedule.
Thank to employee scheduling module you will be able to see a daily summary in the work schedule and a monthly summary for the worker, including:
- number of individual shifts in the work schedule
- number of individual days off from work in the work schedule
- estimated salary of the worker in the work schedule
The work schedule will be available in the application for all employees who have the application, for others it is possible to generate a pdf file with the work schedule and send it to workers or print it. 
If changes are made to the work schedule for an worker, they will be automatically informed via system notifications. You can manage the employee scheduling module yourself or delegate another person to do so.
3. Leave management
Thanks to this module, workers will be able to send leave requests from the application. When an worker sends a request for leave, every authorized person to operate the leave management module will be automatically informed via system notifications.
After considering the request for leave, the worker will also be informed of the decision made.
You will have insight into all of your employees' taken and planned leave days. Employees will be able to see their vacations in the employee scheduling module.
Thanks to Work tracker application, you will streamline team work.

bluejetty:00095851:ios.description:
WristNet is a web browser for Apple Watch. Search the web, read articles and open your favorite sites right on your wrist, and manage everything comfortably from the companion iPhone app.
SEARCH AND READ ON YOUR WRIST
• Dictate, scribble or type a search or a web address
• Read news, articles, recipes, scores and more on the watch screen
• Choose your search engine: Google, Bing, DuckDuckGo, Brave, Startpage, Yahoo and more
BOOKMARKS, ORGANIZED FROM YOUR IPHONE
• Save sites as bookmarks and group them into categories
• Reorder and pin your favorites on iPhone; changes appear on your watch
• Your recently opened bookmarks are always one tap away
QUICK ACCESS
• Watch face complications and Smart Stack widgets for quick search, pinned and recent bookmarks
• Siri and Shortcuts: "Search with WristNet" or open your bookmarks by voice
PRIVACY FIRST
• No third-party ads
• No tracking across other companies' apps or websites
• We never collect the sites you visit, your searches or your bookmarks
• Usage analytics help us improve the app, and you can turn them off anytime in Settings
DESIGNED FOR APPLE WATCH
A clean, fast interface made for small screens, with large tap targets and Digital Crown scrolling.
GOOD TO KNOW
Video and audio playback are not supported on Apple Watch. Some websites may look or behave differently on a small screen.
WRISTNET PREMIUM
WristNet is free to download and includes daily browsing time on Apple Watch and a limited number of bookmarks. WristNet Premium unlocks unlimited browsing time on your watch and unlimited bookmarks and categories. Premium is available as an auto-renewable subscription or a one-time lifetime purchase. Available plans and prices are shown in the app.
• Payment is charged to your Apple ID at confirmation of purchase.
• Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your account is charged for renewal within 24 hours before the end of the current period.
• You can manage or cancel subscriptions in your App Store account settings.
• Any unused portion of a free trial, if offered, is forfeited when you purchase a subscription.
Terms of Use: https://www.notion.so/411686c61ac481a3b271df6c4d3894da
Privacy Policy: https://www.notion.so/40d686c61ac481aebb04fc4ae7cd1dfb

bluejetty:00128310:ios.name: Baseball Softball Pocket Coach
bluejetty:00128310:ios.summary: A tool designed for youth baseball coaches, to save you tons of time and keep you organized and informed. Also works great for softball, kickball, etc. or just tracking your personal stats. Syncs with iCloud to all your devices, and you can
bluejetty:00128310:ios.description:
A tool designed for youth baseball coaches, to save you tons of time and keep you organized and informed. Also works great for softball, kickball, etc. or just tracking your personal stats. Syncs with iCloud to all your devices, and you can share with others, too.
I've been coaching little league baseball for over 6 years. I've tried paper scorebooks, spreadsheets, and smartphone apps but nothing worked quite the way I wanted. I created something that will save you HOURS of time, year after year - isn't that worth a few dollars to you?
The season starts with practices. Pocket Coach provides an attendance keeper for practices. I don't know about you, but I reward players who show up for practices. Simply check off who is present, and now you have that information for later when you are planning your lineup.
In baseball, rain happens. You probably need to send out a quick notice to parents and players when an event gets canceled or delayed, when you're at the field away from your computer. You can store 2 emails and 2 mobile phone numbers for each player, and in seconds blast out a team email or text message. Parents appreciate that!
Planning the lineup for games is what I used to spend alot of time on. In little league, players will often play different positions throughout a game. A good coach will think this through carefully ahead of time, and lay out each position for each inning, including bench time. (Of course, changes may occur based on game situations, and being able to quickly change this on the fly is a great feature of this app.) How often did your lineup accidentally include two left fielders and no center fielder? Doh! Pocket Coach will clearly highlight positions in red when you mess up.
I also like to consider how often each player has played in the infield, in the outfield, sat on the bench, etc. when planning the lineup. You have all of this information at your fingertips now! When you're done, you can print a lineup sheet directly from your phone or email it to another coach.
For younger leagues, you may just want to randomize the fielding positions, and you can do that too.
I've long ago given up trying to decypher scorebooks when tracking batting averages etc., so I would always write my own notes on an index card, and plug that into a spreadsheet later. As a coach, you care about batting RESULTS. With a couple screen taps, you can quickly and easily record a batting result: single, strikeout, fielders choice, whatever. Very simple, anyone can do it with no training. Later, you can pull up all the important batting statistics.
It's very important to keep track of how many pitches each pitcher has thrown, and there is a pitch counter built in. It also tracks balls and strikes, walks and strikeouts, hits and outs, and runs. 
Of course, a baseball coach usually coaches multiple teams over the years, and Baseball Pocket Coach supports as many teams as you want. You might play softball yourself and want to track your own batting stats but not the entire team, you can do that! Some parents might want to use Pocket Baseball Coach to track their own child's stats, and use the group email and texting features. Trust me, it's way easier to use than the "free" apps out there! (Nothing is free if it gives you a headache to try to use it : )
With Pocket Coach you can print or email a ton of reports directly from your iPhone, iPad, or M1 Mac. Geek out all the way and use an iPad in the dugout for your players to see, while you make changes on your iPhone.
Runs great on a Mac with Apple Silicon.

bluejetty:00089085:ios.description:
Fitmint transforms every step into a rewarding challenge and build a lasting habit of walking. 
Connect your apple health and start tracking your daily steps. Achieve your daily step goal, level up, and earn GRIT coins. Redeem GRIT coins for exciting gift cards from Amazon, Nike and other popular brands.
Monitor your progress with weekly and monthly analytics.
Start with a 7-DAY FREE TRIAL, then unlock all features and GRIT coins with a subscription!
Fitmint is a gamified walking and steps tracker designed to help you build a healthy walking habit while having fun and earning rewards. Every day, you’re assigned a personalized step goal. Complete it to level up and earn GRIT coins, or miss it and see your level drop - your performance is always on display! These coins can be redeemed for exciting gift cards from Amazon and other popular brands, making every step count toward tangible rewards.
How It Works:
Daily Step Goals: Start each day with a clear, achievable steps goal. Hit your target, and you’ll level up, unlocking more rewards and new challenges.
Progress Analytics: Stay motivated by tracking your performance with detailed weekly and monthly summaries. See how you rank against others on the leaderboard and monitor your consistency over time.
Community & Social Engagement: Connect with a community of fitness enthusiasts who share your passion for walking and healthy living. Share your workout selfies and progress updates to inspire others and celebrate your achievements.
Use Cases:
For Fitness Beginners: Build a consistent walking habit in a fun, non-intimidating way while earning rewards that keep you motivated.
For Competitive Walkers: Challenge friends or join public competitions to see who can walk the most steps and earn the highest rewards.
For Habit Builders: Integrate Fitmint with Apple Health to effortlessly track your daily steps and progress, turning simple walks into a rewarding journey.
For Reward Seekers: Convert your fitness efforts into real-world benefits by redeeming GRIT coins for gift cards.
Target Audience: Fitmint is perfect for anyone looking to improve their fitness through walking, whether you’re just starting out or already a seasoned walker. It’s ideal for busy professionals, fitness enthusiasts, and anyone who enjoys gamification and friendly competition to stay motivated.
Subscription Information:
- Start with a 7-day free trial
- After the trial, subscription is required to access all features
- Choose between monthly or annual subscription options
- Subscription automatically renews unless turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period
- Payment will be charged to your Apple ID account
- Account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period
- Manage subscriptions in your Apple ID Account Settings
Download Fitmint today and start turning every step into a step toward a healthier, more rewarding lifestyle!
