bluejetty:00179034:ios.description:
This is the FREE version of the Best seller iTunes app, the SAS Survival Guide, available now in the App Store and as an inApp Purchase. Based on the million-copy bestselling book, this fantastic free app provides you with a bare bones guide to wilderness survival. Jam-packed with basic survival tools, you'll be equipped for any expedition to the outdoors with this entry-level guide in your arsenal.
▶▶ ACCOLADES ◀◀ 
◆◆◆ SAS Survival Guide wins "Official Honoree" Award at the 15th Annual Webbys ◆◆◆
◆◆◆ Selected for "iTunes REWIND 2010" ◆◆◆
◆◆◆ Listed under "Apple Featured Applications", "What's Hot" & "New & Noteworthy" Worldwide.◆◆◆
◆◆◆ Has achieved the #1 LIFESTYLE APP in most geographic locations.◆◆◆
▶▶ ABOUT THE SAS SURVIVAL GUIDE ◀◀ 
For over twenty years, the SAS Survival Guide has been the definitive guide to surviving any situation, anywhere in the world. Now, for the first time ever, the bestselling book has been reinvented for the iPhone. 
Written by former SAS soldier and instructor, John "Lofty" Wiseman, this application brings you the elite training techniques of Britain’s toughest fighting force in the most accessible version ever. Now you can take the world-class survival skills of the SAS with you anywhere in the world – from the peaks of Kilimanjaro to the deserts of Kandahar…or to your closest national park. 
The Lite App Contains:
•Basic survival information including: building fires, finding water, navigating by the stars, survival kit, signals and codes
•Photo galleries of cloud spotting, night sky navigation, and more
•Video of Lofty Wiseman demonstrating knife skills
•100+ question quiz to test if you've got what it takes to survive
•Survival checklist to help you prepare for trips
•Search the app by keyword for quick reference
▶▶▶ WHY NOT GET THE FULL APP ◀◀◀ 
The Full app contains:
•Full text, in 9 chapters, of the bestselling book optimised for the iPhone 
•16 videos providing invaluable survival tips from Lofty himself 
•Photo galleries of edible, medicinal and poisonous plants 
•Morse Code signalling device 
•100 + question quiz to test if you've got what it takes to survive 
•Survival Checklist 
•Sun Compass 
•Search tool to scan entire book by subject 
•Extreme Climate Survival: sections on surviving Polar, Desert, Tropical, and Sea 
•Comprehensive First Aid section 
------------------------------------
Also included for purchase is the ◆ SAS Urban Survival Guide ◆ 
Learn How to Protect Yourself Against Terrorism, Natural Disasters, Fires, Home Invasions, and Everyday Health and Safety Hazards

bluejetty:00159495:ios.description:
OpeninApp is India's most popular link-in-bio app that allows you to create smart links for free and let your audience open links directly in the native apps.
Instagram doesn’t pay its creators for creating content, but Youtube does…
So you will notice that most Instagram users share links to their Youtube channels in their Instagram stories or in their bio Links on Instagram.
But whenever a user taps on a youtube link shared in an Instagram profile, instead of opening the YouTube app, Instagram opens the YouTube website in a browser inside its own app.
Now that creates a lot of problems for the users:
They cannot like, comment, or subscribe to that video and can't even see the video in full-screen mode.
It also creates another disadvantage for the creator/influencer: That there is no ad shown in the video… This means the creator is not paid anything at all for that video.
The reason all of this happens is that no user is logged in on YouTube inside that Instagram browser…
Using OpeninApp, you can create smart links in just 2 mins, which let your users open the links directly in their native apps
Create your smart link using openinapp in 4 simple steps:
Step 1: Type or paste your link and click on Generate Link
Type or paste any link that you want your followers to open
Step 2: Sign in with your Apple, Gmail or Phone number
Choose your preferred mode of login
Step 3: Copy the generated link
Copy the link generated or share it directly via WhatsApp
Step 4: Share it with the world
Paste the link on your Instagram bio, Instagram story, or anywhere across your social platforms for your audience to have the best experience of your content
OpeninApp is 100% Free and Safe to use. Copy, customize, and share your links straight from your phone and view the performance of your links on the go!

Create your smart link and let your audience open the link directly in apps

Edit the link on your dashboard to customize it as per your brand or liking
MEASURE
Share your link and let us help you with the insights. Get In-Depth Analytics like Total and Per day clicks, Age and Gender Distribution, Top traffic sources, devices & location, and much more. Share it with Brands to close that deal!
GROW
Improve your engagement by 10x and generate up to 8x more ads revenue.

iPhone X or newer OR iPad Pro with front-facing TrueDepth camera

AI Plastic Surgeon™

Lip Volume

The AGXR Attune app lets you control your hearing aids directly from your mobile device. You can change pr
bluejetty:00043970:ios.description:
The AGXR Attune app is compatible with the following hearing aids: 
• Attune is compatible with hearing aids produced by GN Hearing
The AGXR Attune app lets you control your hearing aids directly from your mobile device. You can change programs, and make simple or more advanced sound adjustments and save them as favorites. The app helps you learn what you can do and how to do it. It can even help you find your hearing aids if you lose them. Last, but not least, you can have your hearing care professional update your hearing aid programs and send you new hearing aid software without taking a trip to the clinic.
AGXR Attune mobile device compatibility:
Please consult the AGXR app website for up-to-date compatibility information: www.agxhearing.com/agx-hearing-technology/agxr/attune/agxr-attune/
Use the AGXR Attune app to: 
• Enjoy optimization anywhere with Audigy Assist: Request help with your hearing aid settings from your hearing care professional and receive new settings and software updates. 
And use these direct control and personalization options:
• Adjust volume settings on your hearing aids
• Mute your hearing aids
• Adjust volume of your Audigy streaming accessories
• Adjust speech focus as well as noise and wind-noise levels with Sound Enhancer (feature availability depends on your hearing aid model and the fitting by your hearing care professional)
• Change manual and streamer programs
• Edit and personalize program names 
• Adjust treble, middle and bass tones to your preferences
• Save your preferred settings as a Favorite – you can even tag to a location 
• Monitor the battery status of your rechargeable hearing aids
• Help locate lost or misplaced hearing aids
• Tinnitus manager: Adjust sound variation and frequency of the Tinnitus Sound Generator. Select Nature Sounds (feature availability depends on your hearing aid model and the fitting by your hearing care professional)
For more information please visit the support website via the link in the app store.

bluejetty:00078293:ios.description:
「楽しいから始まる学び」を提供するメディア【QuizKnock】
QuizKnock（クイズノック）は、「楽しいから始まる学び」をコンセプトに、何かを「知る」きっかけとなるような記事や動画を毎日発信する東京大学発の知的メディアです。
クイズを通じて様々な体験を届けるウェブメディア・YouTubeチャンネルの運営から、知的な能力を楽しく鍛えるゲームアプリの開発まで幅広く手がけています。
本アプリでお届けするウェブメディアでは、話題のニュースや人生に役立つ知識から、マニアックなテーマを解説するコラムや夢中になれる謎解きまで、幅広く楽しめる記事を毎日更新しています。
+—QuizKnockの主なコンテンツ—+
◆ 【クイズ記事】
多彩なジャンルのトピックをクイズで楽しみながら学べる！
QuizKnockでは、昨日の出来事からスポーツ・エンタメ、さらにはアカデミックな話題まで幅広くカバーするクイズ記事を日々更新しています。
クイズ形式で楽しみながら、気になる話題について知ることができます。よく知っている話題のクイズは、知識試しとしても楽しむことができます。
◆ 【クイズ連載】
「解く楽しみ」を入り口に幅広い知識をどんどん吸収できる！
誰でもある程度は知っている常識レベルのクイズを集めた『常識Knock』や、
知っているだけで自慢できるレベルのクイズを集めた『博識テスト』、
ひとつのジャンルを10問のクイズで極める『10問でマスター』シリーズなど、
よりクイズを楽しみたいあなたにオススメの連載を取り揃えています。
◆ 【コラム】
日常の疑問からマニアックなテーマまでわかりやすい解説が読める！
「ディズニーランドを貸し切るには何円かかる？」
「地球上で自分だけが問題を解けたら、偏差値はいくつ？」
素朴な疑問からアカデミックな話題まで、言われてみると気になってしょうがない
テーマを実力派ライター陣がわかりやすく解説するコラムも充実しています。
◆ 【謎解き・パズル】
ひらめきを問われる謎解きやパズルであなたの頭をリフレッシュ！
ひらめくと気持ちいい！　
クイズとは違った快感を味わうことのできる謎解きやパズルも週１ペースで更新中です。クイズに疲れたときは、頭の体操はいかがですか？
◆ 【YouTube連動記事】
あの大人気クイズ王たちが解いた問題に挑戦してみよう！
チャンネル登録者数が100万人を突破、伊沢拓司を筆頭に大人気のYouTubeチャンネル
「QuizKnock」の動画と連動した記事を随時配信しています。あのクイズ王たちが
解いた問題に挑戦してみませんか？
◆ 【多彩なライター陣】
超実力派高学歴ライター陣が集結！
東京大学を始めとした名門大学出身のライターが多数集結、面白いクイズとわかりやすい解説をみなさまにお届けしています。
+—QuizKnockアプリの特徴—+
◆ アプリなら記事から記事への移動もスムーズに
記事のジャンルはスワイプ操作（画面に指を置いて左右に動かす）でサクサク表示を切り替えられます。
関連記事への移動もスムーズに行うことができます。
◆ 気になるクイズはブックマーク
「これは覚えておきたい」「これは面白い」そんなクイズがあったらブックマーク。
記事がどこにあったか覚えていなくても、ブックマーク画面からお気に入りのクイズを
すぐに振り返ることができます。
◆ あなたの正解率は何％？　マイページ機能
これまでに挑戦したクイズの通算問題数や、その正答率を見ることができます。
たくさん記事を読んで、どんどん正答率を上げていきましょう。
＜動作環境＞
iOS15.0以上
※ ただし一部の機種では正常に動作しない場合があります。
※ iOS15.0未満は動作保証の対象外となりますのでご注意ください。
＜お問い合わせ＞
ご利用後、気になる点や不具合などがございましたら、下記のアドレスまでご連絡ください。
app.contact@quizknock.com
App Storeのレビュー欄に不具合報告をいただいた場合、お客様のご利用環境などをお伺いすることができませんので、お問い合わせフォームよりご連絡いただけますようお願いいたします。
【Twitter】
@QuizKnock
【YouTube】
https://www.youtube.com/c/quizknock

bluejetty:00089408:ios.description:
ReadingClock is a simple reading timer and tracker for building a daily reading habit. Tap to start, read, and watch your minutes add up toward your daily and weekly goals.
Whether you're a kid logging reading for school, a parent cheering on a young reader, or an adult who wants to read more, ReadingClock keeps you consistent.
FEATURES
- Reading timer: slide to start, slide to stop, and your session is logged automatically
- Daily and weekly reading goals with progress at a glance
- Reading calendar that shows how consistent you've been all month
- Streaks and milestones: celebrate 7-day and 30-day streaks, 10, 50, and 100 hours, and more
- Share your wins with friends and family
- Reading notes for thoughts, favorite quotes, and progress
- Add, edit, or delete reading logs anytime
- Total reading time for today, this week, and all time
- Optional sound and milestone alerts when you reach your daily goal
- Smart long-session review to easily trim your time if you forget to stop the timer
WHY I BUILT READINGCLOCK
I'm Grace, a mother of two. My kids read every day, and although their school asks for only 20 minutes, they usually read for 40 minutes to an hour. Watching how much their reading and writing improved over time inspired me to build an app that helps other readers keep the same routine.
My children gave me a lot of feedback on this app. It wouldn't be here without them!
"I love ReadingClock! I use it for my reading time at home and for my homework." - my son
"ReadingClock is so helpful! Also my mom always takes my feedback to make the app better!" - my daughter
Upgrade to ReadingClock Pro to enjoy the app ad-free.

bluejetty:00123956:ios.description:
///// GROW. SURVIVE. DESTROY!
Hurricane.io is an online strategy game where you are the hurricane. You'll start as a tiny tropical storm, but by absorbing clouds you can get massive in no time.
Destroying cities charges special powers, but you'll shrink while on land. Activate your powers at the perfect time to unleash chaos on the world ⁠— and the competition!
That's right. You're not the only cyclone around, and angering a bigger hurricane might get you eaten. But when you're a Perfect Storm, the whole sky is yours to devour!
How long can you survive? How big can you get? And how much destruction can you cause?
///// FEATURES
Compete against real players from around the world
Gain size and wind speed by absorbing clouds… or smaller hurricanes!
Destroy cities to charge and unleash devastating powers
Collect coins to trade for stronger powers
See real-world hurricane data from JTWC & NHC
Socialize and strategize in live text chat
Use Party Mode to play in private rooms with friends
Hurricane.io is played online by default, but offline mode is available at all times.
///// DISCORD
Want to befriend other hurricanes? Found a bug or other in-game problem? Join our official Discord community! Developers and players alike will be glad to say hi and help out. https://discord.gg/9CFM6dQDXx

bluejetty:00088941:ios.description:
Logging seizures and keeping a good diary is an essential skill for managing epilepsy and it has never been easier!
Renowned website, SeizureTracker.com is excited to bring you an innovative way to log seizures that builds on the Seizure Tracker experience. App users can time and videotape seizures simultaneously in this revolutionary and simple-to-use application. When you stop the video and timer, it immediately creates an event log that is stored in a seizure library. You can edit the event at any time to add additional details about triggers, seizure description and what happened afterward. You can also use this app to log seizures without videos attached.
Videos recorded through this app can be synchronized to SeizureTracker.com which allows them to be shared through the extensive website reporting capabilities. 
Seizure Tracker was founded by the parents of a child with Epilepsy. We were searching for solutions to ease our own situation and in the process found a way to give back to the community and help others too. Our goal is to empower people living with Epilepsy while redefining the way information about seizures and Epilepsy is collected and shared.
Key Features
- Time and visually record seizures as they happen
- Videotape seizures and upload them to SeizureTracker.com for private sharing
- Record VNS Usages and Rescue Medication administrations
- Automatically add recorded seizure to Library
- Add additional information to seizure entries
- Create seizure entries with manual entry tool
- Store information in Seizure Library
- Record the location of your event and review it within a map on SeizureTracker.com
- Synchronize events with SeizureTracker.com account
- Graph synchronized events (and surrounding information) through the integrated Seizure Tracker system
Please email Info@SeizureTracker.com with comments and suggestions.

bluejetty:00087339:ios.name: Skyflow – Time-lapse Camera
bluejetty:00087339:ios.summary:
Skyflow is a powerful, professional-grade tool for creators who want top-quality in time-lapse and stop-motion.
Skyflow’s standout feature is the ability to change your time-lapse playback speed even after shooting was finished.
With power
bluejetty:00087339:ios.description:
Skyflow is a powerful, professional-grade tool for creators who want top-quality in time-lapse and stop-motion.
Skyflow’s standout feature is the ability to change your time-lapse playback speed even after shooting was finished.
With powerful camera controls, broad format support, and a full-featured editor, Skyflow gives you complete control from shoot to export.
Highly Configurable Capture Experience:
• Source selection: SDR Video, HDR Video, Apple Log, 12MP and 48MP Photo
• Expanded save formats: HEIF, HEIF (10-bit), ProRes, ProRAW
• Shooting modes: Time-Lapse and Stop Motion
• Adjustable Start Time, Interval, and Duration
• Pro Tools: Histogram, Zebra, Apple Log LUT Preview
• Manual control of ISO, shutter speed, EV, white balance, and focus
• Noise Reduction for night shots by limiting shutter speed
• Long Exposure effects: Light Trails & Motion Blur
• 3-stop/2-stop Exposure Bracketing (EB)
• Panning motion for cinematic movement
• Horizon level and photo grid overlays
Feature-rich Time-Lapse Editor:
• Playback speed adjustment with reverse option and speed ramping
• Advanced cropping with perspective correction
• Full editing and sharing support for (Pro)RAW
• Improved image fusion for exposure-bracketed sequences (EB)
• Exposure and color adjustments
• Keypoint-based ramping for playback speed, crop settings, exposure and color adjustments
• Trimming, adding music, continuing a time-lapse, and more
Export and Sharing:
• Export up to 8K (depends on your device model)
• Video formats including ProRes
• Custom frame rate and bitrate
• HDR / Dolby Vision export support
• Save to Photos, Files, or share to other apps
Other Features
• Detailed time-lapse info view with photo metadata and capture-metrics graphs
• Create time-lapse projects from photo albums, bursts, videos, or imported folders
• Support for DJI OSMO Mobile and DJI OSMO Mobile 2 handheld gimbals
Please note: DJI OSMO Mobile 3 and later are not supported due to factors outside our control!
Free Version
You can shoot unlimited time-lapses with no restrictions.
Exports, however, are limited to 540p resolution and include a watermark.
Limitations can be removed with a one-time in-app purchase.

bluejetty:00078346:ios.summary: The Best Nine app is the best way to recapitulate the current or previous years with a layout of your top nine Instagram posts. Using the app is easy, just insert your Instagram username and wait for your best 9 collage to be generated. The
bluejetty:00078346:ios.description:
The Best Nine app is the best way to recapitulate the current or previous years with a layout of your top nine Instagram posts. Using the app is easy, just insert your Instagram username and wait for your best 9 collage to be generated. Then make the finishing touches like adding the tag with total likes or likes per post number, changing the background, or adjusting borders for a more pleasant look. The final layout will consist of a 3x3 grid displaying your most popular photos and reels on Instagram. Whether you’re joining the classic top nine for Instagram trend or sharing your top nine Insta highlights, the final layout will consist of a 3x3 grid displaying your most popular photos and reels on Instagram. Your followers will love it, and you will, too.
Download the Best Nine app to get these features:
Essentials you will love
• Make top 9 collages containing photos and reels from your Instagram.
• Generate best posts from any of previous years.
• Customize the time period to display your best memories from any chosen stretch of time.
• Highlight your favorite video moments with the collage consisting purely of reels.
• Generate your collages without logging in, ensuring your Instagram account stays safe and private.
• Create 3x3 layouts for any Instagram profile you want.
• Export your top9 collage with ease to any social network of your choice.
• Let everyone know about the popularity of your topnine posts by displaying the total number of likes or numbers of likes for each post separately. You can even explore your top9 results from any year.
Customize the way you want
• Change the background color and adjust the border settings to make it more personal.
• Rearrange the order of your pictures and videos so your post will stand out. 
• Display your reels in motion or as static thumbnails only.
Privacy:
The necessity of inserting your Instagram username into the third-party app can make you think about privacy and security. Let us assure you there is no need to be concerned when using the Best Nine app. First of all, we take the privacy of our users very seriously, and we never share any of your data with other third parties. And we don't even have access to your Instagram password since all the authentication will happen on the Instagram side. 
Feedback:
Feedback is driving us to bring more features, better features, and to improve the overall experience. Let us know what you like about the Best Nine app or what you don't like. We would love to hear your opinion.
Purchases:
To use some premium features in the app, you need to purchase Best Nine PLUS. We offer two options with unlimited access to all Best Nine's features:
- Yearly subscription
- One-time payment
If you choose to get a Best Nine PLUS, then your payment will be charged to your iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase. Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. The cost of the renewal depends on your Subscription Plan. Subscriptions may be managed by the user, and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings after purchase. When canceling a subscription, your subscription will remain active until the end of the period. Auto-renewal will be disabled, but the current subscription will not be refunded.
Do you want to see more? For information about the Best Nine app, visit https://best9.app
Privacy Policy: https://legal.apptoro.support/hc/en-us/articles/10140276028689
Terms of Service: https://legal.apptoro.support/hc/en-us/articles/10140631906833

bluejetty:00129412:ios.description:
The Loire Valley during the 15th Century. As influential princes, the players devote their efforts to careful trading and building in order to lead their estates to prominence. Two dice set out the action options, but the players always make the final choices. Whether trading or livestock farming, city building or scientific research, many different paths lead to the prosperity and prominence of the players! The many ways to gain victory points in this building game require careful thought round after round along with extensive planning ahead. Thanks to the different estates, the game remains challenging for the players for a long time, as no two games play out alike. The winner is the player with the most victory points at the end of the game.
Features
- The easy to follow tutorial guides you through the rules
- cross-platform play with all opponents
- ranked and casual games
- world ladder with GLICKO rating
- 3 AI opponents (easy, medium and hard)
- play offline alone or with your friends/spouse
- asynchronous game with notifications
- fast ranked games for live experience
- 10 new quality avatars for your DIGIDICED collection
- Languages: English, German, French, Spanish, Korean, Chinese (simplified), Japanese, Russian and Italian
- Map Pack DLCs for purchase to add new maps to your game.

SummitFM Public Radio App: 
The SummitFM Public Radio App allows you to listen to SummitFM and The 330, pause and rewind the live audio, and view the program schedule for The SummitFM and The 330 all at once! You can explore SummitFM and
bluejetty:00128423:ios.description:
SummitFM Public Radio App: 
The SummitFM Public Radio App allows you to listen to SummitFM and The 330, pause and rewind the live audio, and view the program schedule for The SummitFM and The 330 all at once! You can explore SummitFM and 330 content, request a song, bookmark a program for later, and wake up to The SummitFM with the alarm clock!
The Summit is a commercial-free, all-music, adult-focused public radio station based in northeast Ohio. The station’s signature sound mixes emerging artists, vintage tracks, and local artists from northeast Ohio.
The 330 is a great way to experience the past, present and future of Northeast Ohio music, homegrown and hyper-local and powered by The Summit.
Live Streaming
• DVR-like controls (pause, rewind, and fast forward). You can pause the live stream to have a conversation and pick up right where you left off! Or rewind to catch a comment you just missed!
• Listen to live streams from The SummitFM and The 330 even while traveling! Start the app and your favorite station starts playing – no clicks to start listening.
• Integrated program schedules for the SummitFM and 330 streams! 
• One click stream switching – flip over to the program you noticed on another stream with a single click.
• Listen to The SummitFM and The 330 in the background while browsing the web or catching up on your emails!
Radio Bookmarks
• Save what you were listening to (Live or On Demand) so you can replay, follow-up, or share it later by simply clicking “Bookmark”.
• Compatible with the popular Radio Bookmark device (www.radiobookmark.com).
Additional features
• Easily share stories and programs with family and friends via the “Share” button.
• Get artist and title information.
• A built in Sleep Timer and Alarm Clock allows you to go to sleep and wake up to your favorite station.
The SummitFM Public Radio App is brought to you by the people at The SummitFM and Public Media Apps. We work to provide our valued listeners with great solutions to find what you want, when you want it, and where you want it.
Please support The SummitFM and The 330 Public Radio by making your donation today!
http://www.thesummit.fm
http://www.publicmediaapps.com

Whether you need Motor Insurance, Travel Insurance, Health Insurance, Domestic Helper Insurance, Yacht Insurance, or Personal Accident Insurance, the DIG App gives you a fast, secure, and fully digital experience.
Why You’ll Love the DIG App
Award-Winning Digital Experience
Recognized as App of the Year, the DIG App reflects Doha Insurance Group’s commitment to digital innovation, customer convenience, and modern insurance services in Qatar.
Instant Insurance
Get quotes and buy or renew Motor, Travel, Health, Domestic Helper, Yacht, and Personal Accident Insurance in just minutes.
Easy Claims
Submit claims directly from your mobile and track their progress in real time.
Digital Insurance Wallet
Securely store and access your vehicle policies, medical cards, travel policies, and other insurance documents anytime.

Healthcare Provider Network

Travel Insurance Made Simple
Whether you are visiting Qatar or traveling abroad, DIG provides fast and secure travel insurance solutions, including:
• Pre-arrival travel insurance for Qatar visitors 
• Global travel insurance for outbound travelers 
• Fully digital and internationally recognized policies 
Secure Access
Log in quickly and safely using biometric authentication, including Face ID and Touch ID.
Enhanced Data Protection
Your personal information, policy details, and transactions are protected with enterprise-grade security, supported by ISO 27001-certified information security practices and PCI DSS-compliant payment processing.
Download the DIG App Today
Experience a faster, smarter, and more secure way to manage your insurance in Qatar with Doha Insurance Group’s award-winning DIG App.

bluejetty:00127413:ios.description:
Play Italian Burraco !
A popular italian card game having something in common with the International Burraco.
- Two teams with two player each, you and your team-mate will have to make more points than your adversaries.
- The game play is divided in two sides, in one your team melds, in the other your opponents melds.
- You can play only in your team side and see other team played melds
- A special kind of joker named Pinella (2 of clubs, spades, diamonds and hearts) can be placed as a natural 2 or a joker on your melds
- A special discard pile letting you to take all the cards in it
The free version is full featured but with advertisements, by purchasing the full version you will turn off ads.
---------------------------------------------------------------
AWESOME FEATURES
---------------------------------------------------------------
- many game configuration settings (Players, Strategy, Audio, Game Speed, Appearance, Gestures)
- standard and special leaderboards
- two game modes available (Single Game and Score Mode) to play against your device
- offline and online games
- detailed helps
- great support for your questions and suggestions
- leaderboards
- geo leaderboards
- and more, enjoy!!!
---------------------------------------------------------------
For your suggestions feel free to contact technical support, we will glad to help you
If you'll enjoy using 'Italian Buraco' please take a minute to leave a nice review: it really helps

bluejetty:00131516:ios.summary:
Lose weight and get fit anytime, anywhere with free exercise videos and personalized workout plans. Get fit, feel great, and start working out for free today!
Stay active, reduce stress, and feel good with unlimited access to free workouts
bluejetty:00131516:ios.description:
Lose weight and get fit anytime, anywhere with free exercise videos and personalized workout plans. Get fit, feel great, and start working out for free today!
Stay active, reduce stress, and feel good with unlimited access to free workouts and meditations. Get your sweat on with celebrity trainers and read articles on how to take care of yourself both mentally and physically.
Achieve your health and fitness goals with unlimited access to the best workout classes - from cardio to strength training to HIIT, yoga, Pilates, and much more. With FitOn you’re guaranteed to find a class you love. Plus, you’ll get to work out with top celebrity trainers like Cassey Ho (of Blogilates), Jeanette Jenkins, Kenta Seki, Breann Mitchell, Danielle Pascente, Kenny Ferrer, and many more.
Plus, EXCLUSIVE workouts led by Gabrielle Union, Julianne Hough, Jonathan Van Ness, and Bob Harper.
Also, reduce stress, get better sleep, improve breathing, relax your body and rejuvenate your mind with short and effective meditations.
AMAZING WORKOUTS
• Quick & effective workouts from celebrity trainers
• Exclusive workouts with Gabrielle Union, Julianne Hough & JVN
• No gym? No problem. Turn your home into a fitness studio with your phone, laptop or TV
• No subscription required, no limits - it’s that simple.
PERSONALIZED PROGRAMS
• Reach your goals with customized workout plans
• Lose weight, build muscle, tone up or reduce stress with plans that work for you
WORKOUTS FOR EVERYONE
• Enjoy cardio, strength, HIIT, dance, yoga, Pilates, Barre, and more
• Browse by workout category, body part, length and intensity
• Short on time? We’ve got quick HIIT 10-minute workouts so you can get your workout in fast!
• Workout anytime on-demand or join an upcoming class
GUIDED MEDITATIONS
• Calming meditations to help reduce stress and anxiety
• Guidance toward improved breathing
• Increased relaxation for better sleep
STAY MOTIVATED
• Join the live leaderboard for friendly competition
• Track your progress and share with friends
• See real-time heart rate using Apple Health and Apple Watch
• Real-time messaging with friends or workout partners
Plus, you can access workouts online from your TV or computer: https://app.fitonapp.com or download our app directly on Apple TV.
------
FITNESS IS ALWAYS FREE
Reach your goals even faster and help support free fitness for everyone by upgrading to PRO:
• Personalized meal plans
• 500+ exclusive recipes
• Unlimited offline downloads
• Real-time heart rate zones with Fitbit & Garmin
• Premium music from top artists
• And much more…
Subscription Details
Fitness is always 100% free - no strings attached. If you choose to subscribe to FitOn PRO for our additional features and to help support our mission you'll be billed annually, charged to your iTunes Account, which will automatically renew unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Auto-renew can be turned off anytime by going to your Account Settings in iTunes after purchase. No cancellation of the current subscription is allowed during the active subscription period.
Apple Health
You can optionally choose to sync your workout activity to the Health app to share with other apps or close your rings if you have an Apple Watch.
Terms of Use: https://fitonapp.com/terms/
Privacy Policy: https://fitonapp.com/privacy/

bluejetty:00172362:ios.description:
SciMatch is The #1 AI Matchmaker That Sees What Other Apps Miss. Our AI provides the kind of personalized match insights a relationship psychologist might offer—but all it needs is a single selfie, making it simpler and more accessible for everyone.
YOU'VE MATCHED WITH THIS PERSON BEFORE. 
Different name. Different job. Same disappointing result. What if the problem isn't you—it's that every dating app shows you the same thing: who looks good in photos. Not who you'd naturally feel comfortable with. Not who you'd vibe with from minute one.
Here's what actually predicts chemistry: the biological signals your brain reads in faces before you even say hello. Openness, warmth, confidence, intensity. The things that make someone feel easy or exhausting.
Most apps ignore this. They let you swipe, match, text for weeks, then meet someone and realize on minute five: I already knew this wasn't it.
SCIMATCH DOES 3 THINGS DIFFERENTLY:
1. We predict who you'd naturally click with
Not based on hobbies. Not based on height. Based on the psychological traits your face reflects—and who you'd feel easy with from the first conversation. No more matching with people you have to work to like.
2. We get you face-to-face in 5 minutes, not 3 weeks
Video speed dates. Five minutes. If there's chemistry, keep talking. If not, you just saved yourself 2 weeks of "hey, how was your weekend?" No one's ever texted their way into real chemistry.
3. Chat opens with compatibility—not just mutual attraction
On other apps, you can only talk to people you both found hot. On SciMatch, chat unlocks when there's actual compatibility—even if you didn't match the traditional way. This means fewer dead-end conversations and more real possibilities.
THE RESULT?
You stop wasting weeks on people who seemed right but felt wrong.
You stop decoding whether there's potential.
You stop performing.
You meet people who feel easy.
WHAT'S INSIDE:
 *AI Compatibility Matching
See who you'd naturally vibe with based on psychological alignment—not just who you think is hot
 *5-Minute Video Dates
Test real chemistry in the time it takes to order coffee. If it clicks, keep going. If not, no time wasted.
 *High-Compatibility Chat Unlock
Talk to people you'd actually work with—not just mutual right-swipes
 *Built-In Dating Coach 
Dating is not only about finding matches. It is also about knowing what to say, how to show up, and how to understand your own patterns.
 *Celebrity Lookalike Matching
SciMatch can help you discover people who resemble your celebrity crush or visual preference — while still keeping compatibility at the center.
FREE DATING APP FEATURES
SciMatch gives you more freedom than many dating apps. You can use core dating features for free, including:
* Unlimited swipes
* Unlimited likes
* Free messaging
* See who liked you
* Advanced filters
* Compatibility-based discovery
No endless paywall just to start a real conversation.
SciMatch is free to use.
Optional upgrades: $11.99–$33.99/month
Stop matching with people you have to convince yourself about.
Start meeting people who feel right from the first conversation.
Support: info@scimatch.com
Terms: scimatch.com/terms-of-use
Privacy: scimatch.com/privacy-policy

bluejetty:00174642:ios.description:

 - View times for any saved trip with a single tap
 - Real-time delay information and vehicle map (subject to data availability)
 - Trackwork and service interruption information
 - Interactive maps (create your trip by clicking on your station/stop)

 - Multi-modal trip editor (customise exact change locations / lines)
 - View your favourite trips on Apple Watch
 - Siri Shortcuts
NOTE: Best efforts are taken to ensure timetable accuracy, but no guarantees are made. If you find an error in the timetable, please email support@tripview.com.au with details. No guarantees are made about real-time data availability. If the transit operator doesn't provide real-time data for a particular service, TripView will revert to showing the scheduled time, as per the timetable.

bluejetty:00016526:ios.name: Heroes of Camelot
bluejetty:00016526:ios.summary:
Reclaim Camelot from the Black Knight. Join thousands of players in this RPG Multiplayer Battle Card Game that will transport you into a world dominated by Dragons and Medieval mythological figures!
The Black Knight and his undead warriors
bluejetty:00016526:ios.description:
Reclaim Camelot from the Black Knight. Join thousands of players in this RPG Multiplayer Battle Card Game that will transport you into a world dominated by Dragons and Medieval mythological figures!
The Black Knight and his undead warriors have invaded Camelot. King Arthur and Merlin have summoned all of Britain for a Hero to rise. Will you be this Hero?
Battle for survival and reclaim your land's power by assembling, evolving, and enhancing hundreds of powerful heroes. Each hero represents a card endowed with distinct abilities and powers. Progress through ten Arthurian lands discover the rarest cards in Camelot. Form teams of rare cards to unleash strategic combos and dominate your opponents. Compete with thousands of players around the world in a live PvP Arena, and form Guilds in the world of Camelot.
UNIQUE TEAM-BASED ASSAULTS
- Follow a Quest system through 10 Arthurian Britain cities and over 80 stages
- Strategically form up to three teams to simultaneously battle against Demons and Dragons
- Each team creates unique combos and skills. Your army must be the most powerful of all Camelot's Territories!
THE STRENGTH IN NUMBERS
- Form a guild, create your team’s unique crest and recruit fellow heroes
- Test the might of your party within your guild in friendly Scrimmage combat
- Band together and enter Boss raids in Camelot's 3D dungeon. Select frontal, side, back or sneak attack positions to test the Boss’ strength 
CULTIVATE YOUR ARMY OF HEROS
- Enhance the abilities of each Hero and Evolve them into powerful and stunning cards
- Discover the rarest cards to uncover the most unique and visceral abilities
PvP BATTLES IN CAMELOT'S ARENA
- Showcase your deck's power in the Camelot's Arena by competing with thousands of players around the world in live PvP combat events. Only the mightiest victors will relish rewards and the admiration of your peers.
STRATEGIZE IN LIVE CHAT
- Join a community of fellow Knights and Druids through live chat to find the Holy Grail!
ASCEND TO NEW LEVELS OF COMBAT IN THE CHAMPIONS TOWER
- Unlock the Caerleon Champions Tower and take on Camelot’s toughest challenge yet 
- Explore a unique dungeon on each level and unearth valuable rewards or hidden boss threats 
- Prepare yourself! Only the mightiest heroes will ascend to the highest floors. Will you make it to the top? 
The Story
King Arthur had long been revered as Britain's champion, providing the fair land full of life, wealth and peace. Knights and Druids alike found serenity with one another. Jealous of Arthur's adoration from all, the evil Queen Morgana vied to destroy everything the King protected. Upon discovering a dark relic, Morgana and the Black Knight invaded Britain, casting a spell and consuming all life before them.
The great Merlin tells a story of a hero in search of the Holy Grail - Britain's only hope. For Britain to be what it once was, a call to arms is desperately needed. King Arthur has summoned all Knights and Druid allies on a quest for a hero to rise. But who can avenge Britain and find the Holy Grail?
Follow @HeroesofCamelot for the latest news!
Like us on Facebook: facebook.com/HeroesofCamelot
**************Important************** 
Note: A network connection is required to play 
Works with iPhone 3GS+, iPod touch 3rd Generation+ and iPad 1+
Requires iOS 6.0 or newer

https://decagames.com/privacy.html
https://decagames.com/tos.html

Highlight: CAN CREATE YOUR OWN LUCKY BLOCK FOR MINECRAFT!
Lucky Block Mods and Maps for Minecraft is back with a new version with the best features ever! Now you can create One Block Lucky Block with thousands of different creations, and make random abilities with the function manager. Easy management of lucky blocks addons/maps in History!
Crazy items drop when breaking lucky blocks! But you don't know if it's the good or bad items inside. Sometimes you can get something like weapons, armor, skins, some rare items that are hard to find... that get you through the game easily, but the nightmare things like TNT or creepers,... or even nothing drop!! So lucky block world for Minecraft can bring your Minecraft game to a standstill!
It's one of the best things that makes your Minecraft game more unexpected and unpredictable! Let's come to explore Lucky Block Mods and Maps for Minecraft, the app added all addons and maps of lucky blocks in the same collection. Go in search of the amazing block now!
FEATURES
* Create your own Minecraft lucky block addons
* Random abilities with Function Manager
* Including famous mod lucky blocks for Minecraft such as Minecraft One Lucky Block, Lucky Block Skyblock, Lucky Block Race Map (minigame),...
* The most interesting lucky block races for mcpe, break them and test your luck
* Automatically suggest the newest and trending lucky block
* Support with other addons, mods, or texture packs for Minecraft games
* Update addons, maps, skin frequently
* Can export to Minecraft Pocket Edition, Minecraft Bedrock, Eerskraft, Craftsman, Crafting and Building, Mike craft,...
* No need for third-party applications
* It is compatible with all versions of Minecraft

bluejetty:00122646:ios.summary: CountAbout is the perfect personal finance app for anyone looking to take control of their financial life. Whether you're managing your budget, tracking expenses, or planning for the future, CountAbout seamlessly integrates all aspects of p
bluejetty:00122646:ios.description:
CountAbout is the perfect personal finance app for anyone looking to take control of their financial life. Whether you're managing your budget, tracking expenses, or planning for the future, CountAbout seamlessly integrates all aspects of personal finance into an easy-to-use platform.
FEATURES:
Customizable Budgeting: Create and customize your budget categories and subcategories according to your needs. Set up monthly or yearly budgets to stay on top of your spending habits.
Auto-Sync Transactions: Automatically sync your financial transactions by linking with thousands of financial institutions. This ensures that your financial data is always up-to-date without the need for manual entries.
Transaction Importing and Exporting: Effortlessly import transactions from other financial software like Quicken, ensuring a smooth transition without losing historical data. Export your data anytime for backup or analysis.
Comprehensive Reporting: Generate detailed reports to analyze spending trends, income, net worth, and more. Visual graphs and charts help you get a clear view of your financial health at a glance.
Mobile and Web Access: Manage your finances on-the-go with our iOS app, or at home through the web-based version. Your data seamlessly syncs across all devices, providing you access wherever you are.
Secure and Reliable: Security is paramount at CountAbout. We use advanced encryption standards to protect your data, ensuring that your financial information is safe and secure.
Recurring Transactions: Set up recurring transactions for your regular expenses and incomes. This feature helps in predicting future balances and planning ahead.
Invoicing Feature: Ideal for freelancers and small business owners, our app allows you to create, send, and manage invoices directly from your device.
Customizable Tags: Attach custom tags to your transactions to enhance tracking and categorization. This feature allows for more precise accounting and better insights.
No Advertisements: Enjoy an ad-free experience that focuses solely on your financial management, without any distractions.
Subscription Based: After a free trial period, CountAbout offers a subscription model, ensuring that you only pay for the services you use with no hidden fees.
CountAbout is not just an app; it's a versatile financial tool designed to adapt to your specific financial needs. It’s perfect for individuals looking for a detailed, dynamic, and user-friendly budgeting solution. With continuous updates and improvements, CountAbout remains at the forefront of financial management technology.
Download CountAbout today to start making smarter financial decisions and pave the way for a secure financial future!
Please note: Internet access is required to sync with financial institutions and to keep your data up-to-date.

firefox-addons:3081863.name: Secure Password-Generator
firefox-addons:3081863.summary: Right-click any input field – or press Alt+Shift+P – to insert a strong random password or memorable passphrase. Respects field length limits, fills the confirm field and clears the clipboard automatically. Nothing is stored or sent.
firefox-addons:3081863.description:
Passlet puts a strong password generator right where you need it: in the right-click menu of every input field – and on a keyboard shortcut.
HOW IT WORKS
• Right-click a password field → "Insert secure password" – done.
• Or click into a field and press Alt+Shift+P (customizable).
• The "confirm password" field is filled automatically.
• Passlet respects the field's length limits (maxlength / minlength), so a site can never silently cut off your password.
• The password is also copied to the clipboard (optional) and the clipboard is cleared automatically after 60 seconds (adjustable).
• A green check mark on the toolbar icon confirms every action.
• Click the toolbar icon to see, regenerate and copy a password.
TWO MODES
• Random characters: length 8–64, lowercase, uppercase, digits and symbols individually selectable, your own symbol set, look-alike characters (0/O, 1/l/I) can be excluded.
• Passphrase: 3–10 random words such as "Tinkling-Proofread-Penniless4-Fame" – easy to type and remember, still strong. English (EFF) and German word lists, choice of separator, capitalization and an extra digit.
SECURITY & PRIVACY
• Generated with crypto.getRandomValues() and rejection sampling – no modulo bias.
• Every selected character group appears at least once.
• Passwords are never stored, logged or transmitted. No tracking, no analytics, no network access at all.
• Works with modern web apps (React, Vue, Angular) because proper input events are fired.
Available in English, German, Italian, French and Spanish.
Word lists: EFF Large Wordlist (CC BY 3.0 US), dys2p/wordlists-de (CC0).

flathub:io.github.bigbigmdm.imsprog.summary: Reading, writing and erasing EEPROM chips
flathub:io.github.bigbigmdm.imsprog.description:
IMSProg is a free software for CH341A and CH347T based chip programmers with graphical interface.
 With IMSProg you can read, verify, program, erase i2C, SPI, SPI NOR, SPI NAND, MicroWire EEPROM
 chips using the CH341A or CH347T programmer device.
 IMSProg is a collection of tools:
 IMSProg - the chip programmer (it's the main part).
 IMSProg_editor - chip database editor.
 IMSProg_database_update - script to update chip database using external web-server.
 Flatpak cannot install udev rules onto the host system automatically. If you get USB permission
 errors, download 71-CH341.rules from https://github.com/bigbigmdm/IMSProg (IMSProg_programmer/other/71-CH341.rules),
 copy it to /usr/lib/udev/rules.d/ or /etc/udev/rules.d/ on the host system, run sudo udevadm control
 --reload-rules && sudo udevadm trigger, and reconnect the programmer.
